Bava Kamma 50a:19-50b:1: Tanu rabbanan: chafar ufatach umasar larabbim – patur. chafar ufatach velo masar larabbim – chayyayv, vechen minhago shel nechuneya chofer borot shichin umearot, shehaya chofer ufoteach umoser larabbim. uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: kiyyem ze halacha zo. halacha zo vetu la?! ella ema: af halacha zo.

Tanu rabbanan: maase bevitto shel nechuneya chofer shichin shennafla levor gadol, bau vehodiu et rabbi chanina ben dosa. shaa rishona amar lahem: shalom. sheniyya amar lahem: shalom. shelishit amar lahem: alta.

Amru lah: mi heelich? amra lahem: zachar shel rechelim nizdammen li, vezaken echad manhigo. amru lo: navi atta? amar lahem: "lo navi anochi, velo ben navi anochi", ella kach amarti: davar sheoto tzaddik mitztaer bo – yikkashel bo zaro?

Amar rabbi acha: af al pi chen, met beno batztzama. shenneemar: "usevivav nisara meod" – melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu medakdek im sevivav afillu kechut hassaara. rabbi nechuneya amar mehacha: "el naaratz besod kedoshim rabba, venora al kol sevivav".

Amar rabbi chanina: kol haomer hakkadosh baruch hu vatteran hu, yivvatru chayyav, shenneemar: "hatztzur tamim poolo, ki chol derachav mishpat". amar rabbi chana veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, may dichtiv:
"Erech appayim" – vela ketiv "erech af"? erech appayim latztzaddikim velarshaim.
Berakhot 34b:27-31: Tanu rabbanan: maase shechala beno shel rabban gamliel. shigger shene talmide chachamim etzel rabbi chanina ben dosa levakkesh alav rachamim. kevan sheraa otam, ala laaliyyay, uvikkesh alav rachamim. biridato amar lahem: lechu, shechalatzattu chamma. amru lo: vechi navi atta?! amar lahen: lo navi anochi velo ven navi anochi, ella kach mekkubbelani: im shegura tefillati befi — yodea ani shehu mekubbal, veim lav — yodea ani shehu metoraf. yashvu vechatvu vechivvevnu otah shaa. ucheshebbau etzel rabban gamliel, amar lahen: haavoda, lo chissartem velo hotartem, ella kach haya maase beotah shaa chalatzattu chamma veshaal lanu mayim lishtot.

Veshuv maase berabbi chanina ben dosa shehalach lilmod tora etzel rabbi yochanan ben zakkay, vechala beno shel rabbi yochanan ben zakkay. amar lo: chanina beni, bakkesh alav rachamim veyichye. hinniach rosho ben birkav uvikkesh alav rachamim, vechaya. amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: ilmale hetiach ben zakkay et rosho ben birkav kol hayyom kullo — lo hayu mashgichim alav. amra lo ishto: vechi chanina gadol mimmecha? amar lah: lav, ella hu dome keeved lifne hammelech, vaani dome kesar lifne hammelech.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: al yitpallel adam ella bevayit sheyyesh sham challonot. shenneemar: "vechavvin petichan leh beillite (lokovel) [neged] yerushelem".
Amar rav kahana: chatzif alay man dimtzalle bevakta.
Veamar rav kahana: chatzif alay man dimfaresh chiteh, shenneemar: "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa".

Mishnah Bekhorot 5:2-5:
Vet shammay omrim, lo yimmana yisrael im hakkohen al habbechor. bet hillel mattirin, vaafillu nachri. bechor sheachazo dam, afillu hu met, en makkizin lo dam, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, yakkiz, uvilvad shello yaase vo mum. veim asa vo mum, hare ze lo yishshachet alav. rabbi shimon omer yakkiz, af al pi shehu ose vo mum: 
Hatztzorem beozen habbechor, hare ze lo yishshachet olamit, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, kesheyyivvaled lo mum acher, yishshachet alav. maase vezachar shel rechelim zaken usearo meduldal, raahu kasdor echad, amar, ma tivo shel ze. amru lo, bechor hu veeno nishchat ella im ken haya bo mum. natal pigyon vetzaram beazno, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruhu. raa shehittiru, vehalach vetzaram beazne vechorot acherim, veasaru. paam achat hayu tinokot mesachakin bassade vekashru zanvot telaim ze laze, venifseka zenavo shel echad mehem vahare hu vechor, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruhu. rau shehittiru, vehalchu vekashru zanvot bechorot acherim, veasaru. ze hakkelal, kol shehu ledato, asur. veshello ledato, muttar: 
Haya vechor rodfo, uveato veasa vo mum, hare ze yishchot alav. kol hammumin haruyin lavo vide adam, roim yisrael neemanim, veroim kohanim enan neemanim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, neeman hu al shel chavero veeno neeman al shel atzmo. rabbi meir omer, hechashud al davar, lo dano velo meido: 
Neeman hakkohen lomar hereti bechor ze uvaal mum hu. hakkol neemanim al mume hammaaser. bechor shennismet eno, shenniktea yado, shennishbera raglo, hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha vene hakkeneset, rabbi yose omer, afillu yesh sham esrim ushelosha, lo yishshachet ella al pi mumche:
Mishnah Bekhorot 5:6-6:3:
Hashshochet et habbechor (umecharo) venoda shello herahu, ma sheachlu achlu vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim. uma shello achlu, habbasar yikkaver vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim. vechen hashshochet et happara umecharah venoda shehi terefa, ma sheachlu achlu veyachazir lahem et haddamim. uma shello achlu, hen yachaziru lo et habbasar vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim. mecharuhu lannachrim o hittiluhu lakkelavim, yeshallemu lo deme hatterefa: 
Al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor, nifgema azno min hassechus, aval lo min haor, nisdeka af al pi shello chasra, nikkeva melo charshina, o sheyyavasha. ezo hi yevesha, kol shettinnakev veenah motzia tippat dam. rabbi yose ben meshullam omer, yevesha, shettehe nifrachet: 
Ris shel ayin shennikkav, shennifgam, shennisdak, hare veenav dak, tevallul, chillazon nachash, veenav. veezehu tevallul, lavan hafosek bassira venichnas bashshachor. bashshachor venichnas ballavan, eno mum, sheen mumim ballavan: 
Chavarvad vehammayim hakkevuim. ezehu chavarvad hakkavua, kol sheshshaha shemonim yom. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, bodkin oto shelosha feamim betoch shemonim yom. veellu hem mayim hakkevuim, achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim, lach veyavesh shel shelachim. achal hayyavesh veachar kach achal hallach, eno mum, ad sheyyochal hayyavesh achar hallach:
Mishnah Bekhorot 6:4-8:
Chatmo shennikkav, shennifgam, shennisdak, sefato shennikkeva, shennifgema, shennisdeka, chittav hachitzonot shennifgemu o shennigmemu, vehafenimiyyot shenneekaru. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, en bodkin min hammatimot velifnim, af lo et hamatimot: 
Nifgam hazzovan, o erya shel nekebba bammukdashim, nifgam hazzanav min haetzem, aval lo min happerek, o shehaya rosh hazzanav maftzil etzem, o sheyyesh (basar) ben chulya lechulya melo etzba: 
En lo vetzim, (o) en lo ella betza echat. rabbi yishmael omer, im yesh lo shene chisin, yesh lo shete vetzim. en lo ella chis echad, en lo ella vetza echat. rabbi akiva omer, moshivo al akkuzo umemaech, im yesh sham betza, sofah latzet. maase shemmiech velo yatzat, venishchat venimtzet devuka bakkesalim, vehittir rabbi akiva veasar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: 
Baal chamesh raglayim, o sheen lo ella shalosh, vesheraglav kelutot keshel chamor, vehashshachul, vehakkasul. ezehu shachul, shennishmeta yerecho. vechasul, sheachat miyyarchotav gevoha: 
Nishbar etzem yado, veetzem raglo, af al pi sheeno nikkar. mumin ellu mana ila veyavne, vehodu lo chachamim. veod shelosha hosif. amru lo, lo shamanu et ellu. et sheggalgal eno agol keshel adam, ufiv dome leshel chazir, veshennittal rov hamedabber shel leshono. uvet din shel acharehen amru, hare ellu mumin:
Mishnah Bekhorot 6:9-12:
Maase shehallechi hattachton odef al haelyon, veshalach rabban shimon ben gamliel lachachamim veamru, hare ze mum. ozen haggedi shehayta chefula, amru chachamim, bizman shehi etzem echad, mum. veim enah etzem echad, enah mum. rabbi chananya ven gamliel omer, zenav haggedi shehi doma leshel chazir, vesheen bah shalosh chulyot, hare ze mum: 
Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, et sheyyabbelet beeno, veshennifgam etzem yado, veetzem raglo, veshennifsak atzmo shebbefiv. eno achat gedola veachat ketanna, azno achat gedola veachat ketanna, bemare aval lo vemidda. rabbi yehuda omer, achat mibbetzav gedola kishtayim bachavertah, velo hodu lo chachamim: 
Zenav haegel sheenah maggaat laarkov, amru chachamim, kol marbit haagalim ken, kol zeman shehen magdilin hem nimtachot. leeze arkov amru, rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, laarkov shebbeemtza hayyarech. al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor, ufesule hammukdashin nifdin alehen: 
Ellu sheen shochatin alehen lo vammikdash velo vammedina, chavarvad vehammayim sheenam kevuin, vechittav happenimiyyot shennifgemu, (aval lo) shenneekru, uvaal garav, uvaal yabbelet, uvaal chazazit, vezaken, vechole, umezuham, veshenneevda vo avera, veshehemit et haadam (al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim), vetumtum, veanderoginos, lo vammikdash velo vammedina. rabbi yishmael omer, en mum gadol mizze. vachachamim omrim, eno vechor, ella nigzaz veneevad:
Mishnah Bekhorot 7:1-4:
Mumin ellu, ben kevuin ben ovrin, poslin baadam. yoter alehen baadam, hakkilon, vehallaftan, hammakkavan, vesherosho shakua, ushekifas. uvaale hachatoteret, rabbi yehuda machshir, vachachamim poslin: 
Hakkereach, pasul. ezehu kereach, kol sheen lo shitta shel sear makkefet meozen leozen. veim yesh lo, hare ze kasher. en lo gebinim, en lo ella gevin echad, hu gibben haamur battora. rabbi dosa omer, kol sheggebinav shochvin. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, kol sheyyesh lo shene gabbim ushete shidraot: 
Hecharum, pasul. ezehu charum, hakkochel shete enav keechat. shete enav lemala, ushete enav lematta, eno achat lemala, veeno achat lematta, roe et hacheder veet haaliyya keechat, sache shemesh, zugedos, vehatztziran. veshennashru rise enav, pasul, mippene marit haayin: 
Enav gedolot keshel egel, o ketannot keshel avvaz, gufo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav, chatmo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav, hatztzimmem, vehatztzimmea. eze hu tzimmea, sheaznav ketannot. vehatztzimmem, sheaznav domot lisfog:
Mishnah Bekhorot 7:5-8:2:
Sefato haelyona odefet al hattachtona, vehattachtona odefet al haelyona, hare ze mum. veshennittelu shinnav, pasul, mippene marit haayin. daddav shochvim keshel ishsha, kereso tzava, tabburo yotze, nichpe afillu achat leyamim, ruach katzrit baa alav, hameushkan, uvaal gever. en lo vetzim, o en lo ella vetza achat, zehu meroach ashech haamur battora. rabbi yishmael omer, kol shennimrechu ashachav. rabbi akiva omer, kol sheruach baashachav. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, kol shemmarav chashuchin: 
Hammakkish bekarsullav, uvearkuvotav, uvaal pika, vehaikkel. ezehu ikkel, kol shemmakkif parsotav veen arkuvotav noshkot zo lazo. pika yotza miggudalo, akevo yotze laachorav, parsato rechava keshel avvaz. etzbeotav murkavot zo al zo, o kelutot (lemala) ad happerek, kasher. lematta min happerek vachatachah, kasher. hayta vo yeteret vachatachah, im yesh bah etzem, pasul. veim lav, kasher. yater beyadav uveraglav shesh vashesh esrim vearba, rabbi yehuda machshir, vachachamim poslim. hashsholet bishte yadav, rabbi posel, vachachamim machshirim. hakkushi, vehaggichor, vehallavkan, vehakkippeach, vehannannas, vehacheresh, vehashshote, vehashshikkor, uvaale negaim tehorin, pesulin baadam, uchesherin babbehema. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shota vabbehema enah min hammuvchar, rabbi eliezer omer, af baale dildulin, pesulin baadam, uchesherin babbehema: 
Ellu kesherin baadam, ufesulin babbehema, oto veet beno, uterefa, veyotze dofen, (veshenneevda vahen avera, veshehemit et haadam). hannose nashim baavera, pasul, ad sheyyaddir hanaya. hammittamme lammetim, pasul, ad sheyyekabbel alav shello yehe mittamme lammetim: 
Yesh bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen, bechor lakkohen veeno vechor lannachala, bechor lannachala velakkohen, yesh sheeno vechor lo lannachala velo lakkohen. ezehu bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen, habba achar hannefalim sheyyatza rosho chay, uven tisha sheyyatza rosho met, vehammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyehe vo mitztzurat haadam. hammappelet sandal, o shilya, ushefir merukkam, vehayyotze mechuttach, habba acharehen, bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen. mi shello hayu lo vanim venasa ishsha shekkevar yalda, odah shifcha venishtachrera, odah nachrit venitgayyera, mishshebbat leyishrael yalda, bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen. rabbi yose haggelili omer, bechor lannachala velakkohen, shenneemar (Shemot 13), peter kol rechem bivne yisrael, ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael. mi shehayu lo vanim venasa ishsha shelo yalda, nitgayyera meubberet, nishtachrera meubberet, yalda hi vechohenet, hi uleviyya, hi veishsha shekkevar yalda, vechen mi shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda, veen yadua im ben tisha larishon, o ven shiva laacharon, bechor lakkohen veeno vechor lannachala. ezehu bechor lannachala velakkohen, hammappelet shefir male dam, male mayim, male geninim, hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim shekatzim uremasim, hammappelet yom arbaim, habba acharehen, bechor lannachala velakkohen:  
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav, shenehem enan bechor lo lannachala velo lakkohen. rabbi shimon omer, harishon lannachala, vehashsheni lechamesh selaim:
Mishnah Demai 1:1-3:
Hakkallin shebbaddemay, hashshitin, veharimin vehauzradin, uvenot shuach, uvenot shikma, venovlot hattemara, vehaggufnin, vehannitzpa. uvihuda, haog, vehachometz shebbihuda, vehakkusbar. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hashshitin peturin, chutz mishshel dufera. kol harimin peturin, chutz merime shikmona. kol benot shikma peturot, chutz min hammustafos: 
Haddemay en lo chomesh, veen lo viur, veneechol leonen, venichnas lirushalayim veyotze, umeabbedin et miuto badderachim, venotno leam haaretz, veyochal kenegdo. umechallelim oto kesef al kesef, nechoshet al nechoshet, kesef al nechoshet, unechoshet al happerot, uvilvad sheyyachazor veyifde et happerot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yaale happerot veyeachlu virushalayim: 
Hallokeach lezera velivhema, kemach leorot, shemen lener, shemen lasuch bo et hakkelim, patur min haddemay. mikkeziv ulehallan, patur min haddemay. challat am haaretz, vehamedumma, vehallakuach bechesef maaser sheni, usheyare hammenachot, peturin min haddemay. shemen arev, bet shammay mechayyevin, uvet hillel potrin:
Mishnah Ketubot 4:8-12:
Lo chatav lah, im tishtabbai efrekinnach veotvinnach li leintu, uvechohenet, ahadrinnach limdintach, chayyav, shehu tenay bet din: 
Nishbet, chayyav lifdotah. veim amar, hare gittah uchetubbatah, tifde et atzmah, eno rashshay. lakta, chayyav lerappotah. amar, hare gittah uchetubbatah, terappe et atzmah, rashshay: 
Lo chatav lah, benin dichrin deyehevon lichi minnay innun yirtun kesaf ketubbetich yater al chulekehon deim achuhon, chayyav shehu tenay bet din: 
Benan nukvin deyehevyan lichi minnay, yehevyan yatvan beveti umittezanan minnichsay ad detinnassevan leguvrin, chayyav, shehu tenay bet din: 
At tehe yatva beveti umittezana minnichsay, kol yeme miggad almenutich beveti, chayyav, shehu tenay bet din. kach hayu anshe yerushalayim kotvin. anshe galil hayu chotvin keanshe yerushalayim. anshe yehuda hayu chotvin, ad sheyyirtzu hayyorshim litten lich ketubbetich. lefichach im ratzu hayyorshin, notnin lah ketubbatah ufotrin otah:
Mishnah Ketubot 5:1-4:
Af al pi sheamru, betula gova matayim vealmana mane, im ratza lehosif, afillu mea mane, yosif. nitarmela o nitgarsha, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin, gova et hakkol. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, min hannissuin, gova et hakkol. min haerusin, betula gova matayim vealmana mane, shello chatav lah ella al menat lechansah. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza, kotev livtula shetar shel matayim, vehi chotevet, hitkabbalti mimmecha mane, ulealmana, mane, vehi chotevet, hitkabbalti mimmecha chamishshim zuz. rabbi meir omer, kol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulealmana mimmane, hare zo veilat zenut: 
Notnin livtula shenem asar chodesh mishshettevaah habbaal lefarnes et atzmah. ucheshem shennotnin laishsha, kach notnin laish lefarnes et atzmo. ulealmana sheloshim yom. higgia zeman velo nissau, ochlot mishshello veochlot batteruma. rabbi tarfon omer, notnin lah hakkol teruma. rabbi akiva omer, mechetza chullin umechetza teruma: 
Hayyavam eno maachil batteruma. asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal veshishsha chodashim bifne hayyavam, vaafillu chullan bifne habbaal chaser yom echad bifne hayyavam, o chullan bifne hayyavam chaser yom echad bifne habbaal, enah ochelet batteruma. zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehen amru, en haishsha ochelet batteruma, ad shettikkanes lachuppa: 
Hammakdish maase yede ishto, hare zo osa veochelet. hammotar, rabbi meir omer, hekdesh. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer, chullin:
Mishnah Ketubot 5:5-8:
Ellu melachot shehaishsha osa levalah, tochenet, veofa, umechabbeset, mevashshelet, umenika et benah, matztzaat lo hammitta, veosa vatztzemer. hichnisa lo shifcha achat, lo tochenet, velo ofa velo mechabbeset. shetayim, enah mevashshelet veenah menika et benah. shalosh, enah matztzaat lo hammitta veenah osa vatztzemer. arbaa, yoshevet bakkattedra. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu hichnisa lo mea shefachot, kofah laasot batztzemer, shehabbattala mevia lide zimma. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af hammaddir et ishto millaasot melacha, yotzi veyitten ketubbatah, shehabbattala mevia lide shiamum: 
Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta, bet shammay omrim, shete shabbatot. bet hillel omrim, shabbat echat. hattalmidim yotzin letalmud tora shello virshut, sheloshim yom. happoalim, shabbat echat. haona haamura vattora, hattayyalin, bechol yom. happoalim, shetayim bashshabbat. hachammarim, achat bashshabbat. haggammalim, achat lishloshim yom. hassappanim, achat leshishsha chodashim, divre rabbi eliezer: 
Hammoredet al balah, pochatin lah mikketubbatah shiva dinarin bashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, shiva tarpeikin. ad matay hu fochet, ad keneged ketubbatah. rabbi yose omer, leolam hu fochet veholech, shemma tippol lah yerushsha mimmakom acher, gove hemenna. vechen hammored al ishto, mosifin lah al ketubbatah shelosha dinarin bashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, shelosha tarpeikin: 
Hammashre et ishto al yede shalish, lo yifchot lah mishshene kabbin chittin, o mearbaa kabbin seorim. amar rabbi yose, lo fasak lah seorim ella rabbi yishmael shehaya samuch leedom. venoten lah chatzi kav kitnit vachatzi log shemen, vekav gerogarot, o mane devela. veim en lo, posek leummatan perot mimmakom acher. venoten lah mitta, mappatz, umachatzelet. venoten lah kippa leroshah, vachagor lematneha, uminalim mimmoed lemoed, vechelim shel chamishshim zuz mishshana leshana. veen notnin lah, lo chadashim bimot hachamma, velo shechakim bimot haggeshamim. ella noten lah kelim shel chamishshim zuz bimot haggeshamim, vehi mitkassa vivlaotehen bimot hachamma, vehashshechakim shellah:
Mishnah Ketubot 5:9-6:4: Noten lah maa chesef letzarkah, veochelet immo millele shabbat lelele shabbat. veim en noten lah maa chesef letzarkah, maase yadeha shellah. uma hi osa lo, mishkal chamesh selaim sheti bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil, o mishkal eser selaim erev bihuda, shehen esrim selaim baggalil. veim hayta menika, pochatim lah mimmaase yadeha, umosifin lah al mezonoteha. bamme devarim amurim, beani shebbeyisrael. aval bimchubbad, hakkol lefi chevodo:

Metziat haishsha umaase yadeha, levalah. virushshatah, hu ochel perot bechayyeha. bashtah ufegamah, shellah. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, bizman shebbasseter, lah shene chalakim, velo echad. uvizman shebbaggaluy, lo shene chalakim, velah echad. shello, yinnaten miyyad. veshellah, yillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot:
Happosek maot lachatano, umet chatano, amru chachamim, yachol hu sheyyomar, leachicha hayiti rotze litten, ulecha i efshi litten:

Paska lehachenis lo elef dinar, hu fosek kenegdan chamishsha asar mane. ucheneged hashshum, hu fosek pachot chomesh. shum bemane veshave mane, en lo ella mane. shum bemane, hi notenet sheloshim veechad sela vedinar. uvearba meot, hi notenet chamesh meot. ma shechatan posek, hu fosek pachot chomesh:
Paska lehachenis lo chesafim, sela kesef naase shishsha dinarim. hechatan mekabbel alav asara dinarin lakkuppa, lechol mane umane. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol keminhag hammedina:
Mishnah Ketubot 6:5-7:1: Hammassi et bitto setam, lo yifchot lah mechamishshim zuz. pasak lehachenisah arumma, lo yomar habbaal kesheachnisah leveti achassenna vichsuti, ella mechassah veodah bevet aviha. vechen hammassi et hayetoma, lo yifchot lah mechamishshim zuz. im yesh bakkis, mefarnesin otah lefi chevodah:

Yetoma shehissiatta immah o acheha middatah, vechatvu lah bemea o vachamishshim zuz, yechola hi mishshettagdil lehotzi miyyadan ma sherauy lehinnaten lah. rabbi yehuda omer, im hissi et habbat harishona, yinnaten lashsheniyya chederech shennatan larishona. vachachamim omrim, peamim sheadam ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni, ella shamin et hannechasim venotnin lah:

Hammashlish maot levitto, vehi omeret neeman bali alay, yaase hashshalish ma shehushlash beyado, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, vechi enah ella sade vehi rotza lemachrah, hare hi mechura meachshav. bamme devarim amurim, bigdola. aval biktanna, en maase ketanna chelum:

Hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo, ad sheloshim yom, yaamid parnas. yater mikken, yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi yehuda omer, beyisrael, chodesh echad yekayyem, ushenayim, yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvechohenet, shenayim yekayyem, ushelosha, yotzi veyitten ketubba:
Mishnah Ketubot 7:2-5:
Hammaddir et ishto shello titom achad mikkol happerot, yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi yehuda omer, beyisrael, yom echad yekayyem, shenayim, yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvechohenet, shenayim yekayyem, shelosha, yotzi veyitten ketubba: 
Hammaddir et ishto shello titkashshet beachad mikkol hamminin, yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi yose omer, baaniyyot, shello natan kitzba. uvaashirot, sheloshim yom: 
Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet aviha, bizman shehu immah bair, chodesh echad yekayyem. shenayim, yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvizman shehu veir acheret, regel echad yekayyem. shelosha, yotzi veyitten ketubba: 
Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet haevel o levet hammishte, yotzi veyitten ketubba, mippene shennoel befaneha. veim haya toen mishshum davar acher, rashshay. amar lah, al menat shettomri lifloni ma sheamart li o ma sheamarti lach, o shettehe memallea umeara laashpa, yotzi veyitten ketubba:
Mishnah Peah 6:10-7:3:
Tevua shennittena leshachat o laalumma, vechen baagudde hashshum, vaaguddot hashshum vehabbetzalim, en lahen shichcha. vechol hattemunim baaretz, kegon halluf vehashshum vehabbetzalim, rabbi yehuda omer, en lahem shichcha. vachachamim omrim, yesh lahem shichcha: 
Hakkotzer ballayla vehameammer vehassuma, yesh lahem shichcha. veim haya mitkavven littol et haggas haggas, en lo shichcha. im amar, hare ani kotzer al menat ma sheani shochech ani ettol, yesh lo shichcha: 
Kol zayit sheyyesh lo shem bassade, afillu kezet hannetofa bishato, ushechacho, eno shichcha. bamme devarim amurim, bishmo uvemaasav uvimkomo. bishmo, shehaya shifchoni o veshani. bemaasav, shehu ose harebe. bimkomo, shehu omed betzad haggat o vetzad happirtza. ushear kol hazzetim, shenayim shichcha, ushelosha enan shichcha. rabbi yose omer, en shichcha lazzetim: 
Zayit shennimtza omed ben shalosh shurot shel shene malbenim ushechacho, eno shichcha. zayit sheyyesh bo satayim, ushechacho, eno shichcha. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shello hitchil bo. aval im hitchil bo, afillu kezet hannetofa bishato, ushechacho, yesh lo shichcha. kol zeman sheyyesh lo tachtav, yesh lo verosho. rabbi meir omer, mishshettelech hammachave: 
Ezehu feret, hannosher bishat habbetzira. haya votzer, akatz et haeshkol, husbach bealim, nafal miyyado laaretz venifrat, hare hu shel baal habbayit. hammanniach et hakkalkala tachat haggefen beshaa shehu votzer, hare ze gozel et haaniyyim, al ze neemar (Mishlei 22) al tasseg gevul olim:
Mishnah Peah 6:6-9:
Haomer sheyyesh bo satayim, ushechacho, eno shichcha. shene omarim uvahem satayim, rabban gamliel omer, levaal habbayit. vachachamim omrim, laaniyyim. amar rabban gamliel, vechi merov hoomarim yuppe choach shel baal habbayit o hura kocho. amru lo, yuppe chocho. amar lahem, uma im bizman shehu omer echad uvo satayim ushechacho, eno shichcha, shene omarim uvahem satayim, eno din shello yehe shichcha. amru lo, lo, im amarta beomer echad shehu chegadish, tomar bishne omarim shehen kichrichot: 
Kama sheyyesh bah satayim, ushechachah, enah shichcha. en bah satayim, aval hi reuya laasot satayim, afillu hi shel tofeach, roin otah keillu hi anava shel seorim: 
Hakkama matztzelet et haomer veet hakkama. haomer eno matztzil lo et haomer velo et hakkama. ezo hi kama shehi matztzelet et haomer, kol sheenah shichcha afillu kelach echad: 
Sea tevua akura usea sheenah akura, vechen bailan, vehashshum vehabbetzalim, enan mitztarfin lesatayim, ella shel aniyyim hem. rabbi yose omer, im bat reshut heani baemtza, enan mitztarfin, veim lav, hare ellu mitztarfin:
Mishnah Peah 7:4-7:
Ezohi olelet. kol sheen lah lo chatef velo natef. im yesh lah katef o natef, shel baal habbayit, im safek, laaniyyim. olelet shebbaarkubba, im nikretzet im haeshkol, hare hi shel baal habbayit, veim lav, hare hi shel aniyyim. garger yechidi, rabbi yehuda omer, eshkol. vachachamim omrim, olelet: 
Hammedel baggefanim, keshem shehu medel betoch shello, ken hu medel beshel aniyyim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, beshello hu rashshay, veeno rashshay beshel aniyyim: 
Kerem revai, bet shammay omrim, en lo chomesh, veen lo viur. bet hillel omrim, yesh lo. bet shammay omrim, yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot, vehaaniyyim podin leatzman. uvet hillel omrim, kullo laggat: 
Kerem shekkullo ollot, rabbi eliezer omer, levaal habbayit. rabbi akiva omer, laaniyyim. amar rabbi eliezer, ki tivtzor lo teolel (Devarim kad), im en batzir, minnayin ollot. amar lo rabbi akiva, vecharmecha lo teolel (Vayikra 19), afillu chullo ollot, im ken lamma neemar ki tivtzor lo teolel, en laaniyyim baollot kodem habbatzir:
Mishnah Peah 7:8-8:3: Hammakdish karmo ad shello nodu vo haollot, en haollot laaniyyim. mishshennodu vo haollot, haollot laaniyyim. rabbi yose omer, yittenu sechar giddulav lahekdesh. eze hi shichcha bearis, kol sheeno yachol lifshot et yado velittelah, uverogliyyot, mishsheyyaavor hemenna:

Meematay kol adam muttarin beleket. mishsheyyelchu hannamoshot. beferet veollot, mishsheyyelchu haaniyyim bakkerem veyavou. uvezetim, mishshettered revia sheniyya. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo yesh sheenam moskin et zetehem ella leachar revia sheniyya. ella chede sheyyehe heani yotze velo yehe mevi bearbaa issarot:
Neemanim al halleket veal hashshichcha veal happea bishatan, veal masar ani bechol shenato. uven levi neeman leolam. veenan neemanin ella al davar shebbene adam nohagin ken:

Neemanin al hachittim, veen neemanin al hakkemach velo al happat. neemanin al hasseora shel orez, veen neemanin alav ben chay ben mevushshal. neemanin al happol, veen neemanin al haggerisin, lo chayyim velo mevushshalin. neemanin al hashshemen lomar shel masar ani hu, veen neemanin alav lomar shel zete nikkuf hu:
Mishnah Peah 8:4-8: Neemanim al hayyarak chay, veen neemanim al hamevushshal, ella im ken haya lo davar muat, shekken derech baal habbayit lihyot motzi millefaso:

En pochatin laaniyyim baggoren mechatzi kav chittim vekav seorim. rabbi meir omer, chatzi kav. kav vachetzi chussemin, vekav gerogarot, o mane devela. rabbi akiva omer, peras. chatzi log yayin. rabbi akiva omer, reviit. reviit shemen. rabbi akiva omer, sheminit. ushear kol happerot, amar abba shaul, kede sheyyimkerem veyikkach bahem mezon shete seuddot:
Midda zo amura bechohanim uvilviyyim uveyisreelim. haya matztzil, notel mechetza venoten mechetza. haya lo davar muat, noten lifnehem, vehen mechallekin benehem:

En pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom mikkikkar befunedyon, mearba sein besela. lan, notnin lo parnasat lina. shavat, notnin lo mezon shalosh seuddot. mi sheyyesh lo mezon shete seuddot, lo yittol min hattamchuy. mezon arba esre seuddot, lo yittol min hakkuppa. vehakkuppa nigbet bishnayim, umitchalleket bishlosha:

Mi sheyyesh lo matayim zuz, lo yittol leket shichcha ufea umasar ani. hayu lo matayim chaser dinar, afillu elef notnin lo cheachat, hare ze yittol. hayu memushkanim levaal chovo o lichtubbat ishto, hare ze yittol. en mechayyevin oto limkor et beto veet kele tashmisho:
Mishnah Peah 8:9:
Mi sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz vehu nose venoten bahem, hare ze lo yittol. vechol mi sheeno tzarich littol venotel, eno niftar min haolam ad sheyyitztarech labberiyyot. vechol mi shetztzarich littol veeno notel, eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyefarnes acherim mishshello, vealav hakkatuv omer baruch haggever asher yivtach baAdonai vehaya Adonai mivtacho (yirmeya 17). vechen dayyan sheddan din emet laamitto. vechol mi sheeno lo chigger, velo suma, velo fisseach, veose atzmo keachad mehem, eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyihye keechad mehem, shenneemar (Devarim 16) tzedek tzedek tirdof. vechol dayyan shellokeach shochad umatte et haddin, eno met min hazzikna ad sheenav kehot, shenneemar (Shemot 23) veshochad lo tikkach ki hashshochad yeavver pikchim vegomer:
selik massechet pea
Mishneh Torah, Foundations of the Torah: Kol bet yisrael metzuvvin al kiddush hashshem haggadol hazze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 32)</small> "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael". umuzharin shello lechallelo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 32)</small> "velo techallelu et shem kadshi". ketzad. kesheyyaamod oved kochavim veyeenos et yisrael laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora o yahargennu yaavor veal yehareg shenneemar bammitzvot <small>(Vayikra 18 5)</small> "asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem". vachay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem. veim met velo avar hare ze mitchayyev benafsho:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar mitzvot chutz meavodat kochavim vegilluy arayot ushefichat damim. aval shalosh averot ellu im yomar lo avor al achat mehen o tehareg. yehareg veal yaavor. bamme devarim amurim bizman shehaoved kochavim mitkavven lahanaat atzmo. kegon sheanaso livnot lo beto beshabbat o levashshel lo tavshilo. o anas ishsha levoolah vechayyotze baze. aval im nitkavven lehaaviro al hammitzvot bilvad. im haya beno leven atzmo veen sham asara miyyisrael yaavor veal yehareg. veim anaso lehaaviro baasara miyyisrael yehareg veal yaavor. vaafillu lo nitkavven lehaaviro ella al mitzva mishshear mitzvot bilvad:

Vechol haddevarim haellu shello bishat haggezera aval bishat haggezera vehu sheyyaamod melech rasha kinvuchadnetztzar vachaverav veyigzor gezera al yisrael levattel datam o mitzva min hammitzvot. yehareg veal yaavor afillu al achat mishshear mitzvot ben neenas betoch asara ben neenas beno leven ovde kochavim:

Kol haover middato belo ones al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora bishat benefesh lehacheis hare ze mechallel et hashshem. ulefichach neemar bishvuat sheker <small>(Vayikra 19 12)</small> "vechillalta et shem elohecha ani Adonai". veim avar baasara miyyisrael hare ze chillel et hashshem barabbim. vechen kol happoresh meavera o asa mitzva lo mippene davar baolam lo pachad velo yira velo levakkesh kavod ella mippene habbore baruch hu kimniat yosef hatztzaddik atzmo meeshet rabbo hare ze mekaddesh et hashshem:

Veyesh devarim acherim shehen bichlal chillul hashshem. vehu sheyyaase otam adam gadol battora umefursam bachasidut devarim shehabberiyyot merannenim acharav bishvilam. veaf al pi sheenan averot hare ze chillel et hashshem kegon shellakach veeno noten deme hammikkach lealtar. vehu sheyyesh lo venimtzeu hammochrim tovin vehu makkifan. o sheyyarbe bischok o baachila ushetiyya etzel amme haaretz uvenehen. o sheddibburo im habberiyyot eno benachat veeno mekabbelan besever panim yafot ella baal ketata vechaas. vechayyotze baddevarim haellu hakkol lefi gadlo shel chacham tzarich sheyyedakdek al atzmo veyaase lifnim mishshurat haddin. vechen im dikdek hechacham al atzmo vehaya dibburo benachat im habberiyyot vedato meorevet immahem umekabbelam besever panim yafot veneelav mehem veeno olvam. mechabbed lahen vaafillu lamkillin lo. venose venoten beemuna. velo yarbe baarichut amme haaretz vishivatan. velo yerae tamid ella osek battora atuf betzitzit muchtar bitfillin veose bechol maasav lifnim mishshurat haddin. vehu shello yitrachek harebe velo yishtomem. ad sheyyimmatzu hakkol mekallesin oto veohavim oto umitavvim lemaasav. hare ze kiddesh et Adonai vealav hakkatuv omer <small>(yeshaya mat 3)</small> "vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar":

Veyesh devarim acherim shehen bichlal chillul hashshem. vehu sheyyaase otam adam gadol battora umefursam bachasidut devarim shehabberiyyot merannenim acharav bishvilam. veaf al pi sheenan averot hare ze chillel et hashshem kegon shellakach veeno noten deme hammikkach lealtar. vehu sheyyesh lo venimtzeu hammochrim tovin vehu makkifan. o sheyyarbe bischok o baachila ushetiyya etzel amme haaretz uvenehen. o sheddibburo im habberiyyot eno benachat veeno mekabbelan besever panim yafot ella baal ketata vechaas. vechayyotze baddevarim haellu hakkol lefi gadlo shel chacham tzarich sheyyedakdek al atzmo veyaase lifnim mishshurat haddin. vechen im dikdek hechacham al atzmo vehaya dibburo benachat im habberiyyot vedato meorevet immahem umekabbelam besever panim yafot veneelav mehem veeno olvam. mechabbed lahen vaafillu lamkillin lo. venose venoten beemuna. velo yarbe baarichut amme haaretz vishivatan. velo yerae tamid ella osek battora atuf betzitzit muchtar bitfillin veose bechol maasav lifnim mishshurat haddin. vehu shello yitrachek harebe velo yishtomem. ad sheyyimmatzu hakkol mekallesin oto veohavim oto umitavvim lemaasav. hare ze kiddesh et Adonai vealav hakkatuv omer <small>(yeshaya mat 3)</small> "vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar": 
Kol hameabbed shem min hashshemot hakkedoshim hattehorim shennikra bahem hakkadosh baruch hu loke min hattora. shehare hu omer baavodat kochavim <small>(gemara shabbat 120 b)</small> "veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem":
Veshiva shemot hem. hashshem hannichtav yod hei vav hei vehu hashshem hameforash. o hannichtav adonay. veel. eloah. velohim. velohe. veshadday. utzevaot. kol hammochek afillu ot achat mishshiva ellu loke:

Kol mi shenneemar bo yaavor veal yehareg veneherag velo avar hare ze mitchayyev benafsho. vechol mi shenneemar bo yehareg veal yaavor veneherag velo avar hare ze kiddesh et hashshem. veim haya baasara miyyisrael hare ze kiddesh et hashshem barabbim kedaniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya verabbi akiva vachaverav. veellu hen haruge malchut sheen maala al maalatan. vaalehen neemar <small>(Tehillim 44 23)</small> "ki alecha horagnu chol hayyom nechshavnu ketzon tivcha". vaalehem neemar <small>(Tehillim 50 5)</small> "isfu li chasiday korte veriti ale zavach". vechol mi shenneemar bo yehareg veal yaavor veavar velo neherag hare ze mechallel et hashshem. veim haya baasara miyyisrael hare ze chillel et hashshem barabbim uvittel mitzvat ase shehi kiddush hashshem veavar al mitzvat lo taase shehi chillul hashshem. veaf al pi chen mippene sheavar beones en malkin oto veen tzarich lomar sheen memitin oto bet din afillu harag beones. sheen malkin umemitin ella leover birtzono uveedim vehateraa shenneemar benoten mizzaro lammolech <small>(Vayikra 20 5)</small> "(venatatti) [vesamti] ani et panay baish hahu". mippi hashshemua lamdu hahu lo anus velo shogeg velo mute. uma im avodat kochavim shehi chamura min hakkol haoved otah beones eno chayyav karet veen tzarich lomar mitat bet din. kal vachomer lishar mitzvot haamurot battora. uvaarayot hu omer <small>(Devarim 22 26)</small> "velannaara lo taase davar". aval im yachol lemallet nafsho velivroach mittachat yad hammelech harasha veeno ose hinne hu kechelev shav al keo. vehu nikra oved avodat kochavim bemezid vehu nitrad min haolam habba veyored lammadrega hattachtona shel gehinnom:

Nashim sheamru lahem ovde kochavim tenu lanu achat mikken unetamme otah veim lav netamme et kullechen yittamu kullan veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael. vechen im amru lahem ovde kochavim tenu lanu echad mikkem venahargennu veim lav naharog kullechem. yehargu kullam veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael. veim yichaduhu lahem veamru tenu lanu peloni o naharog et kullechem. im haya mechuyyav mita kesheva ben bichri yittenu oto lahem. veen morin lahem ken lechattechilla. veim eno chayyav mita yehargu kullan veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael:

Kainyan sheamru boonasin kach amru bocholaim. ketzad. mi shechala venata lamut veamru harofim sherfuato bedavar peloni meissurin shebbattora osin. umitrappein bechol issurin shebbattora bimkom sakkana chutz meavodat kochavim vegilluy arayot ushefichat damim sheafillu bimkom sakkana en mitrappein bahen. veim avar venitrappe onshin oto bet din onesh harauy lo:

Uminnayin sheafillu bimkom sakkanat nefashot en ovrin al achat mishshalosh averot ellu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha" afillu hu notel et nafshecha. vaharigat nefesh miyyisrael lerappeot nefesh acheret o lehatztzil adam miyyad annas davar shehaddaat nota lo hu sheen meabbedin nefesh mippene nefesh. vaarayot hukkeshu linfashot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 26)</small> "ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu uretzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze":

Bamme devarim amurim sheen mitrappein bishar issurim ella bimkom sakkana. bizman shehen derech hanaatan kegon shemmaachilin et hachole shekatzim uremasim o chametz befesach o shemmaachilin oto beyom hakkippurim. aval shello derech hanaatan kegon sheosin lo retiyya o melugema mechametz o mearla. o shemmashkin oto devarim sheyyesh bahen mar meorav im issure maachol shehare en bahen hanaa lachech hare ze muttar vaafillu shello bimkom sakkana. chutz mikkile hakkerem uvasar bechalav shehen asurim afillu shello derech hanaatan. lefichach en mitrappein mehen afillu shello derech hanaatan ella bimikom sakkana:

Mi shennatan enav beishsha vechala venata lamut veamru harofim en lo refua ad shettibbael lo. yamut veal tibbael lo afillu hayta penuya. vaafillu ledabber immah meachore haggader en morin lo bechach veyamut velo yoru ledabber immah meachore haggader shello yehu benot yisrael hefker veyavou bidvarim ellu lifrotz baarayot:
Niddah 13b:5-7: Tanu rabbanan: haggerim vehamesachakin betinokot — meakkevin et hammashiach. bishlama gerim — kidrabbi chelbo, deamar rabbi chelbo: "kashin gerim leyisrael kesappachat", ella mesachakin battinokot may hi?
Ilema mishkav zechur — bene sekila ninhu! ella derech evarim — bene mabbul ninhu!
Ella denasyvi ketannot, delav benot olode ninhu, deamar rabbi yose: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol hanneshamot shebbagguf, shenneemar: "ki ruach millefanay yaatof uneshamot ani asiti".
Proverbs 4:15-20: Ki lo yishnu im-lo yareu venigzela shenatam im-lo (ykeshavelav) [yachshilu]
Ki lachamu lechem resha veyen chamasim yishtu
Veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech vaor ad-nechon hayyom
Derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu {p}
Proverbs 4:21-24: Mikkol-mishmar netzor libbecha ki-mimmennu totzot chayyim
Haser mimmecha ikkeshut pe ulezut sefatayim harechek mimmekka
Proverbs 4:25-5:2: Enecha lenochach yabbitu veafappecha yayshiru negdecha
Al-tet-yamin usemovl haser raglecha mera {p}
Proverbs 5:3-8: Ki nofet tittofna sifte zara vechalak mishshemen chikkah
Veacharitah mara challaana chadda kecherev piyyot
Ragleha yordot mavet sheol tzeadeha yitmochu
Orach chayyim pen-tefalles nau mageloteha lo teda {p}
Harechek mealeha darkecha veal-tikrav el-petach betah
Proverbs 5:9-13: Pen-yisbeu zarim kochecha vaatzavecha bevet nochri
Veamarta ech saneti musar vetochachat naatz libbi
Velo-shamati bekol moray velimlammeday lo-hittiti ozni
Shabbat 54b:18-55a:3: Parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya: vachada para haveya leh? veha amar rav, veamri lah amar rav yehuda amar rav: teresar alfe igle hava meassar rabbi elazar ben azarya meedreh kol shatta veshatta.
Tana: lo shello hayta ella shel shechento hayta, umittoch shello micha bah nikret al shemo.

Rav verabbi chanina verabbi yochanan verav chaviva matnu: bechulleh deseder moed kol ki hay zuga challofe rabbi yochanan umeayyel rabbi yonatan. kol mi sheefshar limchot leanshe veto velo micha — nitpas al anshe veto. beanshe iro — nitpas al anshe iro. bechol haolam kullo — nitpas al kol haolam kullo.
Amar rav pappa: vehane deve resh galuta mittafsu akkulle alma. ki ha deamar rabbi chanina: may dichtiv "Adonai bammishpat yavo im zikne ammo vesarav" — im sarim chatu,
Zekenim me chatu? ella ema: al zekenim, shello michu bassarim.

Rav yehuda hava yatev kammeh dishmuel. atay hahi itteta ka tzavvcha kammeh, vela hava mashgach ba. amar leh: la savar leh mar: "otem ozno mizzaakat dal gam hu yikra velo yeane"? amar leh: shinnana, reshach bekarire, resha dereshaych bechammime. ha yatev mar ukeva av bet din.
Dichtiv: "bet david ko amar Adonai dinu labboker mishpat vehatztzilu gazul miyyad oshek pen tetze chaesh chamati uvaara veen mechabbe mippene roa maallehem vegomer".
Yevamot 60b:6-14: Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad — keshera lakkehunna, shenneemar: "vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar hachayu lachem", vahare pinchas immahem.
Verabbanan? laavadim velishfachot. i hachi, bat shalosh shanim veyom echad name?

Kidrav huna. derav huna rame, ketiv: "kol ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu", ha enah yodaat — kayyemu, mikkelal dehattaf, ben yadu ben lo yadu — kayyemu. uchetiv: "vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar hachayu lachem", ha yadi — harogu!
Heve omer biruya libbael hakkatuv medabber.

Tanya name hachi: "vechol ishsha yodaat ish" — biruya libbael hakkatuv medabber. atta omer biruya libbael, o eno ella nivala mammash? keshehu omer: "vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar", heve omer: biruya libbael hakkatuv medabber.

Mena yadi? amar rav huna bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: heevirum lifne hatztzitz. kol sheppaneha morikot — beyadua shehi reuya libbael, kol sheen paneha morikot — beyadua sheenah reuya libbael. amar rav nachman: siman laavera — hidrokan.

Kayyotze baddavar, atta omer: "vayyimtzeu miyyoshve yavesh gilad arba meot naara vetula asher lo yadu ish lemishkav zachar", mena yadi? amar rav kahana: hoshivum al pi chavit shel yayin, beula — rechah nodef, betula — en rechah nodef.

Uneabberinhu lifne tzitz? amar rav kahana bereh derav natan: "leratzon lahem" ketiv, leratzon velo lefureanut. i hachi bemidyan name? amar rav ashe: "lahem" ketiv, lahem — leratzon velo lefureanut, ulegoyim — afillu lefureanut.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon ben yochay. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi: beferush shemia lach, o mikkelala shemia lach?
Zevachim 57a:5-11: Habbechor neechol lakkohanim. tanu rabbanan: minnayin labbechor shenneechol lishne yamim velayla? shenneemar: "uvesaram yihye lach kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin" – hikkisho hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim; ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.
Vezo sheela nishala lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne: bechor lechamma neechol? naana rabbi tarfon veamar: lishne yamim velayla echad.

Haya sham talmid echad shebba levet hammidrash lifne chachamim techilla, verabbi yose haggelili shemo, amar lo: rabbi, minnayin lach? amar lo: beni, shelamim kadashim kallim, uvechor kadashim kallim; ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.
Amar lo: rabbi, bechor mattana lakkohen, vechattat veasham mattana lakkohen; ma chattat veasham leyom valayla, af bechor leyom valayla!

Amar lo: nadun davar mittoch davar, venilmad davar mittoch davar; ma shelamim en bain al chet – af bechor eno ba al chet, ma shelamim neechalim lishne yamim velayla echad – af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.

Amar lo: rabbi, nadun davar middavar, yilmad davar middavar; chattat veasham mattana lakkohen, uvechor mattana lakkohen; ma chattat veasham en bain beneder unedava – af bechor eno beneder unedava, ma chattat veasham neechalin leyom echad – af bechor neechol leyom echad!

Kafatz rabbi akiva, venistallek rabbi tarfon. amar lo: hare hu omer "uvesaram yihye lach" – hikkishan hakkatuv lechaze vashok shel shelamim; ma shelamim neechalin lishne yamim velayla echad, af bechor neechol lishne yamim velayla echad.
Zohar, Bereshit 78: Ta chaze, kad itkaddash yoma bemaale shabbatta sukkat shalom sharya veitperisat bealma. man sukkat shalom, da shabbatta, vechol ruchin veilulin veshedin vechol sitra dimsaave kulhu temirin vealin beena derechayyay denukeva dithoma rabba. deha kevan deitar kedushata al alma, ruach mesaava la itar bahadeh. veda arik mikkammeh deda.

Ucheden alma bintiru illaa vela baenan letzallaa al netiru kegon shomer et ammo yisrael laad amen. deha da beyoma dechol ittakkan dealma baya netiru. aval beshabbat sukkat shalom itperisa al alma veitnetir bechol sitrin. veafillu chayyayve gehinnom netirin innun, vecholla bishlama ishtakkecha illain vetattain, ubbegin kach bekiddusha deyoma mevarchinan happores sukkat shalom alenu veal kol amo yisrael veal yerushalam.

Ammay al yerushalam, ella da hi medora dehahi sukka. uvaena lezammena lehahi sukka deitperasat alana ulemeshra immana ulemeheve (davar acher mageynea) alana keimma desharyay al benin, uvegin da la dachalin mikkol sitrin, veal da happores sukkat shalom alenu.

Ta chaze, beshaata deyisrael mevarchin umezammenin lehay sukkat shalom ushepiza kadisha veamre happores sukkat shalom, keden kedushata ilaa nachata uferisat gadfaha alayyhu deyisrael umechasya lon keimma al benin, vechol zinin bishin itkannishu mealma, veyatve yisrael techot kedushata demarehon, ucheden da sukkat shalom yahiv nishmatin chadtin livnaha, may taama begin debeh nishmatin sharyayn (sefer acher dichden zeman ziuuga venittelet nishmatin uvah sharyayn) uminneh nafkin. vechevan desharya uferisat gadfaha al benaha. arikat nishmatin chadtin lechol chad vechad.

Tu amar rabbi shimon al da tanenan shabbat dugema dealma deate ihu, hachi hu vadday, veal da shemita veyovel dugema da beda. veshabbat vealma deate hachi hu. vehahu tosefet denishmeta meraza dezachur ka atya al hay sukkat shalom denatil mealma deate veda tosefet yahavat lealmma kaddisha. uvehahu tosefet chadan veyitneshe minnayyhu kol millin dechol vechol tzaarin vechol akin kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom haniach Adonai lecha meatzbecha umeragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha vegomer.

Uvelelya deshabbatta bae bar nash leatama mikkolla, begin leachazaa dehay sukkat shalom mikkolla itkelilat, uvilvad dela yafgim mechla chada leyoma, veit deamre teren, litren seudate ochoranin deyoma, veshappir. vechol shekken i salik yattir leyoma veyachil lemitam mimmechlin ochoranin velizire bitre tavshilin sagya, veukemuha chavraya.

Ner shel shabbat linshe amma kaddisha ityeyhivat leadlaka, vechavrayay ha amru deihi kibbeta botzina dealma veachashichat leh kulei veshappir. aval raza demilla. hay sukkat shalom matronita dealma hi venishmatin deinnun botzina illaa bah sharyayn. veal da matronita baaya leadlaka, deha beduchetaha itachdat vaavadat ovada.

Veitteta baaya bechedva delibba ureuta leadlaka botzina deshabbat, deha yekara illaa hi lah uzechu rav legarmah lemizke livnin kaddishin dihon botzina dealma beorayyta uvedachalta, veyisgon shelama beara, vihevat levaalah orka dechayyin, begin kach baaya leizdahara bah.

Ta chaze, shabbat lelya veyoma zachor veshamor ihu kechada, veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekadsho uchetiv shamor et yom hashshabbat, zachor lidchura shamor lenukeva vecholla chad. zakkain innun yisrael chulakeh dekudesha berich hu adveh veachasanteh alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elokav.
Zohar, Chayei Sara 17: Ta chaze, kamma atrin metukanin leh lekudesha berich hu behahu alma, uvechullehu be motve lon latztzaddikim. kol chad vechad lefum dargeh kedka chaze leh.

Ketiv, (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha, dekudesha berich hu kariv lon legabbeh desalkin inun nishmatin mittatta leela uleitachada beachsantehon deittaknan lehu. yishkon chatzerecha, illen atrin vedargin levar, uman inun, kema deat amer (zecharya 3:7) venatatti lecha mahlechim ben haomdim haelle. vehay hu darga ben kaddishin illain.
Uman dezakkain ledarga da, inun shelichan demare alma keinun malachin veavdin shelichuta tadir biruta demarihon, begin deillen (itkaddashu) tadir bikdushsha vela istaavu.

Kegavvna da, man deistaav behay alma ihu mashich aleh ruach mesaav, vechad nafak nishmateh minneh mesaavin leh umedoreh ben inun mesaavin veillen inun mazzikin dealma. kema deitmeshach bar nash garmeh behay alma hachi hu medoreh veitmeshach behahu alma (59 veinnun ruchi misave mesaavin leh veoolin leh laggehinnam.)

Ta chaze man deitkaddash venatir garmeh behay alma dela istaav. medoreh behahu alma ben inun kaddishin illain veavdin shelichuta tadir, veillen kayyme bachatzer kema deat amer, (Shemot 27:9) et chatzar hammishkan.

Veit ochoranin deinun lego yattir, delav inun bachatzer ella beveta kema deat amer, (Tehillim 65:5) nisbea betuv betecha. amar david nisbea betuv betecha, kevan deamar yishkon chatzerecha, ammay ketiv nisbea betuv betecha, yisba betuv betecha mibbae leh kema dichtiv yishkon. ella ha taninan let yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilchudayyhu.

Veit atar lachaside elyonin deayyle lego, umay inun, kedichtiv, (Bamidbar 3:38) vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav vegomer. vechamma madorin al madorin unehorin al nehorin mitparshan behahu alma, vechol chad ichsif minnehora dechavreh, kema deovadin itparshan behay alma hachi name duchetin unehorin mitparshan behahu alma.

Veta chaze ha ittemar deafillu behay alma kad bar nash naim al arseh, venishmatin itzterichu leitshotta bealma venafku miggo gufa, lav kol nishmata venishmata salka veshatya lemechoze bikar sever appe deattik yomin, ella kema deitmeshich tadir uchefum ovade hachi nishmateh salka.

I istaav ihu naim venishmata nafka vechol inun ruchin mesaavin naktin lah veitdabbekat behu beinun dargin tattain deshatyayn bealma veinun modiin lah millin deinun kerevin lemete bealma, ulezimnin demodin lah millin kedivan vechayychan bah veha ukemuha.

Vei zache bar nash kad ihu naim, venishmateh salka azla veshatya uvaka ben illen ruchin mesaavin, vechullehu machrizin veamrin, pannun atar pannun, lav da missitrana, veihi salka ben inun kaddishin umodae lah milla chada dikshot.

Vechad nachata kol inun chavilin terikin baan leitkerava bahadah leminda hahi milla, veinun modain lah millin ochoranin, vehahi milla denatla go inun kaddishin ben inun ochoranin ihu keibbura go tivna. vehay (man ihu dezache yattir beod deihu kaim venishmeta kayyeyma behay alma.)

Kegavvna da kad nafkin nishmatin miggufa mehay alma, baan lesalka, vechamma tarin chavile tehirin kayyme, (6) i inun missitrayyhu kullehu achadin behu beinun nafshan umasre lon bida deduma leoola lon baggehinnam.

Ulevatar salkan veachadan behu veinun natle lehon umachreze behu illen inun deavru al pikkude demarehon, vechen shatyayn bechol alma. ulevatar mehaddere lehu laggehinnom, vechen ad teresar yarche. levatar teresar yarche mishtakkeche behahu atar deitchaze lon. inun nishmatin dezachu salke leela kema deittemar vezachan beduchetayyhu.

Ta chaze, zakkain inun tzaddikaya deitgeniz lehu kamma tavin lehahu alma, velet atar penimaa bechol inun keinun deyade raza demarehon veyade leitdabbeka behu bechol yoma, al illen ketiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatecha, yaase limchakke lo.

May limchakke lo, kema deat amer (iyyov 32:4) chikka et iyyov bidvarim. veillen inun dedachakin lemilla dechachmeta, vedayykin lah, umechakkan lah leminda berira demilla, veishtemoda lemarehon, illen inun demarehon mishtabbach behon bechol yoma, illen inun dealin ben illain kaddishin, veillen alin kol tare dilela velet man deyimche bidehon, zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, avraham al leminda uleitdabbeka bemareh kedka yaot levatar deakdim ovadoy bekadmita, vezacha beinun yomin illain, veitbarach meatar dechol birchan nafke mittamman, dichtiv vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. may bakkol. atar denahara dela paske memoy lealmin.

Amar ribbi chiyyay ta chaze, deavraham la baa leitarva binshe alma uleitdabbeka bishar amin ovde kochavim umazzalot, begin dinshayyay dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot inun saavin leguverayyhu uleinun demitdabbekin behon, begin dechad avraham yada chachmeta, yada ikra vesharsha umean atar nafke veshatyayn ruche mesaavin bealma, veal da ome leavdeh dela yissav itteta livreh mishshear ammin.
Zohar, Chayei Sara 19: Tanu rabbanan kol nishmatan shel tzaddikim lemala beeden hen. uma mimma sheyyored meeden yisge hachachma baolam, laomdim bo vnehenin mehanaotav vechissufav, al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak kevan shehanneshama zocha likkanes beshaare yerushalayim shel mala. michael hassar haggadol holech immah umakdim lah shalom. malache hashsharet temehim bo veshoalim aleha (Shir hashshirim 3:6) mi zot ola min hammidbar. mi zot ola ben haelyonim mehagguf hecharev sheddome lehevel dichtiv, (Tehillim 144:4) adam lahevel dama. hu meshiv veomer (Shir hashshirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati, achat hi meyuchedet hi. achat hi leimmah, leimmah zo hi kisse hakkavod shehi em lanneshama veyoledet lah shennigzera mimmenna.

Rauha banot vayashruha. ellu shear hanneshamot shehen bemaalatan lemala vehem hannikraot benot yerushalayim. amar rabbi yose ha chazarna al ma deamaran ellu nikraot benot yerushalayim, vehaacherot nikraot benot lot. rauha banot vayashruha. shear hanneshamot meshabbechot lah, veomrot shalom boech. melachot ufilaggeshim, melachot ellu haavot shehem melachot. ufilaggeshim, hen gere hatztzedek. kullam meshabbechot umekallesot otah ad shennichneset lemala, veazay hanneshama bemaalatah umitkayyeyma arichut hayyamim hada hu dichtiv veavraham zaken ba bayyamim. nichnas baarichut hayyamim laolam habba.

Rabbi abba sava kam al ragloy veamar, menucha veshalom garmin yehe lach rabbi shimon ben yochay dechazarat atara leyoshnah. detaninan bematnitta kadmaa dechevan shehanneshama hi betashlumah beatar illaa (lezimna batra alin) la tavat legufa, ella itberian minnah nishme ochoranin denafke minnah vihi ishtearat bekiyyuma, ad deata rabbi shimon ben yochay vedarash uma im baolam hazze shehu hevel vehagguf shehu tippa serucha nichneset bo otah hanneshama. leatid lavo sheyyitztzarfu kullam veyihye hagguf muvechar bekiyyum vetashlum yoter, eno din lehikkanes otah hanneshama bo bechol hattashlumin vhailluyin shebbah.

Amar rabbi acha otah hanneshama (bo bechol hattashlumin vhailluyin shebbah) mammash voto hagguf mammash atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehaamidan bekiyyuman leatid lavo, aval shenihem yihyu shelemim betashlum haddaat lehassig ma shello hissigu baolam hazze:

Veavraham zaken ba bayyamim vegomer. rabbi bo amar rabbi yochanan (beotam hayamim) beoto haolam shehu yamim, velo baolam hazze shehu layla. amar rabbi yaakov beotam haolamot shehem yamim beotam hahanaot vehakkissufin shehu nochel: vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. beoto hammisra (nusach acher hammaaser) shennatan lo hakkadosh baruch hu mishshemo, shehi ot hei, shebbo nivra haolam.

Vetanya amar rabbi yochanan metatron sar happanim shehu naar eved merabbo haadon hammoshel alav, memunne al hanneshama bechol yom lehasepik lah meoto haor shennitztzetavva, vhu atid lemesav chusheban pitka bevatte kivre min duma uleachazaa leh kamme mareh, vhu zammin lemebad chamir hahu garma techot ara letakkana legufayay ulekayyma lon bishlemuta degufa bela nishmata (bezimna) dekudesha berich hu yeshaddar lah leatrah.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak beotah shaa ma ketiv, vayyomer avraham el avdo zekan beto hammoshel vegomer. mahu el avdo, i bechachmeta da nistakkel mahu el avdo. amar rabbi nehoray lo nistakkel ella bamme sheamar avdo, avdo shel makom. (zaken beto) hakkarov laavodato, uman ihu, ze 314 kidkaamaran, deihu atid leyappot lagguf bevatte kivre.

Hada hu dichtiv vayyomer avraham el avdo, ze metatron avdo shel makom. (181 1) zekan beto, shehu techillat beriyyotav shel makom. hammoshel bechol asher lo, shennatan lo kudesha berich hu memshala al kol tzivotav.

Vetana amar rabbi shimon amar rabbi yose amar rav, kol tzivotav shel oto eved notlim or vnehenin mizziv hanneshama, detana or hanneshama laolam habba gadol meor hakkisse. vha mehakkisse nitla hanneshama. ella ze lefi harauy lo veze lefi harauy lo. rav nachman amar gadol meor hakkisse mammash dichtiv, (yechezkel 1:26) demut kemare adam alav milmala, may alav al zohoro.

Ucheshehu holech laasot shelichuto kol tzivotav vehammerkava shello nizzonin meoto hazzohar. hada hu shehanneshama omeret lo (dichtiv) sim na yadcha, kelomar siatcha, tachat yerechi, zehu or hannishpa min hanneshama alehem.

Amar rabbi yehuda berabbi shalom kach kibbalnu beshaa shezze holech bishlichuto shel makom, kudesha berich hu menia kol tzivotav shel mala beot achat mishmo. amar rav huna kach yerechi begimatriyya ram. kelomar hanneshama omeret sim na yadcha siatcha tachat maalato shel ram vnissa hammoshel al hakkol uleachar shetztzivva siat elyonim tachat yado ani mashbiacha shevua gedola bo.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak elohe hashshamayim vilohe haaretz. hoil veamar bAdonai shehu hakkol, lamma neemar elohe hashshamayim, amar rabbi yehuda shehu adon al hakkol, bevat achat uverega echad hu menia lakkol vechullam keayin negdo. rabbi yitztzechak omer al shetayim otiyyot mishshemo lehorot shehu hakkol ven acher bilto:

Veashbiacha baAdonai elohe hashshamayim vilohe haaretz. amar rav huna vei havina immehon demare matnitta kad gillu raza dena la ifrashna minnehon hachi, deha ana chaze amikin saggiin befumayyhu degalu vela itchazzeyayn lechol enish. ta chaze, shevuat keyayma da ome lah nishmata dichtiv asher lo tikkach ishsha livni.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak mehacha mashma shehoil veatta holech bishlichut ze lo tikkach ishsha livni, kelomar shello tikkach guf livni (davar acher labenayyney) likkanes beguf acher beguf zar beguf sheeno rauy lo, ella behahu mammash shehu shelli, behahu mammash sheyyatztzati mimmennu, hada hu dichtiv ki im el artztzi veel moladti telech.

Amar rabbi yose mahu velakachta ishsha livni leyitztzechak. amar rabbi yitztzechak oto hagguf shennitztzetaer immi beoto haolam, velo haya lo hanaa vechissuf bo mippene yirat kono, oto hagguf mammash tikkach litztzechak immo behay simchat hatztzaddikim. litztzachek immo besimchat hakkadosh baruch hu, litztzachek immo deachshav et sechok baolam hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 126:2) az yimmale sechok pinu vegomer.

Amar rabbi yehuda bar yitztzechak ta shema en malach echad ose ela shelichut echad, velo 2 shelichut bevat achat. vetanya amar rabbi abba malach echad asher keset hassofer bematnav atid lehareshim kol echad veechad al mitztzecho, uleachar ken hassar haggadol holech letakken kol echad veechad ulehaamido lekabbel nishmato, hada hu dichtiv hu yishlach malacho lefanecha velakachta ishsha, may lefanecha lifne shelichutecha.
Rabbi (elazar) eliezer azal lemecheme lerabban yochanan ben zakkay rabbeh, vhahu yoma resh yarcha hava, kad mata gabbeh
Amar leh chayyayv adam lehakebil pene rabbo. amar leh lav al kach amarit. ella ana chame beanpach demilla chadta it gabbach meinun amikim deat atid lemitba.

Amar leh, chamena hay or harishon dematlanoy asara uvaasara natil, uveraza daasara nahig lecholla, uveatvavta daasara avid ovadoy. vetana asara pitkin asara maftechan deve katztzere bidoy, ufitkin asara natil beginta deeden leatkana ara al gufehon detztzaddikayya.

Amar leh eliezer beri chamit havit yattir mimmalacha kaddisha dealma, baasara itbere, baasara itnehig. baasara kurseyay kaddisha, baasara orayyta, hu baasara matlanoy, baasara almin illain (baasara) vechad illaa al kolla berich hu.

Veema lach milla dateh demare dematnitta hava behay ma ketiv vayyikkach haeved asara gemallim miggemalle adonav vayyilech. amar leh ribbi zachina lifsuka da, aval vechol tuv adonav beyado mahu. amar leh hu shemeh demareh deazil gabbe leaala leh uleanhaga (uleaggana) leh, amar da vadday hu ki shemi bekirbo.

Tenan amar ravi abbahu ta chaze, man deyada shemeh al bureyeh, yada dehu ushemeh chad hu, kudesha berich hu ushemeh chad dichtiv, (zecharya yad) Adonai echad vegomer (kullehu) kelomar hashshem vehu echad.

Amar rabbi abba it leistakkala befarshata da: vayyavrech haggemallim michutz lair el beer hammayim. amar rabbi abba michutz lair, da hu be kivre. el beer hammayim, detanya hannikdamim bevatte kivre otam shennasu venatnu battora, deha tenan keshennichnas adam lakkever ma deshaalu leh techilla im kava ittim lattora dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:6) vhaya emunat ittecha vegomer. uchesheyyetztze eno din (lakeyymam) lahakimam battechilla.

Amar rabbi abba leet erev zehu yom shishshi shehu erev hashshabbat sheaz hazzeman lekayyma metayyay, may mashma ditnan shitta alfe shenin havi alma, vhu elef hashshishshi shehu siyyum hakkol, vehayeynu leet erev, zeman siyyum hakkol. leet tzet hashshoavot, ellu hem talmide chachamim hashshoavim memeha shel tora shehu et latztzet ulehitnaer min heafar.

Veamar rabbi abba od yish ladaat ditnan otam hammitassekim ladaat et boram baolam hazze venishmatam betashlumah laolam habba zachu latztzet mishshevuot hanneshama holech ladaat mi hu gufah mammash umay hu. hinne anochi nitztzav al en hammayim af al gav shettalmid chacham hu holech achar hattashlum, dichtiv vehaya haalma hayyotztzet lishov veamarti eleha hashekini na meat mayim mikkaddech emor li remez yediato mimma shehissagta.
Veamra elay gam atta shete, af atta eved (kamocha) kamoni velo nitchallef li (al) yediatcha bidiato shel makom baruch hu, vetztzarich atta lehassig sheatta nivra kamoni.

Vegam ligmallecha eshav, kelomar yediat hassagati shelo hissigu siatcha, veyadati ki maala yish li alecha vheach nivra atta mizziv hannatun etztzelcha. im hu omer siman ze yehi masur beyadi al kol devarim ellu, veeda shehi haishsha hu hagguf meotah hanneshama hashshevua shehishbiani:

Vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vegomer. ribbi yitztzechak amar ribbi yehuda beod shekkol hainyaynim hu rotztze lenassot al hagguf, may ketiv vehinne rivka yotztzet, zehu hagguf kadosh shennitassak bedivre tora vechittet gufo lehassig veladaat et kono. asher yalda livtuel, amar rav yehuda bitto shel el. ben milka, ben malkah shel olam. eshet nachor achi avraham. chevrat hassechel guf shennidbak bassechel vehi ach hanneshama. vechaddah al shichmah, massa hachachma aleha.

Vyyaratz haeved likratah. ze 314. vayyomer haggemiini na meat mayim mikkaddech, emor li remez chachmata bidiat borech mimma sheasakt baolam sheyyatztzat mimmennu. amar ribbi abba kidfarshinan, achar kol ze ma ketiv vasim hannezem al appah vehatztzemidim al ydeha. amar rabbi abba otam haatztzamot shennifzeru lechan ulechan, hu tzomed otam veshoklam ze al ze kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 58:11) veatztzemotecha yachlitz. amar ribbi abba beotah shaa oto hagguf omed beeretz yisrael vesham nichnas bo nishmato.

Amar ribbi yochanan mi molich hagguf leeretz yisrael, amar ribbi zera kudesha berich hu ose mechilot tachat haaretz vehem mitgalgelim veholchim leeretz yisrael hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) vertz refaim tappil.

Amar ribbi yitztzechak gavriel molich otam leeretz yisrael, mena lan dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:58) hatelchi im haish hazze, uchetiv hatam (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel. amar ribbi yose may dichtiv ulerivka ach ushemo lavan. amar rabbi yitztzechak en yitztzer hara batel min haolam, af al pi shekkullo lo nimtztza ketztzato nimtztza.

Ta chaze, battechilla keshehaya mutal baolam hazze nikra lot, laolam habba (yibbadel) yibbatel min haolam, aval (leatid lavo) lo kullo, vnikra lavan lo menuval kevarishona ella keman desache minniuulo. lavan lemay itztzetrich. amar rabbi shimon lemebad periyya ureviyya itztzetrich, deamar rabbi shimon im en yetztzer hara nimtztza, periyya ureviyya eno matztzuy.
Ta shema kevan shehagguf nivna veomed bekiyyumo, may ketiv vayshallechu et rivka achotam vegomer. may (have) veet meniktah, ze koach hattenua. ribbi yitztzechak amar ze koach hagguf.

Ribbi abbahu patach behay kera (Shir hashshirim 4:8) itti millevanon kalla itti millevanon tavoi vegomer, amar ribbi abbahu kevan shehagguf nivne al kiyyumo umeviin oto lekabbel nishmato leeretz yisrael, hanneshama mamtenet elav veyotztzet likrato kema deat amer vayyetztze yitztzechak lasuach bassade. hada hu dichtiv itti millevanon kalla. zo hi hanneshama. tashuri merosh amana, hayeynu dichtiv vayyissa enav vayyar.
Amar rabbi yehuda im hi hanneshama, tenach avraham kidkaamaran, aval yitztzechak mahu. amar rabbi abbahu ha chavrayyay amru deachshav itkere yitztzechak al shum chedvavta saggia divalma.

Amar rabbi abbahu battechilla nikret hanneshama avraham vehagguf sara, achshav nikret hanneshama yitztzechak vehagguf rivka. tenan bematnitin, amar rabbi shimon arbaim shana kodem kiyyum hagguf mamtenet hanneshama lagguf beeretz yisrael. beeze makom bemakom hammikdash.
Amar rabbi abbahu ta chaze, vayyikkach et rivka vattehi lo leishsha vayyeehaveha vayyinnachem yitztzechak achare immo. ohev leoto hagguf umitnachem immo, vhu et lischok vehachedva baolam.
Amar ribbi yehuda ha kol parshata da itberar lan, aval la yachilna leminda mahu: vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura. uleshikkula dedata kol parshata da listure.
Kad ata rav dimi, amar, hay parshata da shamana vela idkarna, amru deillain takkifin la zimnuha legallaa vanan may nema. kam ribbi yehuda veamar mimtivta dechavrana mare matnitta galya.

Kamu veazlu hu vribbi yisa veribbi chiyyay, ashkechuha leribbi elazar beribbi shimon vehava megalle razin ditfillin. alu kammeh veamru bemay itassak mar. amar lon tama ditfillin amina, deha zakkaa hu bar nash demanach tefillin veyada tama didhu.

Amru i nicha kammeh demar lema lan milla. amru shemana meavuch dekudesha berich hu birchimu saggia dehava leh im yisrael amar lon lemebad leh be mashkena kegavvna dirticha illaa dilela veyete diyyureh immehon hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham. veshamana meavuch dehacha satim tama ditfillin behay pesuka.

Amar leh ta chazi, kegavvna illaa itavad mikdash birtichoy kaddishin, uvatar ken ashre kudesha berich hu diyyureh immehon, keinyayna da, uchegavvna da itaru chavrayyay mare matnitta betama ditfillin, lemehevi hahu gavra dugema dirtiche illain, reticha tattaa reticha illaa, lemete malchuta dileh veyashre diyyureh ilavi.

Vetaninan it beh razin illain vedugemehon, veit beh telat retichin, dugemat illain kaddishin razin ditlat atvavta dishmahan kaddishe, almin telat, retichin telata atvavta, arba parashiyyot shallit al arba, veal kach raza deshyn ditlat kitrin, 366 dearba kitrin, telata melachin shallitin begufa tefillin aloy kudesha berich hu leela, illen tefillin deresha, tefillin didroa arba parashiyyayn.

Libba rachiv dugema dirticha tattaa vetattaa rachiv. od taninan da rechiva didroa letatta. velibba rachiv, dugema deihu letatta veitmasserun bideh leaalaa lon kol chele shemaya, kach libba hu rachiv letatta vitmasseru bidoy kol evre gufa.

Veela minnih arba parashiyyayn al mocha deresha ihu, aval kudesha berich hu shallita illaa malka mikkolla. (veruach) vraza dechachmeta da, hu kegavvna demakdesha dichtiv vaase keruv echad mikkatztza mizze ucheruv echad mikkatztza. vealayyhu diyyureh demalka bearba atvavn teren retichin.

Uchehay gavvna libba umocha, libba mikkan umocha mikkan vealayyhu medoreh dekudesha berich hu bearba (davar acher arba) parashiyyayn. amar rabbi elazar mikkan ulehala raze dechitre atvavta ufarashiyyayn begufayyhu uretztzuotehon. halacha lemoshe missinay uremiza dilhon itgeli vetama decholla bitlat eser mechilan (derachame).

Amar ribbi yehuda ilmale la atena ella bedil raza da dayyay. amru leh zakkaa chulakach lealma deate dechol raz la anis lach. amru leh atena kammeh demar leminda raza dehay pesuka vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura.

Amar perusha dehay pesuka kema degalu chavrana mare matnitin, dechad nishmata yete behahu gufa kaddisha dilah, ha milayyay havu al chayyayvaya dikumun vyichsherun ovadin veyitten lehu mizziva yekara dileh deyindeun vituvun veyizkun zechuta shelemata.

Vechad chama shelomo da hava sagge (davar acher tave saggi) veamar (Kohelet 8:10) uvechen raiti reshaim kevurim vvau umimkom kadosh yehallechu, sheyyavou veyichyu mimkom kadosh. vtaninan amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan ketiv, (yirmeya 3) hayahafoch kushi oro venamer chavarburotav, kach harshaim shelo zachu lashuv baolam hazze ulehaktir maasim tovim laolam, lo yaktiru baolam habba. ree ma ketiv vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha, vesherotztze laasot lahem neshama legufam ulekarvam bitshuva, kema deat amer veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan.

Amar ribbi elazar ta chaze, ma ketiv vteled lo et zimran veet yakshan, harebe maasim raim ad shennigrashim min haolam dichtiv vayshallechem meal yitztzechak beno. vaalehem neemar (Daniel 12:2) verabbim mishene admat afar yakitztzu vegomer, veal haacherim neemar vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia vegomer.

Amar ribbi yehuda hay mashma al parshata, umashma deoto zeman (nikra) (sefer acher avad) avad shem (hanneshama) avraham, uvimkomo nikret ytztzechak kidkaamaran, hada hu dichtiv vyhi achare mot avraham vayvarech elohim et yitztzechak beno, vayyishev yitztzechak im beer lachay roi. im yediat hachay shehu chay haolamim ladaat ulehassig ma shelo hissig baolam hazze hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:9) ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai, (ad kan midrash hannelam)

Ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Kohelet 12:7) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu laadam, natal afareh meatar demakdesha, uvana gufeh mearba sitrin dealma, dechullehu yahavu leh chela, levatar itrak aleh rucha dechayye kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim vegomer levatar kam veyada deihu meela vetatta, ucheden itdabbak veyada chachma illaa.

Kegavvna da kol bar nash dealma ihu kalil meela vetatta, vechol inun deyadin leitkaddesha behay alma kedka yeut, kad olidu bar, mashchin aleh ruach kaddisha meatar dechol kaddishe nafkin minneh, veillen ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu begin degufa itavid bikdusha kedka yaot, hachi name yahavin leh rucha meatar illaa kaddisha kedka chaze veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, beshata dezammin bar nash lemehav chusheban ovadoy ad la yippuk mealma, hahu yoma, yoma dechusheban ihu, degufa venishmata yahave chushebna. levatar nishmata itparsha mineh, vegufa tav leara, vecholla tav leatreh deitnasiv mittamman veha ukemuha, ad zimna dekudesha berich hu zammin laachayay metayay kolla ganiz kammeh.

Vehahu gufa mammash vehahi nishmata mammash zammin kudesha berich hu leatava lealma kemillekadmin ulechadta anpe alma hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun. vehahi nishmata mammash geniza kamme kudesha berich hu vetavat leatrah kefum archaha kema deat amer veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. ulezimna dezammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayay, zammin ihu learaka talla merisheh alayyhu, uvehahu talla yekumun kolla meafra.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) ki tal orot tallecha. may tal orot, orot mammash meinun nehorin dilela divhon zammin laaraka chayyin lealma, begin deilana dechayye yarik chayyin dela paskin lealmin, deha hasheta paskin begin deha chivya bisha shalta veitkasse sihara. uvegin kach kivyachol paskin memoy vechayyin la shaltin bealma kedka yeut.

Uvehahu zimna hahu yetzer hara deihu chivya visha yistallak mealma veyaavar leh kudesha berich hu kema deittemar (zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz. ulevatar deihu yitavar mealma, sihara la itkasya, venahara denagid venafik la yippaskun mabbuoy, ucheden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim vegomer.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya i tema dechol gufin dealma yekumun veyitarun meafra, inun gufe deitnetiu benishmata chada ma tehe minnayyhu. amar rabbi yose inun gufin dela zachu vela atzlachu hare inun kela havu, kema dehavu etz yavesh behahi alma hachi name behahu zimna, vegufa batraa deitneta veatzlach venatal sharashoy kedka yeut yakum.

Vealeh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:8) vehaya keetz shatul al mayim vegomer vehaya alehu raanan vegomer. deavad ibbin venata sharashin veatzlach kedka yeut. veal hahu gufa kadmaa dela avad ibbin vela nata sharashin (velo zacha velo atzlach) ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:6) vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov vegomer. ki yavo tov da techiyyayt hammetim.

Veyitnehir hahu nehora dezammin leanhara lehu letzaddikayya dehava ganiz kammeh miyyoma deitbere alma dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. ucheden zammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayay, uchetiv, (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka vegomer, ucheden yitgabbar tov bealma, vehahu deitkere ra yitavar mealma kidamaran. ucheden inun gufin kadmae lehevo kella havu.

Amar ribbi yitzchak zammin kudesha berich hu laaraka alayyhu al inun gufin ruchin ochoranin, vei zachan behon yekumun bealma kedka yeut, vei lav yehon kitma techot raglehon detzaddikaya dichtiv (Malachi 3), uchetiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim mishene admat afar yakitzu vegomer. vecholla ittakam veitattad kamme kudesha berich hu, vechullehu beminyayna havu kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam vegomer.

Ta chaze, ha ittemar kol inun metin divara deyisrael yekumun bekadmita, begin dekudesha berich hu yitar alayyhu veyokim lon, alayyhu ketiv yichyu metecha, illen inun di veara deyisrael. nevelati yekumun, illen inun divgo aran ochoranin, dela ketiv behu techiyyay ella kima. deha rucha dechayye la tishre ella beara kaddisha deyisrael, uvegin kach ketiv behu yichyu metecha, veinun dilvar, yitbere gufa dilhon vikumun gufa bela rucha. ulevatar yitgalgelun techot afra ad deyimtun leeretz yisrael, vetamman yekabbelun nishmata, vela birshu ochora, begin deyitkayyeymun bealma kedka chaze.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yesa havu yatve lelya chad veaske beorayyta. amar ribbi elazar ta chaze, beshata dekudesha berich hu zammin laachayay metayay, kol inun nishmatin deyitarun kammeh kullehu kayymin diukenin diukenin kammeh behahu diukena mammash dehavu behay alma, venachit lon kudesha berich hu, veyikre lon bishmahan kema deat amer, (yeshaya noach) lechullam beshem yikra. vechol nishmata teol leduchetaha, vikumun bekiyyuma bealma kedka chaze, ucheden yehe alma shelim, veal hahu zimna ketiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) vecherfat ammo yasir vegomer, may vecherpat ammo yasir. da yetzer hara deachshich anpe biryayn veshallit behu.

Amar ribbi yose ha chaminan kol zimna devar nash kaim berucha da. lav ihu mesaav, nafka nishmateh minneh ihu mesaav. amar leh vadday hachi hu, vehachi ittemar deha hahu yetzer hara kad natil rucha devar nash saiv leh veishtaar gufa mesaav, ushear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot kad inun bechayyehon inun mesaavin deha missitra missaava it lon nishmatin, vechad itrik minneh hahu mesaavu ishtaar gufa bela mesaavu kelal.

Begin kach man deitdabbak beitteta dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot istaav ihu. vehahu bera deityelid leh yekabbel aleh ruach mesaava. vei tema ha besitra deavoy miyyisrael ka atya, ammay yekabbel aleh ruach mesoova. ta chaze, deha bekadmita istaav avoy beshata deitdabbak behahi itteta deihi mesoova, vechevan deav ihu istaav behahi itteta deihi mesoova, kol shekken deihu bera deityelid minnah yekabbel aleh ruach mesoova. vela od ella deavar al orayyta dichtiv, (Shemot la) ki lo tishtachave leel acher, ki Adonai kanna shemo begin dekanne al hay berit kaddisha.
Zohar, Chayei Sara 22: Ta chaze, vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vehinne rivka yotzet. yotzet, baa mibbae leh, may yotzet. dekudesha berich hu appik lah mikkol inun bene mata dechullehu chayyayvin, vehi yotzet mikkelala dilhon. vattered haayna ketiv beHei, raza ihu deiarat tamman bera demiryam, uvegin kach ketiv haayna beHei useliku lah maya.
Davar acher vehinne rivka yotzet kema dichtiv yotzot lishov mayim, ammay yotzot velo holchot velo vaot. ella begin ditmirin havu kol yoma uvehahi shata nafkin leshaava maya, vesimana nakit bideh.

Ta chaze, kad mata avda lecharan veashkach lah lerivka leet erev hava idan tzelota demincha. behahi shata demata yitzchak letzallaa tzelota demincha, behahi shata mata avda legabbah derivka. uvehahi shata demata yitzchak litzlota demincha kemilkaddemin matat rivka legabbeh. leishtakkacha kolla beatreh deitzterich kedka yeut, vecholla mata beraza dechachmeta, veal da ata hahu avda liver hammayim raza dichtiv (Shir hashshirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon, veokimna, vecholla raza ihu.
Zohar, Chayei Sara 23: Ribbi shimon hava ate litverya vehava immeh ribbi abba. amar ribbi shimon leribbi abba nizil, deha anan chamenan devar nash chad yimte hasheta legabban umillin chadtin befumeh veinun millin deorayyta. amar ribbi abba ha yedana debchol atar demar azil, kudesha berich hu meshadder leh malachin tasin begadfin leishtashea beh.

Ad dehavu azle, salik ribbi shimon enoy, vechama bar nash dehava rahit veazil. yatvu ribbi shimon veribbi abba. kad mata gabbayyhu, amar leh ribbi shimon man ant. amar leh yuday ana umikkappotkiyya kaatina veana azilna atitreh devar yochay deitmannun chavraya bemillin yedian veshadderuni gabbeh. amar leh ema beri. amar leh ant bar yochay. amar leh ana bar yochay.

Amar leh ha okimna dela yafsik bar nash bitzloteh beneh leven kotla kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vegomer. uman detzalle asir lemeevar arba ammot samich leh, veukemuha lehanne arba ammot lechol setar bar lekammeh. veukemuha dela yitzle bar nash achore rabbeh vechulei veitmannun bechol hanne mile.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 39:13) shima tefillati Adonai veshavati haazina el dimati al techorash. may tama shima vela shema, beatar chad ketiv shema Adonai vechanini vegomer, uveatar ochora shima. ella bechol atar lezimnin shema lidchura ulezimnin shima lenukeva. shima kema deat amer, (Tehillim 17:1) shima Adonai tzedek vegomer. shema kema deat amer, (Tehillim 30:11) shema Adonai vechaneni. (Mishlei 1) shema beni. (Devarim 27:9) haseket ushema.

Vehacha shima tefillati Adonai, begin dehay (deihu) darga dimkabbela kol tzelotin dealma. veha taninan deavda minnayyhu atara veshavve lah beresha detzaddik chay olamim dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:6) berachot lerosh tzaddik. veal da shima tefillati Adonai.

Shima tefillati Adonai da tzelota di velachash. veshavati haazina da tzelota dearim bar nash kaleh beakteh kema deat amer, (Shemot 2:23) vattaal shavatam el haelohim. umahu shavatam, ella devitzloteh arim kaleh vezakif enoy leela kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 22:5) veshoa el hahar. utzelota da metabbar tarin vedafik (saavadechayk) lon leaala tzeloteh. el dimati al techorash da, ail kamme malka velet tara dekaim kammeh, uleolam la ahadaru dimin berekanya.
Tu ha ketiv hacha telat dargin, tefilla. shava. dima. lokovel illen telat ochoranin. ki ger anochi immach. levatar toshav. levatar kechol avotay ikra dealma.

Ta chaze, tzelota devar nash meomed, begin ditre tzelota ninhu chad mioshshev vechad meomed, veinun chad lokovel teren dargin tefilla shel yad utefilla shel rosh. legabbe yom valayla vecholla chad. uf hacha tefilla mioshshev legabbe tefilla shel yad, leatkin lah kema (davar acher keman) deatkin lechalla vekashit lah leaala lechuppa, hachi name mekashtin lah beraza dirtichaa umashshiryayha, yotzer meshartim vaasher meshartav vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh vechulei.

Veal da tzelota meyushshav, kevan deoolat legabbe malka illaa veihu ate lekabbela lah, keden anan kayymin kamme malka illaa, deha keden (darga) dechura itchabbar benukeva, uvegin kach la yafsik ben geulla litfilla (ugeula (Shemot 157 1), utefilla teren dargin inun, raza detzaddik vatzedek 156 244).

Uvegin devar nash kaim kamme malka illaa natal arba ammot litzloteh veukemuha divshiura (davar acher basheyavarea) desureta deyotzer kolla. vechol ma deate besitra didchura bae leh leinish lemekam vekiyyumeh veizdakkaf (sefer acher vayzadekaf). kegavvna da kad ihu korea, korea bevaruch, vechad ihu zakif, zakif bashshem, begin leachazaa shevacha didchura al nukeva.

Veta chaze deha ukemuha la yitzle bar nash achore rabbeh veittemar kema dichtiv, (Devarim 10:20) et Adonai elokecha tira. et leachlala devae lemidchal merabbeh kemora dishchinta, udechilu detalmid, rabbeh ihu. begin kach beshata ditzlota la yashve hahu mora lekammeh, (davar acher 33 litzlota) ella mora dekudesha berich hu bilchodoy vela mora ochora.
