Veta chaze tzelota demincha atkin leh yitzchak. vadday kema deatkin avraham tzelota detzafra lokovel hahu darga deitdabbak beh. vechen (davar acher kach) yitzchak atkin tzelota demincha lokovel hahu darga deitdabbak beh. veal da tzelota demincha mechi nate shimsha lenachata bedargoy listar maarav.

Deha ad la nata shimsha letzad maarav ikre yom mitztzafra ad hahu zimna dichtiv, (tehillim 22) chesed el kol hayyom. vei tema ad chashecha, ta chaze, dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy na lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev. ki fana hayyom lokovel tzelota detzafra dichtiv chesed el kol hayyom, deha keden shimsha ihu listar mizrach, kevan denata shimsha venachata listar maarav, ha keden ihu zeman tzelota demincha uchevar pana hayyom veatu tzille arev veitar dina kashya bealma.

Ufana hayyom deihu darga dechesed, venatu tzille arev deinun darga dedina kashya, ucheden itcharav be makdesha veittokad hechala. veal da taninan dihe var nash zahir bitzlota demincha deihu zimna dedina kashya sharyay bealma.
Yaakov atkin tzelota dearvit deha ihu atkin lah vezan lah bechol ma deitzterich, vadday vav atkin leh, veh ittezanat min vav delet lah nehora miggarmah kelal.

Uvegin kach tefillat arvit reshut deha itkelilat bitzlota deyoma begin leitnahara, vehasheta lav zimna ihu. veokimna lah deha la itgalya nehora dimama deyanhir lah, veihi shalta bachashocha ad zimna defalgut lelya deishtasha kudesha berich hu im tzaddikaya beginta deeden, ucheden ihu zimna leishtashea bar nash (sefer acher ulemile) beorayyta kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, david ata veamar illen telat zimnin ditzlote dichtiv, (Tehillim 55:18) erev vavoker vetzohorayim ha telata, veihu la tzalle ella tere minnayyhu, dichtiv asicha veeheme, vela yattir. da litzlota detzafra veda litzlota demincha, begin kach asicha veehme dayyka. betzafra deihu shata dechesed sagge leh bechesed beasicha, uvemincha dehu shata dedina kashya bae hamayay uvegin kach veehme. ulevatar kad itpelig lelya hava kam beshirin vetushebchan kedka yaot dichtiv, (tehillim 62) uvallayla shiro immi veha ittemar.

Kam rabbi shimon veazlu. azal hahu var nash bahadeh ad teverya. ad dehavu azlu, amar ribbi shimon ta chaze, tefillot keneged temidin tiknum rabbanan deanshe keneset haggedola, begin deashkechan tere dichtiv, (Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves echad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim. veinun mitkarvin behanne tere zimne deyoma deinun zimnin litzlota.
Amar hahu gavra ha bekadmita avot tiknum lehanni tzelote, uma deatkinu avraham veyitzchak hu ikra, uma deatkin yaakov deihu shevacha deavahan ammay ihu reshut vela ikkera kehanne.

Amar ribbi shimon ha (229 b) ittemar. aval ta chaze, hanni tere zimne ditre tzelote lav inun ella lechabbera leyaakov beadveh, kevan deitchabbaru da beda anan la tzerichin yattir, dechevan deityehivat itteta ben teren deroin veitchabbarat begufa la itzterich yattir, veal da anan bainan leitara teren deroin begin deityehivat benayyhu, kevan deihi benayyhu, gufa veitteta millayyhu bilchishu dela leadkara.

Uvegin kach yaakov meshammesh bammarom taninan. may bammarom kema deat amer, (Tehillim 92:9) veatta marom leolam Adonai. vecholla ihu raza leyade middin. atu ribbi abba vehahu yuday uneshaku yedoy. amar ribbi abba ad yoma den la kaimna bemilla da bar hasheta. zakkaa chulaki dezachina lemishma leh:
Zohar, Chayei Sara 8: Midrash hanneelam vayyihyu. rabbanan patche behay kera, (Shir hashshirim 7:12) lecha dodi netztze hassade nalina bakkefarim. tanu rabbanan hayyotztze ladderech yitpallel shalosh tefillot, tefilla shehi chova shel yom. utefillat hadderech al hadderech shehu ose. utefilla sheyyachzor leveto leshalom. velema lehu lehanne shelosha, afillu beechad yachil lemebedeh, detaninan kol sheelotav shel adam yachil lemichlelinhu beshomea tefilla.

Amar rabbi yehuda kol ovadoy devar nash ketivin besifra, hen tav hen bish, veal kullehon atid lemittan dina, detaninan amar rav yehuda amar rav, may dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:16) galmi rau enecha, otam haddevarim sheasa haggolem sheeno mashgiach baolam habba, kullam rau enecha sheiyyaynta bahem. veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu, litten alehem din vcheshbon laolam habba, hilkach yakdim adam tefillato tamid veyoil leh.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak en adam ose averot ella mi shehu golem vlo adam, vehayeynu hahu dela mistakkal benishmata kaddisha, ella kol ovadoy kehay beira dela mashgachat vela yadat. amar rabbi bo, vechi golem mitkere davd deamar hay pesuka. amar lo rabbi yitztzechak adam harishon amaro, galmi rau enecha, kodem shezzarakta bi neshama, rau enecha lemebad bidyokni bene nasha dedamu li. veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu, man inun. yamim yutztzaru, kehay tzura didi. velo echad bahem dela ishtaar chad minnehon.

Amar rabbi bo, lamma. amar leh ta chaze, kullehu dedamu leh o birmiza dileh, la metu bemitat nafshehon, vechullehu laku behahu inyayna mammash. ta chaze, amar rabbi yehuda diukeneh deadam harishon veshappiruteh hava kezahara dirkia illaa deal gabbe shear rekie, uchehahu nehora deganiz kudesha berich hu letztzaddikayyay lealma deate, vechol inun dehavu remiza beh midiukeneh deadam harishon beh laku umitu.

Dechach orchoy dekudesha berich hu, yahiv utera levar inish, lamma, lemezan anayin ulemebad pikkudoy. la avid hay vitgae (vei itgalya beh) behahu utera, beh yilke dichtiv, (Kohelet Adonai:12) osher shamur livalav leraato. yahiv leh benin, lamma, lemelaf lehu orchoy dekudesha berich hu, ulemitar pikkudoy kidamur beavraham (Bereshit 18:19) ki yedativ lemaan asher yetztzavve et banav veet beto acharav veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka vegomer. la avid hay umitgae behu, behu lake dichtiv, (iyyov 18:19) lo nin lo velo neched beammo vegomer. vechen kehay gavvna kad yahiv kudesha berich hu mishappiruta tava illaa deadam harishon lehu, lamma, begin lemitar pikkudoy ulemebad reuteh, la avdu keden ella itgau beh. beh laku behay shappiruta.

Amar rav yehuda, kad bara kudesha berich hu adam harishon, hava golem ad la zarik beh nishmata, vekara lehahu malacha dehu memunne al diukena divne nasha, veamar lo ayyen vetztzor bediukena deden shitta beni nesha, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:3) vayyolled bidmuto ketztzalmo vayyikra et shemo shet, kelomar shitta.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak mehahu afra mammash deitbere adam harishon nasiv kudesha berich hu leitberaa illen shitta, vekara leh shet, shitta, hada hu dichtiv vayyoled bidmuto ketztzallemo meotah haisa shennivra haggolem shello, veal kach neemar galmi rau enycha veiyaynt bo laasot (davar acher 33 bo) dedamu leh. veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu, man inun, kullehu dela natru may deyahav kudesha berich hu lon veittardu min alma (veitdanu behahu dina).

Tenan hatam amar rav yehuda amar rav ashkachna ditlat mitran havi lelya, vechol chad vechad it inyayna dekudesha berich hu bevar nash. kad nafik nishmateh minneh vishtaar hahu golma naim al arseh, venishmateh salka bechol lelya kamme kudesha berich hu, amar rabbi yitztzechak i zakkaa hi chadan imma, vei la dachyayn lah levar. amar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim Adonai:8) hishbati etchem benot yerushalami im timtztzeu et dodi ma taggidu lo shecholat ahava ani.

Amar rabbi pinchas amar rabbi yehuda hishbati etchem benot yerushalam, hanneshama omeret leotam hanneshamot hazzochot likkanes lirushalam shel mala, vhem hannikraot benot yerushalami al shezzochot likkanes sham, ulefichach hanneshama omeret lahem hishbati etchem benot yerushalami im timtztzeu et dodi da kudesha berich hu. rav amar ze ziv aspaklarya shel mala. ma taggidu lo shecholat ahava ani, lehanot mizziv shello ulehistofef betztzillo. rav huna amar shecholat ahava ani, otah hatteshuka vehakkissuf shekkasafti baolam al hakkol lefichach ani chola. rabbi yehuda amar zo ahava sheohevet hanneshama lagguf, dechevn shennishlam kitztzo shel guf otam hayyamim shennigzeru alav kema deat amer vayyihyu chayye sara, ma ketiv vayyakam avraham meal pene meto vegomer.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav ma ketiv bappasuk kodem ze dichtiv vattamat sara bekiryat arba hi chevron beeretz kenaan.

Rabbi yitztzechak amar rabbi yochanan bara kudesha berich hu laadam vehichnis bo arbaa devarim hannechelakim bagguf. amar rabbi yehuda hamechubbarim bagguf. rabbi yitztzechak amar hannecholakim bagguf shehem cholkim lehitparesh kol echad lisodo kesheyyotztze haadam min haolam hazze. rabbi yehuda amar hamechubbarim bagguf bechayyav, mashma mikra dichtiv vattamat sara, ze hagguf. bekiryat arba, ellu haarba yesodot. hi chevron, shehayu mechubbarim begufo bechayyav. beeretz kenaan, baolam hazze habbocher adam bizman muat:

rashi: Ketura. zo hagar, venikret ketura al shennaim maasheha kiktoret (Bereshit Rabba), veshekkashra pitchah, shelo nizdavvega leadam miyyom sheppersha meavraham:

Vayyihyu chayye sara mea shana veesrim shana vesheva shanim. lechach nichtav shana bechol kelal uchelal, lomar lecha shekkol echad nidrash leatzmo, bat 100 kevat 20 lechet, ma bat 20 lo chata, shehare enah bat onashin, af bat 100 belo chet, uvat 20 kevat 7 leyofi:
Shene chayye sara. kullan shavin letova:
ohc: Vayyihyu chayye sara. tzarich ladaat lamma amar vayyihyu velo amar kasseder haamur bechol hatztzaddikim "vaychi adam" (Bereshit 5:3) "vaychi shem" (Bereshit 11:11), o yomar "elle shene" kasseder haamur beavraham?

Achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma) shessibbat mitatah hayta keshehodiuha akedat yitzchak vechimat shello nishchat, parcha nishmatah, uchefi ze mitat sara hayta mitztzad shemuat yitzchak. hu sheramaz beamro vayyihyu leshon tzaar sheramaz el haamur.

O yirtze lefi maamaram zichronam livracha (pirki derabbi eliezer lev) hannizkar, shemmeta al yede besora raa, ze yaggid sheim lo haya hammeora od lah chayyim, vehu amro vayyihyu perush havaya chadasha meshunnit mehakkitzva, shekkitzvat yameha yoter hem, veal yede maase hannizkar hayu chayyeha sach haamur bainyan. veamro chayye sara, ki hatztzaddikim mechayyim yemehem, veharshaim yemehem mechayyim otam:

Veamro od shene chayye sara, lefi ma shepperashti sheamar "vayyihyu" lehaggid shemmeta mechamat tzaar, yaggid hakkatuv beamro "shene chayye" vegomer, perush sheshshalma shene chayyeha shekkatzvu lah, ella shehaya ze sibba shemmeta al yadah. ulema shepperashti sheal yede sibbat habbesora alu lah chayyeha pachot mimma shehayu, yechavven lehodia mishpat hachesed asher yishpot hakkadosh baruch hu lididav, ki chol tzaddik shello hishlim yamav lesibba yedua lo yigra Adonai mitztzaddik ma shehaya marviach illu chay shanav shelemim, veyashlim lo secharo al hashshanim shello paal bahem davar (tanchuma, ki tissa 3), ki yomar elav: illu hayiti chay, taavati hayta lesaggel davar tov. vehu amro shene chayye sara, kivven el hashshear, shekkol shenoteha hayu chayyim mimmenna veheiru mikkevodah.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vayyihyu chayye sara – perush betzaar hayu chayye sara mea shana, ki bechullan hayta betzaar. ad tishim shana hayta bechevle leda shello yalda leavraham, vetze ulemad ma sheamra rachel (Bereshit 30:1) "hava li vanim veim ayin meta" vegomer, umittishim ad mea bekeruv shehaya yishmael rodef et yitzchak lehargo kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 53), vehayta mitztaeret al haddavar – hare mea shana. veesrim shana vesheva shanim leelle yechashvu shene chayye sara, ki az batcha bivnah ki kevar gerash avraham et yishmael.

rashi: Levet immah. derech hannashim hayta lihyot lahen bayit leshev bo limlachtan, veen habbat maggedet ella leimmah:
Venikkita mishshevuati vegomer. vekach lo ishsha mibbenot aner eshkol umamre:
Rak et beni vegomer. rak miut hu; beni eno chozer, aval yaakov ben beni sofo lachazor:
ohc: Venikkita mishshevuati zot. perush: mikkichat ishsha livno meet moladto, aval mishshevuat kichat bat kenaan bimkomah omedet, shehu davar hattaluy beyado.
Rak et beni vegomer. lo hishbio al davar ze, veen ze ella teshuva leamro "hehashev ashiv" vegomer:

rashi: Vayfattach. hittir zemam shellahem, shehaya sotem et pihem shelo yiru vadderech bisdot acherim:
Berach et avraham bakkol. bakkol ole begimatriyya ben, umeachar shehaya lo ben haya tzarich lehassio ishsha:
ohc: Veavraham zaken vegomer. perush, letzad sheraa atzmo zaken, vegam raa ki higdil Adonai lehetiv immo bechol tuv, chash al haeved hammoshel bakkol veroe nechasim merubbim, vehaish adone hakkol zaken, yachshov machshavot lehassi bitto leyitzchak ki yitten battov eno. laze amar lo sim na yadcha vegomer, nitchakkem lehashebio bederech kelal al hakkenaani, veaznav tishmana davar ki hakkol lo kol elav sheyyevattel dato, ki hu arur kenaan kefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 139), veyitzchak baruch.

rashi: Lemotzehem. leshon metzia:
targum: Metul dechaye inun leman demashkach lehon ulechula visreh maase:

rashi: Ki lo yishnu. enam yecholin lishon:
targum: La damchin ad ma demavashin uferida shintehon ad ma deavdin tikla:

rashi: Vayyishtachu artza. mikkan shemmodim al besora tova:

Ger vetoshav anochi immachem. ger meeretz acheret venityashshavti immachem. umidrash aggada im tirtzu hareni ger, veim lav ehye toshav veettelenna min haddin, sheamar li hakkabba lezaracha etten et haaretz hazzot:
Achuzat kever. achuzzat karka levet hakkevarot:
ohc: Ger vetoshav vegomer. taam taanato "ger vetoshav", al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 3 mehilchot zechiyya umattana veze leshono: yachol litten mattenat chinnam leger toshav sheatta metzuvve lehachayoto, dichtiv (Vayikra 25:35) "ger vetoshav vachay immach", ad kan. veyesh lecha ladaat ki chol toratenu hakkedosha hi sichliyyit, uvifrat beinyene hahanhaga haartzit, uchemo sheanu mitnahagim beger hayyoshev immanu, kemo chen yitchayyev sichliyyut yoshve haaretz lehanehig benehem lehachayot adam shehu ger vetoshav immahem velatet lo mattenat chinnam, vehi taanat avraham ger vetoshav anochi tenu li. vedikdek lomar "ger" velo hispik lomar "toshav", hamechuvvan lomar shehagam sheani ger veeni mikkem, af al pi chen hareni toshav. od taam amro ger, ki chash lomar al atzmo toshav baolam hazze, vehu hefech middat hatztzaddikim, laze hikdim lomar "ger".

Veekbera vegomer. perush shello yeakkevuhu. od nitkavven lomar lihyot sheatid hu legallot dato ki chafetz bisde efron venoten bah mamon, atta yomru: ma raa avraham latet kulle hay besaddana deara, halo davar hu, vadday sheraa bo davar gadol sheyyishve bechifle kiflayim! laze hikdim lomar "veekbera meti", lekavro millefanay, perush, ze hu shemmachricho shello lachush al mamono, veim lo haya meto lefanav lo haya kone davar. umeatta hagam sheyyikne sede efron bechol mamon shebbaolam, yitlu shehu makom muvchar likvura velahem en bechach kelum.

rashi: Terem achalle. terem sheani mechalle, vechen kol leshon hove, peamim shehu medabber bilshon avar veyachol lichtov terem killiti, ufeamim shemmedabber bilshon atid, kemo ki amar iyyov, hare leshon avar, kacha yaase iyyov (Iyov 1), hare leshon atid, uferush shenehem leshon hove, ki omer haya iyyov ulay chatu vanay vegomer, vehaya oshe kach:
ohc: Ani terem vegomer ledabber el libbi. shalal ki lo shemaattu ozen, lachush lannaara shettaase letzad ma sheshshama.

rashi: Meet shana veshivim shana vechamesh shanim. ben 100 keven 70 uven 70 keven Adonai belo chet:
ohc: Veelle yeme shene chayye avraham asher chay. dikdek lomar "[asher] chay" al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 63) sheamru ki chasru lo chamesh shanim kodem yom shebbo asa esav chamesh averot, velaze amar asher chay perush: lo shanim shekkatzvu lo ki yoter hayu, ella elle hem ma shechay.
Chassalat parashat chayye sara

rashi: Pen titten laacherim hodecha. pen tafne libbecha lelohim acherim, latet lahem tiferet hodcha veshivchacha:
Ushenotecha leachzari. lesar shel gehinnom:
targum: Dela titten leacharane chelach ushenayich lenucherain:

rashi: Umigdanot. leshon megadim, shehevi immo mine perot shel eretz yisrael:
Mispo. kol maachal haggemalim karuy mispo, kegon teven useorim:
Vayyomer bat mi at. leachar shennatan lah shealah, lefi shehaya batuach bizchuto shel avraham shehitzliach hakkabba darko:
Lalin. lina achat, lin shem davar; vehi amra lalun – kamma linot:
ohc: Bat mi at haggidi vegomer. samach shete hashsheelot, lehaggid ki lo nistappek im hi mibbene mishpachat avraham, sheim haya mesuppak lo haya lo lishol hayesh makom ad sheyyeda im derech nachon lefanav, ella vadday sheheemin baAdonai ki hitzliach darko, uma sheshshaal "bat mi at" hu ma shem aviha vegomer, vekodem shettashiv amar "hayesh bet avich" vegomer ki lo yishtanne davar ze behaggadat bat mi vegomer, vehaven:

rashi: Veatta vanim shimu li veal tasuru meimre fi:
targum: Vehasheta venaya shemaun li vela tistun min memre defumi:

rashi: Venahamta veacharitecha. sof shettinhom beacharitecha:
targum: Vetinhom besofach ad ma deyigmar bisrach vegushemach:

rashi: Vayyomer achiha veimmah. uvetuel hechan haya? haya rotze leakkev uva malach vehemito:
Yamim. shana, kemo yamim tihye geullato (Vayikra 25), shekkach notnin livtula zeman 12 chodesh lefarnes atzmah betachshitim (ketuvot 57):
O asor. 10 chodashim; veim tomar yamim mammash, en derech hamevakshim levakkesh davar muat, veim lo tirtze ten lanu merubbe mizze:
Lo yichle. lo yimna kemo lo tichla rachamecha (Tehillim 40) uchemo vayyikkale haggeshem (Bereshit 8):
ohc: Shemaenu vegomer. perush: kabbel devarenu sheanu omrim lecha laasot, vehu sheatta tivchar hakkever hammuvechar shebbakkevarim ukevor metcha, veencha tzarich lishol reshut lomar, makom peloni ani chafetz, velo latet shavyo. vehattaam hu ish mimmennu et kivro lo yichle vegomer, vahare netinat reshut meatta netuna lecha. vetamam kede shello yitakkev meto lefanav kemo shebba betaanato. veamro nesi vegomer yitbaer besamuch:
Adoni. perush adon, veeno kinnuy layyachid, uchemo "adoni tzedek" shebbihoshua (Yehoshua 10:1).

rashi: Peraehu. battelehu:
Sete mealav. sur:
targum: Aresh vela tebar imhon sete vaavar minhon:

rashi: Al haggemallim. leshamran, kemo vehu omed alehem (Bereshit 18:8), leshammesham:
ohc: Vayyavo el vegomer vehinne omed al vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma ba lelammedenu beamro vehinne omed vegomer, veal pi divre razal (yalkut shemauni kat) sheamru ki hikkir eliezer bimrutzato shel lavan leraa, vehizkir shem hameforash veheemid haggemallim baavir al haayin, vehu amro haggemallim al haayin, vehu amad al haggemallim dichtiv "vehinne omed" vegomer, umimmakom gavoah kara lo lavan, vehu amro "bo beruch Adonai", veachar shebba mimmakom gavoah dibber elav "lamma taamod bachutz". uvaze lo kashe lamma hikdim lomar "bo" vegomer veachar kach amar "lamma taamod" vegomer, ki meharauy sheyyomar "lamma taamod" veachar kach yomar "bo" vegomer:

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vehinne omed vegomer, shehagam sheshshaol shaal haish et rivka "hayesh bet avich makom" vegomer, veamra "gam teven" vegomer "gam makom" vegomer, af al pi chen lo mippene ze nata achareha lalechet bet aviha, ella amad bimkomo al haayin.

Veamro bo beruch vegomer, veachar kach amar "lamma" vegomer – nitkavven lomar lo ki ma shemmezammeno lavo etzlo lo lehaachsino beveto, ella shello yaamod bachutz, aval leolam tzarko al atzmo, ki ene reshaim tichlena.

rashi: Vayyavrech haggemallim. hirbitzam:
Ki nofet tittofna. leshon "matok" (Mishlei 24:13):
Sifte zara. afikorsut:
Vechalak mishshemen chikkah. leshon "chech" (Iyov 12:11):
targum: Metul dechavrita menatfan sifvata denuchereta usheia min mishcha chikkah:

rashi: Ach im atta lo shemaeni. atta omer li lishmoa lecha velikkach bechinnam, ani i efshi bechach:
Ach im atta lo shemaeni. halevay vetishmaeni:
Natatti. 364 109, muchan hu etzli, vehalevay natatti lecha kevar:
ohc: Vaydabber vegomer. "lemor ach" vegomer. perush sheyyemaet beribbuy devarim.
Natatti kesef vegomer. perush: im hu gamar litten lo hassade betorat mattana, gam hu gamar latet lo hakkesef betorat mattana. "kach mimmenni" – veaz akabbel mattenatcha "veekbera et" vegomer:

rashi: Vayhi achare mot avraham vayvarech vegomer. nichamo tanchume avelim. davar acher aappi shemmasar hakkabba et habberachot leavraham, nityare levarech et yitzchak mippene shetztzafa et esav yotze mimmenu, amar yavo baal habberachot vivarech et asher yitav beenav, uva hakkabba uvercho (sota 14):
Ad im killu. hare im meshammesh bilshon asher, im killu day sippukon, shezzo hi gemar shetiyyatan, kesheshshatu de sippukan:
ohc: Vattechal lehashekoto. haya tzarich lomar "vaychal lishtot", nitkavven lomar shehayta hi mekarevet lo hammayim lishtot ad sof hashshetiyya, velo haya tzarich hu litroach behattayat mayim elav.

Od efshar shechashsha alav letzad shehaya ayef badderech, vehafelagat hashshetiyya tazzik, vehi hatztzaddeket shiara bedatah shiur sheyyaspik lishtiyyato, velo ratzta lehosif lo leval yistakken, ki heayef lo yeshaer bishtiyyato beet tzimono. uchede shello yachshov ki letzad hameatat hattorach nitkavvena laze, amra elav gam ligmallecha vegomer ad im killu, velo etnaheg immahem behashearat hahistappekut. ha lamadta ki letzad rachmanut veahava nitkavvena elav kattaam hannizkar.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 40.) befasuk (Devarim 11:15) "venatatti esev besadcha livhemtecha" vegomer, shetztzarich adam lehakedim latet mazon livhemto veachar kach et atzmo. veyesh lecha ladaat ki davka deen kan sakkana o tzaar, aval besakkana o besheyyesh tzaar, kodem yesh lachush letzaaro veachar kach behemto. velaze kesheshshaal haish "hagemiini meat", hirgisha hatztzaddeket ki tzame lammayim haya umitztaer haya, laze amra lo "shete". ucheshennatna lo shiur sheshshiara ki vadday en kan chashash letzaar hatztzama, "vattechal lehashekoto vattomer gam ligmallecha eshav", ki begeder ze sheencha mitztaer otam tzarich lehakedim. vehu shessamach hakkatuv levattechal lehashekoto" "vattomer gam ligmallecha" vegomer. veamro ad im killu, perush: lo ashaer lahem kefi haumedna, ella ashke velo essa yadi ad sheere shemmayim lifnehem veenam shotim, veze lecha haot ki killu lishtot.

rashi: Veelle shene chayye yishmael vegomer. amar rabbi chiyya bar abba lamma nimnu shenotav shel yishmael, kede leyaches vahem shenotav shel yaakov mishshenotav shel yishmael, lamadnu sheshshimmesh yaakov bevet ever 14 shana keshepperesh meaviv kodem shebba etzel lavan, shehare keshepperesh yaakov meaviv met yishmael, shenneemar vayyelech esav el yishmael vegomer (Bereshit Rabba 25), kemo shemmeforash besof megilla nikret:
Vayyigva. lo neemra gevia ella betzaddikim:

Badderech. derech hamezumman, derech hayyashar, beoto derech shehayiti tzarich, vechen kol bet velamed vehe hameshammeshim berosh hatteva unekudim befattach, medabberim bedavar happashut shennizkar kevar bemakom acher, o shehu mevorar venikkar beezo hu medabber:
Vayyaan lavan uvetuel. rasha haya, vekafatz lehashiv lifne aviv:
Lo nuchal dabber elecha. lemaen baddavar hazze lo al yede teshuvat davar ra velo al yede teshuvat davar hagun, venikkar shemme yatza haddavar, lefi devarecha shezzimmenah lecha (Bereshit Rabba):

ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer hakere vegomer. batuach haya eliezer baadono shettefillato mekubbelet asher hitpallel "hu yishlach malacho" vegomer, vehosif hu lehitpallel sheyyihye hu rauy leasot haddavar al yado, ki yimmatze lifamim shettihye menia lekayyem divre hattefilla mitztzad haemtzai, laze hitpallel lelohe adono sheyyakre lefanav.

Vetaam shehutzrach laasot seder ze, ki chash leval yatuhu mishpachat avraham kesheyyedu ki hu metzuvve veomed lakachat bat mehem, yittenu lo shifcha mishshifchotam asher ittam babbayit veyomru ki hi mizzaram. laze nitchakkem veasa keseder ze behavechana muvheket shehi havvatranut hammuflaa, shennotenet yoter mimma sheshshaal mimmenna. gam baze yeda otah yedia tzodeket ki hi mibbet avraham, sheheshicha lefi tummah mibbeli daat davar mimmennu ki otah yevakkesh, ufetach devareha heiru beamrah (Bereshit 24:24) "bat betuel" vegomer:

rashi: Vaavo hayyom. hayyom yatzati vehayyom bati, mikkan shekkaftza lo haaretz. amar rabbi acha yafa sichatan shel avde avot lifne hammakom mittoratan shel banim, shehare parasha shel eliezer kefula battora veharebe gufe tora lo nittenu ella birmiza (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayyitten lo et kol asher lo. shetar hammattana hera lahem:
Vayyalinu. kol lina shebbammikra linat layla echad:

Bekiryat arba. al shem arba anakim shehayu sham, achiman sheshay vetalmay vaavihem. davar acher al shem arba zugot shenikberu sham ish veishto, adam vechavva, avraham vesara, yitzchak verivka, yaakov velea (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayyavo avraham. mibbeer sheva:
Lispod lesara velivkotah. venismecha mitat sara laakedat yitzchak lefi sheal yede besorat haakeda, shennizdammen benah lishchita vechimat shello nishchat, parcha nishmatah mimmenna umeta:
ohc: Vattamat sara. ramaz hakkatuv beamro bekiryat arba lomar ki chas veshalom lo yityaches hammita latztzaddikim, ella shekkiryat arba perush ir shehayta benuya mearbaa yesodot nifreda hi venasa mehem. veamro hi chevron perush shehagam shemmeta hi mashpaat bahem bechinat hachibbur, ki hatztzaddikim hagam sheyyamutu hagguf eno meshullal mehachayyim, ki tzaddikim bemitatam keruyim chayyim, vetze ulemad (shabbat kinnev:) mimmaase derav achay bar yoshiyya. vehattaam hiv ki bihyotam baolam hazze mehappechim bechinat hachomer shebbaysodot livchinat haruchaniyyut hakkadosh shebbannefesh beemtzaut maasim tovim vehafelagat hattora shemmishtaddelim baolam hazze. ulehaskilcha baddavar tze ulemad ma shekkatav rambam perek 4 mehilchot yesode hattora din Adonai, sheyyishtanne hayesod lisod chavero hakkarov elav veyehafech heafar lemayim. uchemo chen yimmatze shebbeemtzaut devekut haadam bekono yithappechu hayesodot kullam lisod haesh, visod haesh lisod esh hanneshama, vehaven.
Veamro beeretz kenaan, ki haolam hazze yikkare "eretz kenaan" (Zohar chelek 1 80.), hiv yetzer hara, uveemtzaut hitatztzemut kenegdo yassig haadam lehafeli laasot bikdushsha uvehassaga.

Lispod lesara velivkotah. perush, lesara shemmeta min haolam, velivkotah letzad ma shennechsar beheadrah. o yomar behefech – lesara letzidkutah uma shennechsar beheadrah, velivkotah letzad ma shennogea lah, shettaama kos hammavet vayyeerav shimshah.

rashi: Bechol bae shaar iro. bekerev kullam uvemaamad kullam hiknahu lo:
Vayyarotz haeved likratah. lefi sheraa shealu hammayim likratah (Bereshit Rabba):
Hagemiini na. leshon gemia, 271 109:
ohc: Hagemiini na vegomer. hinne himit mimma shehitna lishol, ki hu amar omar eleha hatti na chaddech veeshte, veatta amar hagemiini perush leshon gemia, gam amar meat, gam lo amar shettatte hi chaddah lehashekoto kaasher hitna. tamo hu al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 80:60) sheraa shealu hammayim likratah, vesiman ze hu muvehak sheeno matzuy bivnot hakkenaani ki im bezera baruch vekadosh keavraham, gam mazzalo herahu ki hi zot, laze haya yare al hattenaim shehitna shemma lo tekayyem otam venimtza hu mafsid mevukkasho al yede tenao, laze haya memaet bechol haefshariyyut bitnaav kede sheyyihye nakel beeneha laasotam.

rashi: Yitzchak veyishmael. mikkan sheasa yishmael teshuva veholich et yitzchak lefanav, vehi seva tova shenneemar beavraham (Bereshit Rabba):
Veefron yoshev. ketiv chaser, oto hayyom minnuhu shoter alehem; mippene chashivuto shel avraham shehaya tzarich lo, ala ligdulla:
Lechol bae shaar iro. shekkullan batlu mimmelachtan uvau ligmol chesed lesara:
Vattomer elech. meatzmi, veaf im enchem rotzim:
Al yamin. mibbenot yishmael:
Al semol. mibbenot lot, shehaya yoshev lismolo shel avraham:
Vattitkas. leshon vattitpael, kemo vattikkaver vattishshaver:
Vaeshal. vaasim. shinna hasseder, shehare hu techilla natan veachar kach shaal, ella shello yitpesuhu bidvarav veyomru haech natatta lah vaadayin encha yodea mi hi:
ohc: Vaeshal otah vaasim vegomer. shinna lachashashat rammautam, ki yomru shennatan hachafatzim kodem letzad ma sheshimmashto, vehem nogim leaviha. laze hikdim ki lo natan ella achar sheyyada heyotah bat betuel sheruya leyitzchak, natan lah bechezkat tachshite kalla lechatan veen leaviha zechut bahem.

rashi: Beni uvencha. ben shene ohavim kamonu ma hi chashuva lichlum, ella hannach et hammecher veet metcha kevor (Bereshit Rabba):
Ad im dibbarti. hare im meshammesh bilshon asher uvilshon ki, kemo: ad ki yavo shilo (Bereshit 49) vezehu sheamru chazal: ki meshammesh bed leshonot, vehaechad i, vehu im:

Adonai elohe hashshamayim asher lekachani mibbet avi. velo amar "velohe haaretz", ulemala amar veashbiacha vegomer? amar lo achshav hu elohe hashshamayim velohe haaretz, shehirgaltiv befi habberiyyot, aval keshellekachani mibbet avi haya elohe hashshamayim velo elohe haaretz, shello hayu bae olam makkirim bo ushemo lo haya ragil baaretz:
Mibbet avi. mecharan:
Umeeretz moladti. meur kasdim:

Vaasher dibber li. letzarki; kemo asher dibber alay (Melachim 1 2), vechen kol li velo velahem hassemuchim etzel dibbur meforashim bilshon al, vetargum shellahem alay, alohi, alehon, sheen nofel etzel dibbur leshon li velo velahem, ella elay, elav, alehem, vetargum shellahem immi, immeh, immehon, aval etzel amira nofel leshon li velo velahem:
Vaasher nishba li. ben habbetarim:
Mikkol mishmar. mikkol ma sheamra tora hishshamer netzor libbecha (meavor alav), ben avera kalla ben avera chamura:
Ki mimmennu totzot chayyim. ki meoto shehu kal yihyu lecha chayyim vesachar gadol im tekayyemennu. kach darash rabbi tanchuma (tanchuma, ki tetze 2):
targum: Mikkol zehura netar libbach metul demineh hu mafkana dechaye:

rashi: Veorach tzaddikim keor noga. sheholech umeir meammud hashshachar:
Ad nechon hayyom. ad chatzot hayyom, shehu beruro shel yom:
targum: Vearcha detzadike kinhora demazhar veazel nahareh ad ma detakin yoma:

rashi: Miggemalle adonav. nikkarin hayu mishshear gemallim, shehayu yotzin zemumin mippene haggezel, shello yiru visdot acherim (Bereshit Rabba):
Vechol tov adonav beyado. shetar mattana katav leyitzchak al kol asher lo, kede sheyyikpetzu lishloach lo bittam (Bereshit Rabba):
Aram naharayim. ben shete neharot yoshevet:
ohc: Asara gemallim miggemalle. perush taam kachto asara, ki beerech gemalle adonav kelokeach echad hayu, vezulat ze haya maspik beechad.
Od yirtze shellakach asara gemallim, perush: harebe, al derech amro (Shmuel 1 1:8) "tov lach measara banim".
Veamro miggemalle adonav. perush: mehameyuchadim letzarko, hammuvecharim etzlo kede sheyyitanu harebe, uva lishlol shear haggemallim shehayu leavraham mikkelal hannechasim.

Veamro vechol tuv perush: kol muvchar shebbekinyane adono, zahav vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot. vehattaam – im lo tirtze lavo acharav, yare bet nechoto. gam leim yitchayyev bemohar, yare ki yesh mimma leharebot mohar umattan. veamro beyado perush: shebbeyado.

rashi: Zekan beto. lefi shehu davuk nakud zekan:

Tachat yerechi. lefi shehannishba tzarich sheyyittol beyado chefetz shel mitzva, kegon sefer tora o tefillin (shavuot 38), vehammila hayta mitzva rishona lo uvaa lo al yede tzaar vehayta chaviva alav unetalah:
Bishmotam latevaledavetam. seder ledatan ze achar ze:
Lo tikkach ishsha livni mibbenot hakkenaani. im lo telech techilla el bet avi velo tove lalechet acharecha:
Haser mimmecha ikkeshut pe. lo taase davar sheyyalizu bo habberiyyot veyaakimu alecha pihem:
Ikkeshut pe. leshon ikkum, kemo "tam ani vayyakkesheni" (Iyov 9:20). uvammishna (chullin 56.): shinneha akumot vaakushot:
Ulezut sefatayim. ikkemimut sefatayim, shello yarchivu habberiyyot pe alecha:
targum: Aber minach ikkuma defuma veaata desifvata archek minach:

rashi: At hayi lealfe revava. at vezarech tekabbelu otah beracha shenneemar leavraham behar hammoriyya vehareba arbe et zaracha vegomer, yehi ratzon sheyyehe oto hazzera mimmech velo meishsha acheret:
ohc: At hayi lealfe revava vegomer. taam amro at, perush: achar shennitbasser avraham shealfe revava yetzu miyyitzchak, yehi ratzon sheyyetzu mimmech. veyoter haya tov lahem shello yihye haddavar velo yakum, vehaven ki chol chelek hara yisna chelek hattov, velu yihye beno uvitto.

rashi: Vayyarotz. lema ratz veal ma ratz? vayhi kirot et hannezem, amar ashir hu ze, venatan enav bammamon:
ohc: Ulerivka ach ushemo lavan vegomer. ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 10; Ester Rabba 6,3) sheamru ki hatztzaddikim shemam kodem lahem, dichtiv (Rut 2:1) "ushemo boaz", "veshem haish elimelech" (Rut 1:2), aval harshaim hem kodmim lishmam, dichtiv (Shmuel 1 25:25) "naval shemo" vegomer. im ken lamma lakach hakkatuv seder hatztzaddikim belavan harasha? velatet taam laddavar yesh lehair bakkatuv amro vayyaratz lamma ratz, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni kat) amru lefi sheraa hannezem vechulei natan enav bammamon. vaadayin kashe, im ken haya lo lehakedim lomar "vayhi kirot vegomer vayyaratz" vegomer. gam baze lo haya tzarich lichtov shete peamim "el haish hachutza el haayin"?

Achen hakkavvana hi ki ze haish lavan charad likrat haish beyado ma sheavar beno uven rivka mehaddevarim umikkeruv haddaat, vehu ish nachri, hare ze maggid ki devarim bego, velaze lavash kina veratz likrato lifgoa bo bekinato et kinat achoto. uletzad bechinat maase ze yiches Adonai oto yichusin shel tzaddikim veamar ushemo lavan, ki maase tzaddikim asa baze veen hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach sechar beriyya.

Veamro vayhi kirot vegomer, yaggid ki ma shekkadam haya kodem kirot hatztzemidim vekodem shamo divre achoto. sidran shel maasim: chashado leeliezer bedavar mechoar, aval kirot hannezem vegomer ucheshamo vegomer kacha dibber elay haish – shav appo. veaf al pi chen modia hakkatuv sheyyatza likrat haish lo lehara, ella adrabba, lehaachsino ulehachazik lo tova, uvaze nityashshevu.
Ki el artzi vegomer. gam zo bichlal hashshevua sheyyikkach lo ishsha mimmoladto, velaze timtza ki techef umiyyad lakach haggemallim vayyelech aram naharayim:

rashi: Derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu. pitom yavo lahem michshol, velo yedu lehizzaher mimmennu:
targum: Vearcha derashie chakkera vela yadin bimna mittaklin:

rashi: Beni lidvaray hakeshiva vegomer:
targum: Beri lemilay atzet ulemaamaray tzele udenach:

rashi: Vaysapper haeved. gilla lo nissim shennaasu lo, shekkaftza lo haaretz veshennizdammena lo rivka bittefillato (Bereshit Rabba):

ohc: Vayyakam vegomer vayyishtachu vegomer. gilla lahem hefech divrehem elav, ki eno machzik atzmo nasi lahem, ella begeder shehem bechavod lemala mimmennu.

rashi: Venishala et piha. mikkan sheen massiin et haishsha ella middatah (Bereshit Rabba):

Orach chayyim pen tefalles. kach derashuhu chachamim (Devarim Rabba 6:2): silsel hakkadosh baruch hu mattan secharan shel mitzvot velo pershan, kede shello yire adam mitzva shemmattan secharah merubbe veyidbak bah, veyanniach shear hammitzvot. veze pitrono: kede shello tefalles archot hattora, e zo likkach vee zo lehanniach, lechach nau mageloteha. henia hakkadosh baruch hu netivoteha velo hodiam. zehu midrash aggada (tanchuma, ekev 2). aval lefi seder hammikraot shekkatuv acharav harechek mealeha darkecha – nire, sheadayin lo hifsik beinyan ishsha hazzona, vechen yesh lefaresh: orach chayyim pen tefalles. al tishkol orach chayyim etzel otah zara, lomar: ezo laasot zo o zo? ki magelot hazzona nau lishol, velo teda lehizzaher ad asher tanua vetippol:
targum: Bearcha dechaye la darcha metaltelin shevilaha vela yada:

rashi: Vayyitten avraham vegomer. amar Rabbi nechemya beracha diattike, sheamar lo hakkabba leavraham vehye beracha, habberachot mesurot beyadcha levarech et mi shettirtze, veavraham mesaran leyitzchak (Bereshit Rabba):
Mishtae. leshon sheiyya, kemo shau arim, tishshae shemama (sham 6):

Mishtae. mishtomem umitbahal al sheraa devaro karov lehatzeliach, aval eno yodea im mimmishpachat avraham hi im lav. veal titma bat shel mishtae, sheen lecha teva shettechillat yesodah shin umedabberet bilshon mitpael sheen tav mafrida ben shete otiyyot shel ikkar hayesod kegon mishtae, mishtolel miggizrat sholal, vayyishtomem miggizrat shemama, veyishtammer chukkot amri (Micha 6) miggizrat vayyishmor, af kan mishtae miggizrat tishshae, ucheshem sheatta motze leshon meshomem beadam nivhal veneelam uvaal machashavot, kemo al yomo nashammu acharonim (Iyov 18), shommu shamayim (Yirmeyahu 2), eshtomam keshaa chada (Daniel 4), kach tefaresh leshon sheiyya beadam bahul uvaal machashavot (veunkelos tirgem leshon shehiyya, vegavra shahe, shohe veomed bemakom echad lirot hahitzliach Adonai darko; veen letargem shate, shehare eno leshon shetiyya, sheen alef nofelet bilshon shetiyya):
Mishtae lah. mishtomem aleha, kemo imri li achi hu (Bereshit 20:13) uchemo vayyishalu anshe hammakom leishto (sham 26):
ohc: Vehaish mishtae lah macharish. perush: leheyot sheraa hatzelachat darko, veyoter mimma sheamar bitnao amra hatztzaddeket, hayta nafsho mekashkeshet lomar eleha ma sheamar besamuch, ki kevar nishlam tenay sheamar "veamra vegam ligmallecha eshav" (Bereshit 24:44). hinne hi amra "vegam" vegomer, vekiyyema devareha dichtiv (Bereshit 24:20) "vattishav lechol gemallav", velo haya tzarich lehametin ad sheyyechallu haggemallim lishtot shello haya ze mehattenay. vehaya mashtik atzmo middabber ad sheyyeda ma sheamra lehashekot gemallav ad sheyyechallu lishtot, vahagam sheen davar ze mehattenay, letzad devareha nolad lo bah safek shemma hi mehaomrim harebe veosim meat, ad sheraa shekkillu haggemallim vegomer, techef natan hatztzemidim vegomer.

rashi: Nafshechem. retzonchem:
Ufigu li. leshon bakkasha kemo: al tifgei bi (Rut 1):
ohc: Vaydabber vegomer im yesh et nafshechem vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava batra lo:) veze leshonam: hane be resh galuta la machzeke ban vechulei. veamru hattaam ki letzad shehem takkifim, hagam shehechziku baaretz lo toil lahem hachazaka bakkarka umotziin otah miyyadam.

Vehinne bitshuvat bene chet amru nesi elohim vegomer ish mimmennu et kivro lo yichle vegomer, yesh bedivrehem shene derachim: haechad hu ki hu gadol ad meod vetakkif, yaase cheftzo uretzono ki en moche beyado letzad hayyecholet, uchefi ze en lo din chazaka bakkever velichshettassig yadam yefannu hammet mikkivro, veze yaggid ki enam chafetzim sheyyikbor meto millefanav zulat im yaase bizroa, vahare hu mutre veomed. vederech hashsheni hu al ze hadderech: nesi elohim vegomer perush en lecha lachush lachashashat din deve resh galuta sheen chezkatam chazaka ki hanniddon eno dome, ki taam deve resh galuta hu letzad shennechshadim hem al haggazel vehechamas, aval atta nesi elohim, perush gedullatcha hi letzad maalat tzidkatcha unekiyyut kappecha, veen lachush laze, vachazakatcha chazaka sheen kenegdah taana. veulay ki laze nitkavvenu beamram shemaenu perush haven devarenu lehechan notim. laze amar im yesh et nafshechem vegomer, perush, im kavvanatchem hi bemashmaut divrechem sheattem chafetzim likbor vegomer shemauni veheyu attem sarsurim beni uven efron vegomer. aval zulat ze yuchra haddavar shepperush divrehem hu kapperush harishon veen retzonam likbor vechulei:

rashi: Vayyakom sede efron. tekuma hayta lo, sheyyatza miyyad hedyot leyad melech; ufeshuto shel mikra vayyakam hassade vehammeara asher bo vechol haetz leavraham lemikna vegomer:
Mibbo beer lachay roi. shehalach lehavi hagar leavraham aviv sheyyissaenna (Bereshit Rabba):

Yoshev beeretz hannegev. karov leoto beer, shenneemar vayyissa mishsham avraham artza hannegev vayyeshev ben kadesh uven shur (Bereshit 20) vesham haya habbeer, shenneemar hinne ven kadesh uven bared (sham 16):
Happilagshim. chaser ketiv, shello hayta ella pilegesh achat, hi hagar, hi ketura (Bereshit Rabba). nashim bichtubba, pilagshim belo ketubba, kidamrinan besanhedrin, benashim ufilagshim dedavid:
Natan avraham mattanot. pershu rabbotenu shem tuma masar lahem (sanhedrin 91). davar acher ma shennittan lo al odot sara ushear mattanot shenittenu lo, hakkol natan lahem, shello ratza lehanot mehem:
ohc: Velivne happilagshim vegomer. uleyishmael lo amar hakkatuv shennatan lo mattanot veshillecho, ki lefi ma shekkatavnu (Bereshit 16:5) ki yishmael mishpat keniyya yesh bo leyitzchak, meshullach veomed hu. veyesh yom lael ayom mishpat yaase veyakkir nikne lekonav.

rashi: Otah hochachta. reuya hi lo shettehe gomelet chasadim, ucheday likkanes beveto shel avraham; uleshon hochachta berarta, aperavebayshat 109:
Uvah eda. leshon techinna, hoda li bah:
Ki asita chesed. im tihye mimmishpachto vehogenet lo eda ki asit chesed:
Vattear. leshon nefitza, veharebe yesh bilshon mishna hameare mikkeli el keli, uvammikra yesh lo dome al tear nafshi (Tehillim 141), asher heera lammavet nafsho (Yeshayahu 53):
Hashshoket. even chalula sheshshotim ba haggemallim:
Pinniti habbayit. meavodat elilim (Bereshit Rabba):

ohc: Vayyishshava lo al haddavar. perush: al bat kenaan behechlet, veal eretz moladto im tirtze lavo immo.

rashi: Pen yisbeu zarim kochecha. nevie habbaal haggovin mamon beshikrehem uvefachazutam (Yirmeyahu 23:32):
Vaatzavecha. atzavecha vigiacha, shenneetzavta vetarachta bo:
Bevet nachri. bevet ovde gillulim:
targum: Dela nisbeun nucherae chelach veleutach tael leveta deacharine:

rashi: Hammachpela. bayt vaaliyya al gabbav. davar acher shekkefula bezugot (eruvin 53):
Bechesef male. shalem, kol shavyah; vechen david amar laaravna bechesef male (divrei hayamim 1 21):
ohc: Veyitten li vegomer. dikdek lomar leshon mattana, hagam shennatal mimmennu damim, keamro "bechesef male", gam dikdek lomar betochchem. hinne nitchakkem avraham liknot hammeara beseder sheen acharav irur. veleheyot sherabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (zohar chelek 1 128) sheefron miyyamav lo raa bammeara zulat hachoshech vehabbehala, veim ken yachol hu lavo betaana kesheyyeda shehammeara yikrat haerech, vaafillu leolam chozer hu, veen zechut hammeara mitkayyem beyad avraham leolam. vahagam sheen onaa lekarkaot, chash avraham lisvarat hayerushalmi shekkatvu hattosafot (kiddushin 42:) sheyyesh lahem onaa bachatzi demehem, vedavka onaat shetut en lahem.

Od yesh lachush shemma yeararu achar hammecher middin hammetzer, o sheyyetze achar kach shetar shibud al hakkarka hahu veyitrefuhu miyyad avraham. laze nitchakkem letakken kol ze veamar leshon mattana umecher, hakkavvana baze sheyyaase ofen sheyyesh bo shenehem, vehu hachalifin, sheyyesh bo mecher veyesh bo mattana, sheyyachol lehachelif machat begamal veen bahem onaa beshum ofen. vedin chalifin yeshno bekarka uvemittaltelin aval lo bematbeot, laze amru zichronam livracha bivchorot veze leshonam (bechorot 50.): amar rabbi chanina kol shekel shekkatuv battora selaim vechulei, chutz mishshekalim haamurim beefron shehem kanterin over lassocher, perakmatya nafkat vechulei, ad kan leshono. umeatta lo nishar makom leefron lavo betaana. velachashashat metzer gam lachashashat shibud asa kol bene hair sarsurim baddavar, umimmela batlu taanat bar mitzra, gam nitgalla ki lo haya aleha shibud, shehaya haddavar beazne kol bae shaar iro.

Veamro laachuzzat kaver, leheyot shello bikkesh mimmennu ella hammeara, aval hassade odennu omed lizchut efron, yesh makom lomar elav achare chen shello yachpotz bidrisat haregel sheyyaavru alav likbor metim vehu lo mecharo ella likbor sara veen derisat regel besadehu od, laze amar laachuzzat kaver.

rashi: Betula. mimmekom betulim (Bereshit Rabba):
Veish lo yedaah. shello kedarkah, lefi shebbenot haggoyim hayu meshammerot mekom betulehen umafkirot atzman mimmakom acher, heid al zo shennekiyya mikkol:

ohc: Terem killa ledabber. perush: beodo omer "im adoni" vehinne rivka, vehu perek ba siman ki hi zot sheruya lihyot im adono.

Rivka yotzet. perush: mesubbevet yetzia mehazzulat letzad tefillat eliezer. asa Adonai shettetze beoto rega, lo kodem velo achar, kede shello yikkashel beishsha acheret, ki hi zot asher yulleda livtuel vegomer, hi bat zugo shel yitzchak, uchemo shepperashti befarashat vayyera befasuk (Bereshit 22:20) "vayhi achare vegomer vayyuggad leavraham" vegomer:

rashi: Vayyishkol avraham leefron. chaser vav; lefi sheamar harebe, vaafillu meat lo asa (bava metzia 87), shennatal mimmenu shekalim gedolim shehen kantarin, shenneemar over lassocher, shemmitkabbelim beshekel bechol makom (sham uvechorot 50), veyesh makom sheshshiklehen gedolim, shehen kantarin tzanetaynaarash 109:
Gam atta. gam lerabbot anashim sheimmo:
Hochiach. berer vehodia, vechen kol hochacha shebbammikra berur davar:
Ragleha yordot mavet sheol tzeadeha yitmochu. leshon kureva:
targum: Riglah nachatan lemota sheyol hilchataha mesamchan:

rashi: Vattere et yitzchak. raata oto hadur vetoha mippanav (Bereshit Rabba):

Vattippol. hishmita atzmah laaretz, ketargumo veitrechinat, hitteta atzmah laaretz velo higgia ad hakkarka, kemo hatti na chaddech, archini, vayyet shamayim (Tehillim 18), vearkin, leshon mutte laaretz, vedome lo ki yippol lo yutal (Tehillim 37), kelomar im yitte laaretz lo yaggia ad hakkarka:

ohc: Veachare chen vegomer vayyakam vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "veachare chen", ki muvan hiv misseder shel devarim sheachare chen hiv shekkavar. od lamma hutzrach lomar paam sheniyya "vayyakam hassade"?

Achen hakkatuv yechavven lehodia ki hayta hakkeniyya kechol mishpete hakkinyan, vehu amro veachare chen, perush: achar sheshshakal avraham leefron deme hammeara, baze sillek efron zechuto meal hakkarka, kemo shekkatav rambam perek 1 mehilchot zechiyya umattana veze leshono: shehaggoy meet shellakach haddamim sillek zechuto, veyisrael lo kana ad sheyyaggia shetar leyado, venimtzeu nechasim ellu kenichse midbar shekkol hammachazik bahem zacha, ad kan. hare sheyyoil netinat hammamon shello nishar laggoy zechut bah, velaze toil ligmor hakkeniyya beyad avraham beemtzaut hachazaka shehechezik bah bema shekkavar bah et sara, aval im haya kover et sara kodem, hagam shehaya noten achar kach kesef hassade, lo haya zoche bintinat hakkesef levaddah kannizkar belo chazaka.

Venishar ladaat im chazaka zo shemah chazaka bekarka haggoy, vehinne katav rambam beferek 2 mehilchot zechiyya umattana veze leshono: aval benichse hefker o hagger, afillu achal perot kamma shanim lo kana lo ilan velo karka ad sheyyaase maase beguf haaretz vechulei, ketzad? hammotze palterin benichse hagger o hefker, vesiyyed bahem o kiyyer gavoah amma o yoter kana vechulei, hammatztzia matztzaot kana vechulei, haya lokeach afar mimmakom gavoah lemakom namuch hare ze metakken haaretz, reinuhu shehaya mashlich heafar belo hakepada, hare ze bechezkat sheeno mechavven ella lehashevot makom ledayish velo kana, ad kan. vechatav hammaggid mishne: hammatztzia matztzaot – perush, leshev alehem, vahare nehena migguf hakkarka. perush acher – hammatztzia matztzaot, sheyyippa hakkarka behatztzaatam kesiyyud vechiyyur vechulei veze ikkar, velaze hiskim harav ibben migash zichrono livracha, ad kan. vehinne bishlama lefi perush rishon shel hammaggid shekkol shennehena migguf haaretz nikret chazaka bimtziut hefker, nomar sheggam bammetziut shellefanenu kevan shekkavar beguf haaretz et sara ishto chashuv nehena migguf haaretz ukenaah, ella lisvarat harav ibben migash sheenah chazaka zulat im yaase tikkun beguf haaretz kesiyyud vechiyyur, im ken kevurat sara lo toil leinyan chazaka, uvamme kana avraham?

Veefshar ki keshebbonin hakkever, uvifrat binyan hakkevarot hakkadmonim shehayu bonin kuchin, umin hassetam hem mesayyedim umechayyerim, uvaze tihye hachazaka. umeatta yityashshev taam shechazar hakkatuv lomar paam sheniyya vayyakam hassade, lomar ki achar shekkavar avraham vegomer, baze hushlema hakkima shel hassade leavraham, vezulat ze hagam shebbeerech efron nechtema gezerato shessillek zechuto, aval adayin eno nikra shel avraham kefi haddin kannizkar, veachar shekkavar vechulei vayyakam vegomer:
Vayyaanu vegomer lemor lo. perush: letzad ki lo rabbim yedabberu, laze amar "lemor lo", ki echad yomar elav bead kullam.
Od nitkavven lomar shello hiskimu benehem al haddavar haamur bitshuvatam, ella "lemor lo", uchemo sheggilla sofam al techillatam "bechesef male".

rashi: Beka. remez leshikle yisrael beka laggulgolet:
Ushene tzemidim. remez lishne luchot metzummadot:
Asara zahav mishkalam. remez laaseret haddibberot shebbahen:
ohc: Al yadeha. perush shehalamuha keillu naasu keshiur ze, veasa haddavar letzad hatzediko behashegachat Adonai alav vesimanim hammatzdikim sherau enav.

rashi: Beni lechachmati hakeshiva vegomer:
targum: Beri lechuchemti tzet livyuni tzele adnach:

rashi: Lo adoni. lo tikne otah bedamim:
Natatti lach. hare hu kemo shennetattiha lecha:
ohc: Lo adoni. perush: lo tikkach hammeara levad, ella gam hassade kevar natatti, perush kevar gamarti bedati litten. vetamo, lo yihye hassade rauy lidvar ma achar shehammeara hi levet hakkevarot. veal ze dikdek lomar "shemaeni", perush, sheyyavin devarav vetamo.

Vehammeara vegomer. perush: kevar bashshelichut harishona kesheanuhu bene chet veamru (Bereshit 23:6) "ish mimmennu et kivro lo yichle" vegomer lecha netattiha, vetaam shechazar paam sheniyya lomar leene vegomer, lomar shello nishar shum michush mittaanat din bar mitzra shechash elav avraham bitchillat devarav sheamar (Bereshit 23:8) "ufigu li" vegomer:

Meal pene meto. al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kinnev:) shekkodem sheyyissatem haggolel, nefesh adam roa veyodaat kol ma shellefaneha. od mikkan shemmashkivin hammet al gabbo (bava batra ad.).

Vaydabber el bene chet lemor. yirtze ki letzad shehu shaal "tenu li achuzzat" vegomer, shennire middevarav shemmitratztze hu bechol makom sheyyittenu lo, laze amar hakkatuv lemor, perush: lo ze hu tachlit haddibbur ella hachana lemor mevukkasho ki hu ze sede efron.

Od yirtze latet taam lamma hutzrach avraham ledabber el bene chet, gam lehaarich kol haamur bainyan, vechi mi shehaya tzarich liknot achuzzat kever o sade echad lecharsho o lenato yihye tzarich lehareim tevel veyoshveha? laze gamar omer lemor – perush: lo letzorech arba ammot karka likbor sara hutzrach ledabber leyoshve eretz, ella lemor haamur bainyan shekkana mearat hammachpela asher en aroch eleha, velaze hutzrach ledabber lechullan ulechol hahamtzaot kede sheyyoil keniyyatah kefi haddin.

Od yirtze lehasir taromet gedola meal avraham, vehu ech yishal mattenat chinnam veyomar "tenu li achuzza", laze hikdim veamar lemor, perush: levavo lo chen yachshov, ella mippiv amar haddevarim, vedato lavo betaana kaasher avaer besamuch.

rashi: Nafal. shachan, kemo umidyan vaamalek uvene kedem noflim baemek (Shoftim 7). kan hu omer leshon nefila, ulehallan omer al pene chol echav yishkon (Bereshit 16:12)? ad shello met avraham yishkon, mishshemmet avraham nafal:

Haohela sara immo. vayvieha haohela venaaset dugmat sara immo, kelomar vahare hi sara immo, shekkol zeman shessara kayyemet haya ner daluk meerev shabbat leerev shabbat uveracha metzuya baissa veanan kashur al haohel, umishshemmeta pasku, ucheshebbat rivka chazru (Bereshit Rabba):
Achare immo. derech eretz kol zeman sheimmo shel adam kayyemet, karuch hu etzlah; umishshemmeta, hu mitnachem beishto:
Vattored kaddah. meal shichmah:
ohc: Vattomer shete vegomer. perush: keneged sheamarta gemia meat – shete kecheftzecha. velo sheyyishte hu beyado, ella hi titrach bammitzva lehashekot tzame lammayim. "vattemaher vattored kaddah al yadah" kede shello yitrach hu biset hakkad lishtot. veamro vattashkehu perush: millevad shello tarach laset hakkad, od lah shehayta torachat lekarev lefiv hammayim shello yitztarech hu afillu lehattot hakkeli.

Vetaam shello amra techef umiyyad "gam ligmallecha" vegomer – letosefet vatranut nitkavvena hatztzaddeket, sheim hayta makdemet lomar "gam ligmallecha" vegomer kodem sheyyishte hu, yesh makom lo lemaher lehakel tarchah kevan sheod lah tirchat haggemallim, ma sheen ken kodem shettodiehu yachshov ki hu ze kol hattorach veyishte kecheftzo leat leat, veachar sheshshata techef amra "gam ligmallecha" vegomer.

rashi: Lasuach. leshon tefilla (Bereshit Rabba), kemo yishpoch sicho (Tehillim 102):

Ashevareym valetaveshaym. shem rashe ummot (Bereshit Rabba), vetargum shel unkelos en li leyashshevo al leshon hammikra shepperesh lemashshiryan, leshon machane, veim tomar sheeno chen mippene haalef sheenah yesodit, hare lanu tevot sheen berosham alef venittosfa alef berosham, kemo chomat anach (Amos 7) shehu min neche raglayim, uchemo asuch shamen (42 4), shehu min verachatzt vasacht:
Uletushim. hem baale ohalim hammitpazrim ane vaana venosim ish beohole appadno, vechen hu omer vehinnam netushim al pene chol haaretz (Shmuel 1 30) shekken lamed venun mitchallefot zo bezo):

Ulay lo telech haishsha. ulay ketiv, bat hayta lo leeliezer, vehaya mechazzer limtzo illa sheyyomar lo avraham lifnot elav lehassio bitto, amar lo avraham beni varuch veatta arur veen arur middabbek bevaruch:
Bechatzrehem. kerakkim sheen lahem choma, vetargumo befatzchehon shehem mefutztzachim, leshon peticha, kemo pitzchu verannenu (Tehillim 98):
Bat betuel. heshivattu al rishon rishon veal acharon acharon:
ohc: Bat betuel asher yalda vegomer. perush sheaviha mibbene haggevira velo mippilegesh.

Asher anochi yoshev bekirbo. gilla dato avraham taam shehutzrach lehashebio velo hoil taam shezze baruch vehu arur, ki haeved chashav machshavot shehagam shekkenaan arur kevar yatza mearur mittaam sheamar hakkatuv "vehye beracha", perush shekkol mishpacha shehaya avraham betochah tihye mevorechet, gam amro "venivrechu vecha" vegomer, laze amar asher anochi vegomer, perush hagam sheani yoshev bekirbo venivrechu vi, im kol ze en davar ze motzi lecha arur mikkillato. gam nitkavven leval yomar letzad shehaya mitgorer immahem shello yareu bishchunato yitchatten bahem, laze amar "asher anochi yoshev bekirbo" af al pi chen lo toil taana zo lehitchatten immahem.

targum: Veli ana avdach uletzadok kahana velivnayahu var yehoyada velishlomo avdach la zamin:
Veha od dehi memalala im malka venatan neviya ata:
Im min ribboni malka hava pitgama haden vela hodat yat avdach man yittev al kurese malchuta deribboni malka batrohi:
Ucheraat bat sheva al appaha al ara usegidat lemalka vaamarat yitkayem ribboni malka david laalam:
Ezeli vetaalin levat malka david vetemrin leh hala at ribboni malka kayemta leamtach lememar are shelomo verich yimloch batray vehu yittev al kurese malchuti uma den melach adoniyahu:
La nizlan meaynach natrinun begaveh delibbach:
Uneches torin ufatimin vean lisge vezamin lechol vene malka uleevyatar kahana uleyoav rav chela velishlomo avdach la zamin:
Demechaltehon mechalta derashie vechamra dechatofaya shatyan:
Vaamaru leh avdohi yivun leribboni malka ulemta betuleta uteshamesh kodam malka utehe leh kariva vetishkuv levatach vetishchan leribboni malka:
Detizdehar betarita vedata sifvatach ninteran:
Uveu ulemta shappirta bechol techom ara deyisrael veashkachu yat avishag demin shunem veaytiu yatah lemalka:
Ucheraat bat sheva usegidat lemalka vaamar malka ma lich:
Vaadoniya var chagit mitravrav lememar ana emloch vaavad leh retichin ufarashin vechamshin gavra redifin kodamohi:
Uneches adoniyahu an vetorin ufatimin im even sechuta din bistar en katzra vezamin yat kol achohi bene malka ulechol gavre yehuda avde malka:
Vihe kad yishkuv ribboni malka im avahatohi veehi ana uveri shelomo mitrechin:
Veulemta shappirta ad lachada vahavat lemalka kariva umeshamsha leh umalka la yedaah:
Veha ad di at memalla taman kodam malka vaana eul batrach vaakayem yat pitgamaychi:
Uchean ribboni malka ene chol yisrael sevirin alach lechavaa lehon man yittev al kurese malchuta deribboni malka batrohi:
Archek minah archach vela tekarev letara devaytah:
Vetzadok kahana uvenayahu bar yehoyada venatan neviya veshimi verei vegibbaraya di ledavid la havo baatzat adoniyahu:
Vaalat bat sheva lokodam malka leidron bet mishkeva umalka siv lachada vaavishag demin shunem meshamsha kodam malka:
Veacharaytah merira hech gira charifa min sayfa ditren pumin:
Vela achlimeh avuhi miomohi lememar ma den keden at aved veaf hu shappir bereva lachada veyateh yeledat batar avshalom:
Vaatev malka david vaamar kero li levat shava vaalat lokodam malka vekamat lokodam malka:
Vaamar natan levat sheva imeh dishlomo lememar hala shemat are melach adoniyahu var chagit veribbonana david la yeda:
Vaamarat leh ribboni at kayemta bememra dayya elahach leamtach are shelomo verech yimloch batray vehu yittev al kurese malchuti:
Are kema dekayemit lach bememra dayya elaha deyisrael lememar are shelomo verich yimloch batray vehu yittev al kurese malchuti techoti are ken abed yoma haden:
Vekayem malka vaamar kayam hu Adonai dipperak yat nafshi mikkol aka:
Vahavo pitgamohi beetza im yoav bar tzeruya veim evyatar kahana vesadin batar adoniya:
Vechaviu lemalka lememar ha natan neviya vaata kodam malka usegid lemalka al appohi al ara:
Veyat natan neviya uvenayahu veyat gibbaraya veyat shelomo achohi la zamin:
Uchean ata emlechinach chean malka veshezve yat nafshich veyat nefash berich shelomo:
Uchean ha adoniya melach veat ribboni malka la yedata:
Umalka david siv al beyomin umichsan leh bilvushin vela shachin leh:
Are nechat yoma den uneches torin ufatimin vean lisge vezamin lechol bene malka ulerabbane chela uleevyatar kahana veha inun achlin veshatan kodamohi vaamaru yatzlach malka adoniyahu:
Vaamar natan ribboni malka at amart adoniya yimloch batray vehu yittev al kurese malchuti:
Vetemar hechna senet marduta umachsanuta ashle libbi:
Vela shemait kala demarvatay ulemalfanay la tzelet adnay:

bart: Hatztzorem. happogem. uvechohen ayre, sheppogem ozen habbechor kede sheyyihye chullin beyado:

Hare ze lo yishshachet olamit. vaafillu nafal bo mum acher. mishshum kenas, lefi sheavar vehittil mum bakkadashim. shehammattil mum bakkadashim sofeg et haarbaim, vaafillu asa mum bevaal mum. dichtiv (Vayikra 22) kol mum lo yihye bo, kare beh lo yehayye bo, shello yattil bo mum. umiddahava leh lemichtav mum vechatav kol mum, lerabbot afillu baal mum shello yattil bo mum:
Kesheyyivvaled lo mum acher yishchot alav. vaafillu veoto mum atzmo, im met hammattil et hammum, beno shochet acharav al oto hammum. dildideh kansu rabbanan, livreh lo kansu rabbanan. vechen halacha:
Usearo meduldal. lefi shello nigzaz meolam:
Kasdor. memunne mehammelech:
Ma tivo shel ze. shehinnichuhu lehazekin kol kach:
Pigyon. sakkin sheyyesh lo shete piyyot karuy pigyon:
Vehittiruhu. af al pi shehannachri nitkavven lehattil bo mum, kevan deshello middaat yisrael asa, shello nitkavven laasot nachat ruach leyisrael:
Raa shehittiru vehalach vetzaram beazne vechorot acherim. kede laasot nachat ruach leyisrael. naasa cheillu amar lo yisrael sheyyaasehu veasur:

Hayu tinokot mesachakim. utzericha leashmeinan kasdor nachri vetinokot. dei ashmoinan kasdor, hava amena venachri hu deshare delekka lemigzar dilma ate lemisrach velilmod lehattil mum bakkadashim, desircheh denachri lo ichpat lan shehare nahug hu veissurin, aval katan dei sharet leh ate lemisrach ema lo. vei ashmoinan tinokot hava amena tinok hu desharu rabbanan, deman dechaze lo ate lememar nammi i hava shade veh gadol muma hava mishtere, dekatan begadol lo michallaf, aval nachri gadol deate leichallofe vegadol yisrael ema lo, tzeriche:
Kol shehu ledato asur. laatoye gerama. kegon sheyyolich habbehema bemakom sheyyesh bo barzel kede shettikkashel bo veyippol bah mum:
Veshello ledato muttar. laatoye im haya yisrael mesiach lefi tummo veomer bifne hannachri bechor ze im nafal bo mum hayinu ochlim oto, veshama hannachri vehittil bo mum, muttar:
Notnin livtula. zeman lechansah lachuppa miyyom shettevaah habbaal leachar shekkiddeshah, lehazehirah al iske chuppa lehachin tachshiteha:
Lefarnes atzmah. betachshiteha shenem asar chodesh, dichtiv (Bereshit 24) teshev hannaara ittanu yamim, umay yamim, shana, dichtiv (Vayikra 24) yamim tihye geullato:
Lefarnes atzmo. betzarche seudda vechuppa:
Ulealmana sheloshim yom. sheenah torachat kol kach betachshiteha, shekkevar yesh beyadah:
Velo nissau. shehabbealim meakkevim. veayde detana resha bedidhi tana sefa nammi bedidhi:

Veochelet batteruma. veim kohen hu vehi yisreelit, shemmishshaa shekkiddeshah ochelet batteruma min hattora, dichtiv (sham 22) vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo, vehay kinyan kaspo hu, ella derabbanan gazur al bat yisrael hameoreset lechohen shello tochal batteruma, gezera shemma yimzegu lah kos bevet aviha vetashke leacheha uleachyoteha, ucheshehiggia hazzeman velo nisset, sheochelet mishshello, enah ochelet bevet aviha, ella balah kohen meyached lah makom umaachilah sham, velekka lemigzar tu shemma tashke mikkos shel teruma leacheha uleachyoteha:
Notnim lah hakkol teruma. im yirtze. uchesheyyaggiu yeme tumatah timkerenna vetikkach chullin:
Rabbi akiva omer mechetza chullin. leechol bime tumatah:
Lo vammikdash. lefi sheenan reuyin, sheen makrivin bammikdash ella min hammuvchar:
Velo vammedina. sheenan mumin kevuim lehafekia kedushshatan. ella mannichin oto ad sheyyippol bahen mum acher kavua veyihyu nishchatim alav:
Garav. min shechin lach mibbachutz umibbifnim. vegarav haamur battora dahave mum, hu shechin yavesh:
Yabbelet. beloven haayin, veen bah sear. uleel dachashiv la bammumin sheshshochatin alav, mayre deyesh bah sear:

Uvaal chazazit. tere gavne chazazit havu. chazazit hammitzrit hi yallefet hakketuva vattora shehu lach mibbachutz veyavesh mibbifnim, vehave muma delo hadar bari, deamar mar lamma nikra shemah yallefet shemmelappefet veholechet ad yom hammita. vachazazit hashshenuya chan hi min shechin sheyyesh lah refua:
Umezoham. sheyyotze mimmennu reach ra:
Veshenneevda vo avera. sherava et haishsha o shehemit et haadam al pi ed echad, sheen lo ella ed echad lo barvia velo vannegicha:

O al pi atzmo. sheen sham ed, ella habbealim amru reinuhu shennirba o shehemit. veeno niskal al pihem. vei havu shenayim edim kesherim meidim baddavar have hashshor biskila, vaafillu bahanaa mittasar:
Vetumtum veanderoginos. disfek zachar hem vekaddeshe, sefek nekeva velo kaddeshe:
En lecha mum gadol mizze. aanderoginos kae. [dimkom] nakvut have chemum, vehave chivchor baal mum, venishchat bammedina veasur begizza vaavoda:
Vachachamim omrim eno vechor. divriyya bifne atzmah hu. venigzaz veneevad. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vechen hammassi et hayetoma. gabbay tzedaka:
Im yesh bakkis. shel tzedaka:

Regel echad yekayyem, shelosha yotzi veyitten ketubba. ha matnitin mefarshim lah baggemara hachi, regel echad yekayyem, bamme devarim amurim, beeshet yisrael, aval bechohenet, shenayim yekayyem, shelosha yotzi veyitten ketubba. umatnitin rabbi yehuda hi dimfalleg ben yisrael lechohenet, velet hilchata kevateh:
Mi sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz vechulei. dachamishshin deavdin tavin kematayim delo avdin:

Vechol mi shetztzarich littol veeno notel vechulei. kegon sheddochek atzmo bimlacha umistappek bemaase yadav kede shello yitparnes meacherim. aval im en maase yadav maspikin lo umesaggef atzmo bechayye tzaar kerovin lemita, al ze amru kol hatztzarich littol veeno notel hare ze shofech damim, veasur lerachem alav, al nafsheh lo chayyes kol shekken al acherim:
Hare zo osa veochelet. shettikkenu mezonot tachat maase yadeha, lefichach osa veochelet ledivre hakkol:
Hammotar. hikdish et motar maase yede ishto ma shehi osa yoter al harauy limzonoteha, velo hikdish maase yadeha atzman:
Rabbi meir omer hekdesh. desavar adam makdish davar shello va laolam. veen ken halacha, ella halacha kerabbi yochanan ben hassandelar deamar chullin, sheen adam makdish davar shello va laolam:
Ma sherauy litten lah. issur nechasim:
Im hissi. haav bechayyav:

Et habbat harishona yinnaten vechulei. ben shehu pachut meissur ben shehu yoter. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda deazlinan batar umdan dateh deav. veim i efshar laamod al umdan dato shel av, yahavinan lah issur nechasim demishtakkeche hasheta bishat nissueha mimmekarkee. aval mimmetaltele en lah issur. veikka leman deamar devazzeman hazze mimmetaltele nammi it lah issur. veim nisset velo tava min hayyorshim, tovaat leachar shennisset, velo amrinan achole achala gabbayhu. vedavka keshehayta nizzonit minnichse aviha, aval im pasku hayyorshim millatet lah mezonot [achole achala ella im ken machata]. veim hayta vogeret sheen lah mezonot veamda venisset velo tava ma sherauy lah lindunyatah minnichse aviha, achole achala gabbe yorshim veenah yechola litboa od, vaafillu hayta nizzonet minnichsehem:
Hazzovan. hannartek shehaggid shel behema chavuy bo. keshennifgam have mum delo hadar bari, aval nittal lo have mum, dechozer leetano:
Erya shel nekeva. bet haerva habbolet lachutz venire al shear shetach hagguf:
Bemukdashim. bishar kadashim sheyyesh bahen nekeva, kegon shelamim, deillu vabbechor lekka nekeva:
Aval lo min happerek. denifgam ben happerakim maale arucha, keshello nechtach kol hazzanav:
O shehaya rosh hazzanav maftzil etzem. hazzanav hattaluy lematta niklaf haor uvasar venishar haetzem megulle, shuv en maale arucha, hoil uverosh hazzanav hu:
Maftzil. kemo asher pitztzel [bereshit 30]. perush acher, shennechelak hazzanav bekatzehu lishte zenavot uvechol achat mishshetehen etzem:
Uven chulya lechulya melo etzba. shechulyot shel zanav rechokot zo mizzo melo etzba, dehaynu rochav gudal:
Hammoredet. mittashmish. aval mimmelacha kofin otah laasot melacha velo dayninan lah kemoredet:
Tarpeikin. kol tarpeik hu mishkal arbaim ushemone seorot shel kesef tzaruf, kemishkal shelosha darkemonim shekkorin baaravi 250, shekkol darkemon shesh esre seorot benoniyyot shel kesef:
Ad keneged ketubbatah. veachar kach noten lah get veyotza belo chetubba. aval eno mashhe otah kede lifchot al hannechasim shennaflu lah mibbet aviha ulehafsidam mimmenna:

Mosifin al ketubbatah shelosha dinarim. mishshum detzaara degavra kashe keshehu nimna min hattashmish yoter mitztzaara deitteta, lefichach keshehi moredet umetzaarto pochatin lah shiva dinarin, ucheshehu mored umetzaarah en mosifin lah ella shelosha dinarim. vehecha demoredet amrinan baggemara chazru venimnu sheyyihyu machrizin aleha arba shabbatot zo achar zo bevatte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot veomer pelonit marda bevalah, vesholchin lah mibbet din heve yodaat sheafillu ketubbatech mea mane hifsadt et kullan, achat arusa veachat nesua, vaafillu nidda vaafillu chola vaafillu shomeret yavam. vekodem hacheraza modiim lah sherotzim lehacheriz aleha, veachar hacheraza modiin otah shekkevar shalma hahachraza, veim amda vemirdah tetze belo chetubba:
Hayyavam eno maachil batteruma. beodah shomeret yavam, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo, vehay kinyan achiv hu:
Asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal. mehanach shenem asar chodesh hakkevuim lah mishshettevaah habbaal:

O afillu chullan bifne habbaal veechad bifne hayyavam. af al gav derubba bifne habbaal, sof sof lo nitchayyev bimzonoteha bechayyav. vehu haddin nammi im nitchayyev bechayyav lo achla mishshemmet, dekinyan kaspo paka, ella dei chullam bifne habbaal hava achla miha bechayyav:
O chullan bifne hayyavam. veen tzarich lomar im hayu chullan bifne hayyavam:
Zo mishna rishona. demishshehiggia zeman ochelet batteruma:

En haishsha ochelet. dechayshinan shemma yimtza vah mum venimtzet zara lemafrea, shehaya mikcho mekkach taut. ulemishna rishona shemma yimtza vah mum lo chayshinan, velekka lemechash nammi shemma tashke leacheha uleachyoteha, deha meyached lah ducheta, hilkach share lah leechol batteruma mishshehiggia zeman:
Hallokeach lezera. lakach tevua lezarah patur bidmay, deillu tevel vadday asur lizroa:
Velivhema. lakach mittechilla lehaachil livhema patur min haddemay. aval lakach mittechilla leadam venimlach aleha livhema chayyav leasser bidmay:
Vekemach leorot. leabbed bo orot:

Mikkeziv ulehallan. keziv hu sof hammakom shekkavshu ole bavel, umishsham ulehallan kavshu ole mitzrayim velo kavshu ole bavel, velo nitchayyevu bidmay ella haaratzot shekkavshu ole bavel bilvad, hilkach mikkeziv ulehallan patur min haddemay velo chayshinan shemma mipperot haaretz shekkavshu ole bavel holichu lesham, shechezkat chutza laaretz patur ad sheyyivvada lecha shehu chayyav vechezkat eretz yisrael chayyav, ad sheyyivvada lecha shehu patur:
Challat am haaretz. shettikken lo gabbal chaver verotze littenah lechohen chaver, patur milleasser:
Vehamedumma. am haaretz shennafla lo sea shel teruma lefachot mimmea sein shel chullin, shennaasa hakkol medumma kelomar eruv teruma, venoten hakkol lakkohen, patur milleasser demay:
Vehallakuach bechesef maaser. shellakach demay bemaot shel maaser sheni, ben bimot maaser sheni shel demay ben bimot maaser sheni shel vadday, patur milleasser:
Usheyare menachot. shehakkometz lammizbeach vehashsheyarim neechalim lakkohanim, velo chayshinan shemma hevi am haaretz davar sheeno metukkan:
Shemen arev. shemen afarsemon. veyesh mefarshim shemen zayit meorav im mor vaahalot uvesamim:
Chavarvad. kemin tippin levanot baayin. targum lavan, chivar:
Vehammayim. hayyordim el haayin umonim harut:
Hakkevuim. attarvayhu kae, achavarvad vehammayim:

Bodkin oto shelosha feamim betoch shemonim yom. bechol esrim veshiva yom shehu shelish hazzeman shel shemonim yom bekeruv bodkim oto im halach hachavarvad. veim halach, af al pi shechazar, monin lo shemonim yom miyyom shechazar. veen hachavarvad kavua ad sheyyaamod shemonim yom. vei lo bedakuhu betoch shemonim yom, af al pi shennimtza hachavarvad sham beyom shemonim lo have mum, deshemma bentayim halach vechazar. vahalacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos:
Ellu hen hammayim hakkevuim. kelomar bemay yadinan i kevuim o ovrim:
Achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim. im heechiluhu lirfua teven vechatzir shekkorin 156 belaaz:
Lach. haggadel baadar vachatzi nisan:
Veyavesh. haggadel beelul vachatzi tishre:

Shel geshamim. hayenu sheggadel bisde vet habbaal. umatnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim hare ze mum, shel bet hashshelachin eno mum. vedigshamim nammi, achal yavesh veachar kach achal lach eno mum, ad sheyyochal yavesh achar hallach:
Shel bet hashshelachin. eretz hatztzericha lehashekot lo have refua, velo badkinan beh:
Achal yavesh veachar kach lach. lirfua, en zo refuato, veaf al pi shello nitrappe vechach eno mum:

Ad sheyyochal yavesh achar hallach. zo hi derech refuato, teven vechatzir haggadel baadar vachatzi nisan maachilin oto baadar vachatzi nisan, veteven vechatzir haggadel beelul vachatzi tishre maachilin oto beelul vachatzi tishre. delo shachtinan leh ad sheyyaavru alav kol yeme hakkayitz veyivdok bishnehem, veim lo nitrappe have mum. vetzarich sheyyochal mehem lo pachot mikkaggerogeret bechol seudda useudda kol shelosha chodashim bitchillat hasseudda uleachar sheshshata, velo yihye kafut beshaa sheochel haasavim hallalu lirfua, velo yihye yechidi ella im chaverav, bassade velo vetoch hair. veim shalmu kol hattenaim hallalu velo nitrappe have mum veshochatin alav:
Metziat haishsha. virushshatah. im nafla lah yerushsha:
Hu ochel perot bechayyeha. vehakkeren shellah:
Ufegamah. chabbala sheyyesh bah pechat damim sheshshamin otah kamma hayta yafa limmacher bashshuk vechamma hi shava achshav:
Uvizman shebbaggaluy. shehabboshet shello. veod, shennimeset alav vehu sovlah:
Yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. bechayyeha, vehakkeren shellah lichsheyyamut o yegarshenna. veim tamut hi, yorshah. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Neemanim. haaniyyim lomar chittim hallalu shel leket shichcha ufea hen, ufeturim min hammaaser:
Bishatan. bishat hakkatzir:
Bechol shenato. beshana shelishit uveshana shishshit, shemmasar ani noheg bahen:

Uven levi neeman leolam. demaaser rishon noheg bechol shana, vechevan deamar shel maaser rishon hem lo chayshinan shemma lo hifrish mehen terumat maaser, dechi hechi delo nechshedu yisrael al teruma gedola, kach lo nechshad ben levi al terumat maaser:
Ella al davar shebbene adam nohagin ken. nohagim latet lahem ken, velo al davar sheen regilim latet lahem kayyotze vo, ulekamman mefaresh veazel:
Laarkov. lakkesher haelyon shehu mekom chibbur hayyarech im hashshok. uchenegdo vaggamal nikkar sheyyesh lo cheneged arkuva elyona zo etzem bolet lachutz:
Kol marbit haagalim ken. kol tarbut agalim uminhagan sheyyehe zenavan maggia learkov [hilkach betzir mehachi have muma], ucheshehen gedelot nimtachot ad lematta:
Shebbeemtza hayyarech. hu hakkefitz haelyon shepperashti dichnegdo vaggamal nikkar:

Al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor. af al gav ditnan beresh pirkin al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor, hadar tanye hacha. mishshum ditnan shelosha hosif vechulei‏ veamru lo lo shamanu et ellu, hadar vechallinhu lomar sheaf al ellu mumin shochatim:

Kama sheyyesh bah satayim ushechachah eno shichcha. deyalfinan shichchat kama mishshichchat omer, ma omer sheyyesh bo satayim eno shichcha, af kama sheyyesh bah satayim enah shichcha, veshichchat kama yalfinan la mikkera dichtiv (sham) veshachachta omer bassade, lerabbot shichchat kama:

Tofeach. min kitnit dak meod, vekorin lo baaravi 96. uvekama shel seorim ayre shennishtaddefu venaasu dakkot ketofeach, vaafillu hachi roim otam keillu hen gassim kishar seorim, veim keshennachashov otan gassim kishar seorim yihye vahen satayim, af al pi sheachshav shehem shedufot en bahem satayim, lo have shichcha. veen lefaresh deshel tofeach mammash yechashvu keillu hem kisorim haggassim, ella bisorim shennishtaddefu venaasu ketofeach, dehachi amrinan bayrushalmi roim et hashshedufot keillu hen meleot:
Anava shel seorim. anava bevav kemo anava bevet, kelomar garger seorim:

Chatmo shennikkav vechulei. vehu shennikkevu mechitztzot hachitzoniyyot shel chotem, shehannekev nire mibbachutz. aval eno nire ella mibbifnim kegon shennikkevah mechitztza hacholeket et hachotem, eno mum, shesseter hu, vaanan yalfinan mikkelal uferat uchelal demumin shebbaggaluy bainan:
Shennifgam. veyesh bo chesron:
Shennisdak. veen bo chesron. veshiur pegima, kede shettachgor bah tzipporen:
Sefato. shura chitzona shel safa. kelomar chuddah hachitzon:
Chittav hachitzoniyyot. hashshinnayim shebbeemtza happe:
Shennifgemu. nechesru:
Nigmemu. nimmoku, velo nishar mehem ella roshem muat, veenan boltot kemo shergilim lihyot:
Vehappenimiyyot. shinnayim haggedolot shekkorin 681, shenneekru legamre. aval nifgemu venigmemu lo have mum:

En bodkin min hammatimot velifnim. shinnayim haggedolot sheachat niret kishtayim vaasuyot kitomot, mishsham velifnim eno nechshav mum mippene shehu seter. vehen atzman shenneekru lo have mum. veen halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos:

Yotze dofen vehabba acharav. derech rechem. kegon shekkaru ishsha shetteomim bevitnah, uleachar shehotziu harishon derech dofen yatza hashsheni derech rechem. aval lehotzi valad min haishsha derech dofen veshettitrappe haishsha vetachazor vetitabber veteled, katav rambam dei efshar:

Shenehem enan bechor. rishon lo have bechor lannachala, veyaldu lo bainan. vesheni nammi lo, reshit ono bainan. uvechor lakkohen rishon lo have, defeter rechem bainan. vesheni nammi lo have bechor lakkohen, divchor larechem veeno bechor lavveladot kegon ze shehaya valad kodem lachen, eno bechor:
Rabbi shimon omer harishon lannachala. savar veyaldu af yotze dofen bemashma:
Vehashsheni lechamesh selaim. savar bechor larechem af al pi sheeno bechor lavveladot have bechor. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Vehu fosek kenegdan chamishsha asar mane. elef dinar hen asara mane, ucheshebba hechatan lekabbel alav velichtov bakketubba, kotev shelish yoter, shehen chamesh esre mane, im hichnisa lo hakkalla dinarin beayin, mippene shehu mistakker bahen:

Ucheneged hashshum. veim hichnisa lo begadim vetachshitim shetztzerichin shuma, hu fosek pachot chomesh, sheim hichnisa shum shel elef zuz eno mekabbel alav ella shemone meot, shedderech habbaim lashum habbegadim unechasim shel hakkalla leshumam yoter mishshavyam lichvod hakkalla ulechabbevah al balah:
Shum bemane veshave mane. kelomar im lo shamu nichse hakkalla vetachshiteha ella kemo shehem shavim bashshuk:
En lo ella mane. lo yichtevu bishtar hakketubba ella mane kemo sheshshamu:

Shum bemane hi notenet sheloshim veechad sela vedinar. shum shehu mekabbelah bemane, sheamru lo ketov mane bakketubba vehi tachnis lecha shum shel mane, tzarich sheyyashumu oto bevet hachatuna sheloshim veechad sela vedinar, shehu mane vechumsho:
Uvearba meot. shum, kesheyyekabbel alav hechatan lichtov arba meot. hi notenet chamesh meot lefi shumat hannoadim:
Ucheshechatan posek vechulei. veim shamu hem techilla vehichnisa lo, ben shum katan ben shum gadol, hu kotev bashshetar pachot chomesh:
Hammedel baggefanim. keshehaggefanim techufim ze achar ze oker meotam shebbentayim vehaacherim metukkanim bechach:

Kach hu medel beshel aniyyim. af al pi sheyyesh bahem pea o ollot shel aniyyim, kach medel beshellahem kemo veshello, kasavar aniyyim din shuttaf yesh lahem, ucheshem sheshshuttaf kemo shehu medel beshello kach medel beshel chavero af aniyyim ken:
Rabbi meir omer beshello hu rashshay. kasavar aniyyim din kone yesh lahem bechelkam, ucheshem shehammocher lachavero asara eshkolot asur ligga bahen af beshel aniyyim ken. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Veim yesh lo hare ze chasher. vehu shettihye shittat hassear hammakkefet meozen leozen meachorav, velo lefanav. ditfe have noy kesheyyesh lo laachorav velo lefanav yoter mikkesheyyesh lo seviv kol harosh uvaemtza kereach. vechol shekken deyesh lo lefanav velo laachorav defasul:
Gevinim. gabbot haayin:
Sheggevinav shochvim. shessaarot gevinav arukkim umuttalim al enav:

Mi sheyyesh lo shene gabbim ushete shidraot. lo sheyyesh lo shene gabbim mammash, dehahu lo chaye. ella chegon sheshshidrato akumma umechaze chegabbin veshidraot harebe. vechulle alma modu dechol hane mume dachashive hane tannae have mum, umashmaut dorshim bilvad ikka benayhu, dechol chad savar shehammum shehu mone hu gibben haamur battora:
Mumin ellu. happoslin babbechor, poslim bechohen laavoda, ben kevuim ben ovrim kol zeman shehen alav:
Hakkilon. sherosho chad millemala verachav lematta. vedome lechissuy shel chavit shekkaruy achla, lefichach nikra kilon:
Vehallaftan. sherosho dome lelefet, sherchava millemala veholechet vechala millematta:
Makkavan. sheddome rosho lemakkevet, shebbolet happaddachat lachutz vechen arpo meachorav, velitzdaav shave rosho, vedome lefattish dehaynu makkevet sheyyotze millefanav umeacharav:

Verosho shakut. garsinan. yesh mefarshim sherosho bolet harebe veyotze lachutz kelappe panav. veyesh mefarshim sheeno bolet kelal lefanav, keinyan shekifas meachorav sheen rosho bolet meachorav kelal, vehu mechussar, sheddome kemi shennechtach mimmennu chaticha meachorav. uleshon shekifas, shekol pisa [sanhedrin sad:], shennittela mimmennu chaticha. uvattosefta mone gam ken tzavvar shakua, sherosho muttal ben ketefav vedome chemi sheen lo tzavvar:

Uvaale hachatoteret rabbi yehuda machshir. kesheyyesh etzem bachatoteret kulle alma lo felige dahava mum. ki felige besheen bah etzem. rabbi yehuda savar chatichat basar bealma hi, verabbanan savre amar kera (Vayikra 21) kol ish asher bo mum mizzera aharon, hashshave vezaro shel aharon yaavod, vesheeno shave vezaro shel aharon lo yaavod. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hakkallin shebbaddemay. shehekellu chachamim al happerot hallalu hannizkarim bematnitin shello leasseran demay, lefi shechezkatan baim min hahefker, mishshum delo chashive, veit behu tere sefeke, safek baim min hahefker ufeturim min hammaaser, vaafillu im timtza lomar shebbaim min hashshamur vechayyavim bemaaser, shemma nitasseru. udemay hem hattevua vehapperot hannilkachim meamme haaretz shehem chashudim al hammaasrot. vehechaver hallokeach perot meamme haaretz tzarich lehaferish mehem terumat maaser umaaser sheni bilvad im hi shenat maaser sheni, aval teruma gedola lo nechshedu amme haaretz aleha lefi shehi bemita, veen lah shiur shechitta achat poteret kol hakkeri, vehakkol nizharim bah. umaaser rishon umaasar ani eno tzarich lehotzi min haddemay af al pi sheamme haaretz chashudim alehem, lefi sheyyachol baal happerot lomar lallevi o leani habbaim littol hammaasrot, have reaya sheen perot hallalu meussarim vettol, dekayma lan bechol ducheta hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. aval bitrumat maaser lekka lememar hachi, shehaochel tevel shello huremu mimmennu mattenot kehunna chayyav mita umishshum issura mafrishinan la litrumat maaser, umaaser sheni nammi kede shello leachlo betuma o shello leachlo chutz lirushalayim:
Hashshitin. teenim midbariyyot:
Veharimin. peresh hearuch pavelatzeraakay belaaz:
Veuzradin. baaravi 287 uvelaaz 578:
Uvenot shuach. teenim levanot hammitgaddelot mishshalosh shanim leshalosh shanim, umitgaddelim bayarim:
Uvenot shikma. teena hammurkevet bearmon:
Venovlot temara. temarim sheenam mitbashshelin bailan vetolshin otan umannichim otam ze al ze ad sheyyitbashshelu. veyesh omrim novlot temara temarim shehippilatan haruach kodem bishshulan:
Gufnim. anavim shemmannichim otan baggefen besof habbatzir uvekoshi mitbashshelim:
Hannitzpa. tzalaf shekkorin 401 belaaz:
Haog. peri adom shekkorin lo belaaz 413. verambam omer shehu ilan sheose kemin eshkolot adummot adummot vekorin lo baaravi 207. velo haya ze happeri chashuv bihuda:
