Vehachometz. bitchilla lo haya hayyayin shebbihuda machmitz lefi shehayu meviim mimmennu nesachim, vechol hachometz shebbihuda lo haya ba ella min hattemed, lefichach hachometz shebbihuda patur. aval leachar shebbatlu nesachim vehachometz ba min hayyayin, hachometz chayyav bidmay af bihuda kemo vishar mekomot:
Vehakkusbar. kizra gad (Shemot 16) targum yerushalmi kusbar, 327 belaaz:
Deyufera. shettoen perotav shene feamim bashshana. deyu bilshon yavan shenayim:
Shikmona. shem makom:
Hammustafos. shennitbashshelu bailan ad shennitbakkeu mealehen. shekkol ellu chashuvim hen vechezkatan sheen bain min hahefker. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo. al hanaat tashmish en hanneder chal, mishshum dimshubad lah velav kol kemineh lehafekia shibudo. veal hanaat mezonot af al gav dimshubad lah ashkechan dechal hanneder, kegon shemmaspikin maase yadeha limzonoteha. uvaggemara parech im ken lamma yaamid parnas, umeshane, kegon sheen maspikin lidvarim shehayta regila vahem bevet aviha, veal ze bilvad yaamid parnas sheyyefarnesenna. velo sheyyaamid shaliach lefarnesah, shehare shelucho shel adam kemoto, ella sheomer kol hamefarnes eno mafsid:
Yater mikken yotzi veyitten ketubba. dead sheloshim yom lo shame eynashe velekka ziluta. tefe mishsheloshim yom shame eynashe veikka ziluta:
Beyisrael. im yisrael hu sheyyachol lehachazir et gerushato:
Uvechohenet. sheim yegarshenna lo yuchal lehachazirah, yahavu leh rabbanan zimna tefe. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ezo hi olelet. haamura battora (sham) vecharmecha lo teolel:

Katef. hashsharvit haemtzai shel haeshkol mechubbarim bo eshkolot ketannot harebe, ucheshehen shochvim ze al ze kemasseoy sheal ketefo shel adam hu nikra katef, ucheshehen mefuzzarim bashsharvit echad lechan veechad lechan en kan katef:

Natef. hen gargerim shel anavim hamechubbarim besof hashsharvit shergilim lihyot teluyim sham anavim harebe, veal shem sheanavav notfot lematta nikra natef, uvilshon mikra kore leeshkol sheen lo lo chatef velo natef olel, lefi shehu lifne shear haeshkolot keolal lifne haish:
Im safek. shennirim haeshkolot hakketannot hatteluyot bashsharvit keillu shochvot zo al zo veen shochvot yafe, dehashta have safek im yesh lah katef im lav:
Shebbaarkubba. yichur shel zemora shetteluyin bah eshkolot harebe vehabbotzer kotztzah, vehi nikret arkubba, ufeamim sheyyesh bah ollot im haeshkolot:
Nikretzet. niktzetzet venechtechet, vedugmato shaninu beyoma (lo:) keratzo umerek acher shechita al yado. uvammikra (yirmeya 46) keretz mitztzafon ba:
Garger yechidi. kegon eshkol sheen lo eshkolot ketannot shochvot zo al zo ella haggargerim mechubbarim bashsharvit atzmo:
Rabbi yehuda omer eshkol. dichtiv (yeshaya 17) venishar bo ollot kenokef zayit shenayim shelosha gargerim. shenayim shelosha gargerim ollot, yoter mikkan eshkol:
Vachachamim omrim olelet. delo chashive haggargerim hashshochvim ze al ze lehikkare katef. vahalacha kachachamim:
Noten lah maa chesef. bechol shabbat letzorech devarim ketannim:
Veochelet immo lele shabbat. af al gav divchol shear hayyamim yachol latet mezonoteha al yede shalish im yirtze, belel shabbat shehu lel ona chayyav leechol immah:
Maase yadeha. motar maase yadeha, kelomar ma sheosa yoter al mezonoteha:
Sheti. kashe litvot kiflayim keshel erev. umishkal shel yehuda kiflayim keshel galil:
Hakkol lefi chevodo. uchefi minhag hammedina nammi:
Shennoel befaneha. delet shel simcha vahasarat yagon. ulevet haevel noel befaneha, shellemachar hi meta veen adam sofdah:
Mechamat davar acher. kegon deitchazzak shebbene adam perutzim metzuyin sham:
Shettomri lifloni vechulei. devarim shel kallut:

Shettehe memallea umeara laashpa. it dimfarshe leachar shetteshammesh vimalle rachmah shichvat zera tenappetzennu kede shello yiklot hazzera vetitabber. veit dimfarshe shettemalle asara chadde mayim uteare laashpa, mippene shenniret keshota:
Shello titkashshet beachad mikkol hamminim. [sheamra hi] konam bosem peloni alay, vehu kiyyem lah:
Baaniyyot shello natan kitzba. laddavar, ad matay asaro aleha, hu deyotzi veyitten ketubba. aval im natan kitzba, tamtin ad oto zeman. vechamma kitzba, shenem asar chodesh:
Uvaashirot sheloshim yom. shekken ishsha chashuva nehenet mereach kishshuteha sheloshim yom, vezot tehane mereach hakkishshutim shennitkashsheta lifne hanneder sheloshim yom. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Yater al chulekehon deim achuhon. im tamuti bechayyay veirashech, yittelu vanayich ketubbatech achare moti kesheyyavou lachalok binchasay im banim sheyyihyu li meishsha acheret. venafka minnah, kegon shekketubba shel zo merubba mishshel acheret o shebbene haishsha acheret merubbim mibbaneha shel zot, vetov laellu sheyyittelu ketubbat imman vaafillu hakketubbot shavot. veen ketubbat benin dichrin nigbet afillu bazzeman hazze ella mimmekarkee, aval lo mimmetaltele. vedavka keshehinniach haav shiur shete hakketubbot vedinar yoter, az yorshin habbanim ketubbat benin dichrin, hoil venishar makom lirushsha shel tora, sheachar sheyyittol kol echad mehabbanim ketubbat immo nishar dinar lachalok velirash benichse avihen, aval im lo hinniach haav ella cheshiur shete hakketubbot o pachot mizze cholkim hannechasim beshave veen ketubbat benin dichrin noheget bahem:

Kerem revai. hannotea kol etz maachol, bashshana harviit maale happerot lirushalayim veochlam sham bikdushshat maaser sheni, o pode otam umaale haddamim lirushalayim, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) uvashshana harviit yihye kol piryo kodesh hillulim, vedarshinan hillulim kemo chilulim, amar rachamana achaleh vehadar achleh:
Bet shammay omrim en lo chomesh. af al pi shettaun pidyon kemaaser sheni en habbealim mosifim et hachomesh delo katva tora vo chomesh:
Veen lo viur. eno chayyav levaaro min habbayit beerev pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit keshemmevaer hammaasrot kedichtiv (Devarim 26) biarti hakkodesh min habbayit:

Uvet hillel omrim yesh lo. chomesh veyesh lo viur. bet hillel yalfe kodesh kodesh mimmaaser, ma maaser yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur, af kerem revai yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur, uvet shammay lo yalfe kodesh kodesh mimmaaser:
Yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot. dichchullin chashve leh:
Vehaaniyyim podin leatzman. min happeret vehaollot shellaktu, veochlim otan bimkoman umaalin haddamim lirushalayim:

Uvet hillel omrim kullo laggat. mishshum deyalfe mimmaaser vesavre lehu maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu hilkach en laaniyyim chelek bo, vedorchim haollot im shear hayyayin vehabbealim maalim hakkol lirushalayim:
Hammashlish maot levitto. masar maot beyad shalish letzorech bitto liknot lah sade o neduneya lichshettinnase:
Neeman bali alay. utenem lo:
Yaase shalish kulei. yikne hassade. veen shomin lah, demitzva lekayyem divre hammet:

Vechi enah ella sade. kelomar afillu kevar nikna hassade vehi rotza lemachrah yechola limkor, hilkach shomin lah. ufelugta derabbi yose verabbi meir davka bigdola min haerusin, deillu leachar shennisset divre hakkol shomin lah. uviktanna nammi mode rabbi yose deen bemaase ketanna kelum veen shomin lah. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Tochenet. berechayim shel yad shehem ketannim. veim rechayim gedolim hem, mechina kol tzarche hattechina, kegon notanto baafarkeset vekoletet hakkemach:
Hichnisa lo shifcha achat. maot o nechasim kede liknot bahem shifcha achat:

Yoshevet bakkattedra. al kisse menucha veenah holechet bishlichuto lechan ulechan, veaf al pi chen mozeget lo et hakkos umatztzaat lo et hammitta verochetzet lo panav yadav veraglav, shemmelachot ellu en mishtammeshim bahem beishsha ella beishto bilvad:

Shiamum. behala. targum uvetimhon levav (Devarim 28) uveshaamimut libba. ufelugetayhu derabbi eliezer verabban shimon ben gamliel have beishsha sheena betela ella mesacheket bemine hatztzechok, delide zimma ikka, lide shimum lekka, sheen shimum ella beyoshev vetohe uvatel legamre. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:

Meematay hannemoshot. it dimfarshe zekenim haholchim al mishantam. veit dimfarshe likkute vatar likkute. shemmeachar sheyyelchu bassade loktim achar loktim o hazzekenim hallalu shemmeacharim lalechet lelakket achar hakkol kevar nityaashu haaniyyim meotah sade, vechol hannimtza vah achar kach hu hefker lakkol, ben laaniyyim ben laashirim:

Revia sheniyya. hammatar nikra revia mippene shehu rovea et haaretz umolidah umatzmichah kezachar harovea et hannekeva vehi mitabberet mimmennu, leshon behemtecha lo tarbia (Vayikra 19). perush acher revia al shem shehammatar mashkiv heafar umarbitzo, targum rovetz revia. uzeman revia sheniyya beshana benonit hu bechg bemarcheshvan:
Sheenan moskin. mesika bezetim kemo kotzer bitvua, botzer baanavim, ore bitenim, goder bitmarim, kach mosek bezetim:

Velo yehe mevi bearbaa issarot. dehaynu shene funedyonim, shehappunedyon shene issarin, utenan en pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom mikkikkar befunedyon, dehaynu mezon shete seuddot, vechevan sheeno mevi zetim shave arbaa issarot, dehaynu mezon shete seuddot lo ushete seuddot leishto, af hu eno yotze lilkot. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Midda zo. deen pochatin leani amura bechohanim leviyyim veyisreelim, kol echad mehem shemmechallek masar ani baggoren lo yifchot mizze hashshiur:
Haya matztzil. sheen rotze lechallek laaniyyim shebbau kol masar ani shebbeyado, verotze lehatztzil mimmennu likrovav haaniyyim:
Notel mechetza. umatznia letzorech kerovav:

Venoten mechetza. laaniyyim shebbau. veim leachar shennatal mechetza vehitznia letzorech kerovav haya lo davar muat, kelomar shello nishar lo kede latet lechol echad min haaniyyim shebbau kashshiur hakkatzuv leel bematnitin, noten lifnehem ma shennishar beyado vehen mechallekim benehem:

Akura. telusha, vesheenah akura mechubberet lakkarka, enan mitztarfin lesatayim venema delo havo shichcha, ella im shechachan havo shichcha. vedavka beshachach shenehem, deim shachach akura velo shachach sheenah akura hayta sheenah akura matztzelet al haakura sheetzlah:
Vechen bailan. sea perot telushin etzel sea mechubbarin en mitztarfin, vahavo shichcha:

Vehashshum vehabbetzalim. sea kama shel shum usea kama shel betzalim en mitztarfin lesatayim kama. i nammi sea shum akur usea shum sheeno akur, vechen sea betzalim akurim usea betzalim sheenan akurin, en mitztarfin:
Im bat. kegon sheyyesh leket ben sea lisa, vechen becherem yesh peret ben sea lisa. aval beferot hailan lo mashkachat reshut ani baemtza, deen leket uferet bailan. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
En lo vetzim o en lo ella vetza echat. matnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, en lo shete vetzim bishte chisin ella vechis echad, i nammi shene chisin uvetza achat, hare ze mum:

Rabbi yishmael omer im yesh lo shene chisim. assefa faleg, dekaamar tanna kamma im en lo ella betza achat ushene chisin have mum, lo hi, dechol sheyyesh lo shene chisin beyadua sheyyesh lo shete vetzim. aval aresha mode dechi en lo ella chis echad kemi sheen lo ella betza achat dame:

Rabbi akiva omer. beyadua lo amrinan, ella moshivo al akkuzo garsinan. vedugmato beferek ketzad meabberin [eruvin ned] akkuzo tenan o akkuzo tenan. al akkuzo, al agvato achat moshivin et habbechor sheen lo ella betza achat bishne chisin:
Umemaech. umemashmesh bakkis uvakkesalim:
Im yesh sham betza achat sofah latzet. veim enah yotza have mum:
Vehittir rabbi akiva. dahave mum, hoil velo metzaah bimkomah keshemmiech umishmesh. vechen halacha:
Hammashre et ishto al yede shalish. shennoten mezonoteha al yede appotroppos veenah ochelet immo. targum vayyichre lahem kera gedola (Melachim 2 6), sheruta:
Lo yifchot lah. beshavua:
Lo fasak lah seorim. kiflayim min hachittim: ella rabbi yishmael shehaya samuch leedom sheshsham hasseorim raot beyoter:
Devela. teenim derusot beiggul venimkarot bemishkal velo vemidda:
Mappatz. rach mimmachatzelet:
Kippa. tzaif echad:
Uminalim mimmoed lemoed. minalim chadashim lechol shalosh regalim:
Chadashim. kashim lah bimot hachamma lefi shehem chammim, veyafim lah bimot haggeshamim:
Vehashshechakim shellah. af kesheyyikne lah chadashim, mippene shemmitkassa vahen bime niddatah:
Oto veet beno. av uveno chohen ovdim avoda beyom echad uvizman echad. veen oto veet beno babbehema kerevin beyom echad:
Uterefa. shennolad bah echad missimane terefot hammenuyin beferek ellu terefot, enah kereva al gabbe hammizbeach:
Veyotze dofen. shekkaru et immo vehotziuhu chay. babbehema, pesula lehakerava, dechi yullad ketiv, perat leyotze dofen. uvechohen hammakriv lo mippesil behachi:

Hannose nashim baavera. kohen shennasa gerusha vachalala zona, noder veoved. af al pi sheadayin lo geresh muttar laavod achar shennadar shello yehane hu mimmenna vehi mimmennu ad sheyyegaresh. vehu sheyyiddor al daat rabbim sheen lo hattara ella lidvar mitzva. velekka lemechash shemma yelech etzel chacham veyomar diltzorech devar mitzva hu shoel sheyyattiru lo et nidro, dechevan dekayma lan shehabba lehattir nidro tzarich lefaresh al ma nadar, vadday ki shama chacham demishshum shehi gerusha o zona daasura lo nadar lo share leh nidro:

Ad sheyyekabbel alav shello yehe mittamme lemetim. hacha saggi leh bekabbala, velo madderinan leh kemo gabbe nose nashim baavera. mishshum dehatam yitzro tokfo, hacha gabbe tuma en yitzro tokfo, hilkach bekabbala gereda saggi leh:
Shennittena leshachat. liktzor beodah lacha lehaachil livhema:
Laalumma. liktzor kede leesor bah omarim acherim, kemo meallemim alummim (Bereshit 37):
Agudde hashshum. shumin shellekatan kede leegod bahen shumim acherim:

Vaaguddot hashshum vehabbetzalim. im shechachan enan shichcha, dederech shumin uvetzalim sheosim mehen aguddot ketannot vechozrim veogdim bechamesh o shesh meellu hakketannot laagudda achat, veal otan hakketannot kaamar delo havo shichcha. mishshum dahave kimammer lemakom sheeno gemar melacha, deamrinan leel besof perek gadish (85 48) delo have shichcha:
Halluf. rambam amar shehu min mimmine habbetzalim:
Rabbi yehuda omer en lahem shichcha. lechol hattemunim, dichtiv sadcha, ma sade begaluy af kol begaluy, perat letamun:

Vachachamim omrim yesh lahem shichcha. ketiv sadcha demashma galuy uchetiv ketzircha demashma nammi galuy, have miut achar miut veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot, umarbinan et hattamun. uferush tamun davar shehanneechol mimmennu hu tamun tachat hakkarka, kemo hatztzenon vehabbatzal vehashshum vehallefet vechayyotze vahen. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haya vechor rodfo kulei‏ hare ze yishchot alav. velo shanu ella shebbeato bishat redifa, aval shello bishat redifa lo:
Haruyin lavo vide adam. sheyyesh lomar adam hittilam bo. kegon nismet eno, niktea yado, nisdeka azno:

Roim yisrael neemanim. yisrael haroe behemto shel kohen neeman lomar al hammumin shennaflu bivhemto shel kohen shemealehem eru veyochlennu bealav hakkohen bemumo. velo chashdinan leh shemma al yede adam ba ze hammum bechavvana veroe ze meshakker uva lehattiro kede sheyyishchatennu rabbo kohen veyaachilennu mimmennu, shehayyisrael muttar leechol min habbechor baal mum keshehakkohen noten lo mimmennu, behachi lo chashdinan leh, delilgima muetet kazo lo chayshinan sheyyeshakker haroe veyaavor avera baavur hanaat legima bilvad:

Roim kohanim. roim shehem kohanim: en neemanim. kesheroim behemtan shel yisrael. denecheshad hay kohen roe shehu atzmo hittil bo mum, dememar amar hay roe, lo shavek rabbi ledidi veyahaveh lechohen acharina. vehu haddin dechohen roe en neeman lehaid al habbechor shel kohen acher, dechayshinan legomlim, desavar aidennu achshav vihe gomel li kesheyyitten li yisrael bechor tam veattil bo mum veyavo chohen ze viideni shemmeelav nafal bo mum:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer neeman hu al shel chavero veeno neeman al shel atzmo. rabban shimon ben gamliel paleg attanna kamma, vesavar delo nechshedu chohanim ella al bechor atzmo shekkevar netano lo yisrael, aval al shel chavero ben rabbo ben acher lo nechshedu alav:

Rabbi meir omer kol hechashud al davar lo dano velo meido. veikka ben rabbi meir letanna kamma, dilrabbi meir bechor kohen shennafal bo mum tzarich shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav, veed echad afillu sheeno chohen en moil bo. uletanna kamma davka chohen eno neeman lehaid al bechoro shel kohen, dechayshinan legomlim, aval sheeno chohen afillu echad meid neeman lehattiro. verabban shimon ben gamliel omer afillu vanav uvene veto shel kohen neemanim, dedavka ihu gufeh al shel atzmo eno neeman. veishto nammi enah neemenet mippene shehi chegufo. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Ezehu feret. haamur battora (Vayikra 19) uferet karmecha lo telakket:
Akatz. chatach:
Husbach bealim. nikshar veneechaz bealim veal yede chach nafal venifrat:
Hare hu shel baal habbayit. shello nifrat derech betzira:
Hammanniach kalkala beshaa shehu votzer. noten sal tachat haanavim sheyyippol happeret letocho:
Hare ze gozel et haaniyyim. deferet binshirato zachu vo aniyyim kodem sheyyaggia laaretz:
Al tasseg gevul olim. meforash leel beferek Adonai‏ (mishna 6):
Eno rashshay. shekkevar nitchayyev befirkonah mishshennishbet:
Chayyav lerappotah. sheharfua kimzonot:
Rashshay. sheen chayyav lazun gerushato:
Mishshennodu haollot. shennikkar ma hu olelet uma hu eshkol:
Haollot laaniyyim. sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello:
Yittenu sechar giddulan lahekdesh. ma shemmashbichin kol shaa betoch karka shel hekdesh. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Bearis. kerem shehaggefanim shellah mudelot al gabbe kelunesot veetzim, leshon af arsenu raanana (Shir HaShirim 1):
Kol sheeno yachol lifshot. kelomar leachar sheavar mealeha, im bammakom shennizkar eno yachol lifshot yado velittol karena veh lo tashuv lekachto (Devarim 24):
Aval rogliyyot. haggefanim haomdim al gabbe karka sheddorchim alehem baregel:
Mishsheyyaavor mimmenna. have shichcha, dechol gefen vagefen min harogliyyot chashiva keumman bifne atzmo, veasur lashuv meumman leumman:
Achad mikkol happerot. kegon sheamra hi konam peri peloni alay, vehu kiyyem lah:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. velet hilchata kevateh:
Shekkullo ollot. sheen bechol hakkerem eshkol sheyyesh lo katef venatef:
Im en batzir. vechamma shiur batzir, shelosha eshkolot sheosim reviit:

Amar lo rabbi akiva vecharmecha lo teolel afillu chullo ollot. verabbi eliezer amar delo tema hoil veen laaniyyim baollot kodem labbatzir yizke vahem baal habbayit, lechach neemar vecharmecha lo teolel:
Hakkochel shete enav keechat. shechatmo shebben enav shakua veeno bolet kelal, ad shekkeshehu ba lehaavir michchol beenav yachol limshoch hammichchol ben ayin leayin veen hachotem meakkevo:
Shete enav lemala. begova hammetzach shello chishar bene adam:
Ushete enav lematta. min hammakom shennehugim lihyot:
Eno achat lemala. min hammakom hannahug:
Veeno achat lematta. min hammakom hannahug:

Roe et hacheder veet haaliyya cheechat. sheenav omdot bimkoman harauy aval eno achat roa lemala veeno achat lematta, cheder lematta vaaliyya lemala. vechol mi shehu meuvvat harut ose chen, shemmedabber im chavero venire cheillu mabbit bifne adam acher:
Sache shemesh. kesherotze lehabbit el hashshemesh meammetz enav vesoger afappav:

Zugedos. zug shenayim. dos bilshon romi shenayim. kelomar, hazzug shel enayim o shel gevine haayin sheddarkam lihyot shavin chaluk lishne inyanim. kegon eno achat shechora veachat keen hattechelet. beachat miggabbot enav sear merubbe uveachat meat. vechen bechol shear zugot shel evarim kol zuga delo shavu lahadade, zagdos kare leh:
Tziran. sheenav zolgot, dolfot veyordot tamid dima:
Shennashru rise enav. shennafal sear shebbeafappav:

Mippene marit haayin. aval mum gamur lo have. vehane mille keshennishar baafappayim roshem sear, aval im lo nishar roshem lassear kol ikkar, hare ze mum gamur. vechen i nefishe seare berise haayin, have mum gamur. ushelosha dinim chalukim yesh bemume adam. hammumin hashshavin baadam uvabbehema, kohen sheavar veavad bahen loke vaavodato mechullelet. vehammumin hayeterim baadam veenan babbehema, loke im avad veen avodato mechullelet. vehammumin shehen mippene marit haayin, im avar veavad eno loke, veen tzarich lomar sheen avodato mechullelet:
Neemanim. haaniyyim al hayyarak chay lomar shel masar ani hu, deyarak chayyav bemaaser midderabbanan:
Davar muat. neemanim af al hammevushshal, difamim shebbaal habbayit shachach milleasser umeasser min hammevushshal mittoch hakkedera:
Millefaso. hakkedera o happarur shemmevashshel bah:

Uvechohenet. sheeno yachol lekayyemah mishshennishbet, sheeshet kohen asura levalah mishshenneensa, kotev lah efrekinnach vaahadrinnach limdintach. vechayyav latet lah ketubbatah, veaf al pi shebbeal karcho tzarich legarshah:
Ris shel ayin. afaf shel ayin:
Hare veenav. kelomar hare sheyyesh beenav:
Dak. 50 belaaz:

Chillazon nachash. hayenu chillazon hayenu nachash, vekorehu nachash sheasuy menummar kenachash. vehu basar nosaf hannimshach vechofe ketzat min hashshachor shebbaayin, vekorin lo baaravi 290, kemo shekkorin latztzipporen tafra, lefi shehu chofe et haayin kederech shehatztzipporen chofa vesar haetzba:
Veenav. sheyyesh beeno chegargir shel enav:
Lavan happosek bassira. sira hayenu shura shebbaayin seviv hashshachor shemmishsham marit haayin baa. veim chut lavan yotze min hallavan shebbaayin ufosek otah shura venichnas bashshachor have mum:
Shachor venichnas ballavan. im chut echad shachor yotze min hashshachor shebbaayin ufosek bassira venichnas ballavan:
Eno mum sheen mumin ballavan. delav ayin hu ella shumman haayin:
Yabbelet. 592 belaaz. vaafillu hi balloven shebbaayin, veyesh bah sear, hare ze mum:
Veshennifgam etzem yado. shennikkar hammum. uleel ayre veshennishbar:

Veshennifsak atzmo shebbefiv. shehashshinnayim kevuot bo. ulemala min hachutin ka mayre. dei chutin gufayhu, dehaynu hashshinnayim atzman shebbeemtza happe, ha tenan leel daafillu nifgemu o nigmemu have mum:
Eno achat gedola. keshel egel:
Veachat ketanna. keshel avvaz:
Bemare. shennire lakkol shezzo gedola mizzo:
Aval lo vemidda. sheim eno nikkar ella vemidda, eno mum:
Velo hodu lo chachamim. lerabbi yehuda. vahalacha kachachamim:
Yesh bechor lannachala. littol pi shenayim:
Veeno vechor lakkohen. latet lakkohen pidyono chameshet selaim:

Habba achar hannefalim. kegon shehayu teomim, echad mehem nefel shello chalu lo chodashav veechad kalu lo chodashav, vehannefel shello chalu lo chodashav yatza rosho chay vehecheziro, ukedamo achiv veyatza. ze haacharon bechor lannachala, derishon lo hifsido, veaf al gav ditziat harishon chashiva leda mealleya. vetaama, mishshum dichtiv reshit ono, mi shellev aviv dave alav im met, yatza nefel shehotzi rosho rishon delav bar keyama [hu] deen libbo dave alav. aval leinyan peter rechem patur hay valad [acharon], divfeter rechem tala rachamana, vahare harishon patar et harechem:

Uven tisha met sheyyatza rosho. vehecheziro, veyatza achiv, have bechor lannachala. deha rishon la chashiv, deen libbo dave alav, uleinyan kohen lav peter rechem hu. aval yatza rosh ben tisha chay veachar kach hecheziro vamet, bechor lannachala nammi lo have ze habba acharav:
Vechen hammappelet behema kulei. lemiftar minnachala la chashive, deen hallev dave alehem, aval peter rechem miha have:
Vachachamim omrim ad sheyyehe vo mitztzurat adam. la chashiv peter rechem, vehabba acharav have bechor lakkohen. vahalacha kachachamim:
Sandal. chatichat basar asuya kidmut sandal, veen lah tzurat evarim, uregila lavo im valad. uleshon sandal yesh mefarshim sanuy vadal:
O shilya. deen shilya belo valad, ella shennimmoach, umihu peter rechem have:
Veshafir merukkam. chaticha shel basar shemmerukkam bah tzurat haubbar. veal shem sheasuya chishfoferet shel betza keruya shafir:
Vehayyotze mechuttach. shennechtach evar evar uvederech ze yatza chullo. aval rosh mechuttach, lo patar im kadam achiv veyatza kodem yetziat rov evre hamechuttach, vehave nammi bechor lakkohen:
Shekkevar yalda. dilinyan nachala deav ketiv reshit ono, uleinyan kohen tela rachamana befeter rechem:
Odah shifcha. afillu odah shifcha beleda rishona venishtachrera achshav, o nachrit venitgayyera umishshebbat leyad yisrael yalda, nammi have bechor lannachala, shehare lo hayu laze banim:
Rabbi yose haggelili omer bechor lannachala velakkohen. devanim hannoladim benachriyyutah lo patre. veen halacha kerabbi yose haggelili:

Nitgayyera meubberet. uvalah immah veyalda. hare oto valad bechor lakkohen, defeter rechem hu beyisrael. velo lannachala, dechevan dehorato shello bikdushsha lav bar nachala hu, dezera oved kochavim rachamana afkereh, dichtiv (Yechezkel 23) vezirmat susim zirmatam:
Yalda hi vechohenet. bat yisrael mevakkeret sheyyalda im kohenet mevakkeret veen yadua e ze valad shel yisrael:
O hi uleviyya. dilviyya nammi venah patur mechamesh selaim. kedaamaran beferek kamma:
O hi veishsha shekkevar yalda. veen yadua eze venah:
Bechor lakkohen. uvalah shel mevakkeret chayyav chamesh selaim lakkohen, deha ben zachar yesh lo chol hecha deiteh:
Velo lannachala. deha lo yada bereh deman hu:

Vechen mi shello shahata kulei. hu bechor lakkohen, vehu yifde et atzmo. velo lannachala, deha lo yada man yaret. vaafillu chefashut lo yaret, dehay madche leh legabbe hay vehay madche leh legabbe hay. umatnitin dekatane velo lannachala, al habba acharav kaamar, shehabba acharav eno bechor lannachala, deshemma ze hassafek ben haacharon hu:
Male geninim. male gevanim harebe. perush acher, tolaim, shehashshafir asuy kullo chatichot ketannot dakkot domot letolaim:
Dagim vachagavim. lav valad ninhu, delo neemra bahen yetzira kaadam:
Yom arbaim. mishshennitabbera, mayya bealma ninhu, veen kan valad ad lemochorat yom arbaim. dearbaim yom have yetzirat havvalad:
Paska lehachenis lo chesafim. dinarim beayin, shemmuchanin lehistakker bahen miyyad:

Sela. shehu arbaa dinarin naase likkatev bishtar hakketubba beshishsha dinarin, betosefet shelish. veashmeinan tanna divdinarin beayin, ben shehen merubbim kegon elef dinar dekatane beresha, ben shehem muatim kegon sela dekatane besefa, leolam nichtavim bishtar hakketubba bishlish yoter, mippene sheomdin lehistakker bahen miyyad. uvidvarim shetztzerichin shuma kegon begadim vetachshitim, ben shehem merubbim kegon ucheneged hashshum dekatane dekae aelef zuz deamar beresha, ben shehem muatim kegon ha dekatane shum bemane, hi notenet sheloshim veechad sela vedinar, leolam pochatin chomesh bishtar hakketubba mimma sheshshamu otam bevet hachatuna, lo shena im shamu otam techilla veachar kach bain lichtov hakketubba, sheaz tzarich lifchot bishtar hakketubba hachomesh min hashshuma sheshshamu bevet hakkalla kidkatane ucheshehechatan posek vechulei, velo shena im hu katav techilla hakketubba, sheaz tzarich shettihye hashshuma betosefet chomesh mimma shekkatuv bakketubba kidkatane uvearba meot shum hi notenet chamesh meot:
Lakkuppa. sheyyitten lah asara zuz al kol mane umane shehi mevia lo, kede liknot lah mehem besamim vetamruke hannashim. velo itparesh bematnitin im lechol shavua o lechol chodesh o lechol shana:
Neemanim al hachittim. lomar shel masar ani hem shennittan li, aval en neemanim lomar kemach ufat ze shel masar ani, shennittan li kemach ufat, deen derech lechallek masar ani kemach ufat:

Seora shel orez. it dimfarshe shibbolet shel orez, shello haya darkam lechallek orez shel masar ani ella beshibbolim. veit dimfarshe seora shel orez kodem shennichtash bammachtesh vehusera kelippato [seora kore] lo, uleachar disha beodo viklippato derech lechalleko laaniyyim:
Gerisin. shettechanan berechayim shel garosot:
Neemanim al hashshemen. shedderech lechallek masar ani beshemen:

Veen neemanim lomar shel zete nikkuf hu. zete nikkuf mimmattenot aniyyim hen, shechovtim umenakkefim bazzayit lehashshir hazzetim shennisharu min hammesika. venikkuf leshon kenokef zayit. veen heani neeman lomar shemen ze hotzeti mizzete nikkuf ufatur min hammaaser, lefi sheen regilin laasot shemen mizzete nikkuf. aval ani haomer kemach ze o fat zo milleket shichcha ufea shellakatti vetachanti kemach veafiti lechem, neeman, shedderech heani laasot lechem milleket shichcha ufea:
Af al pi. im ratza lehosif afillu mea mane yosif. velo amrinan sheeno rashshay kede shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo:
Shello chatav lah. tosefet middato, ella al menat lechansah:
Vehi chotevet. af al pi shello nitkabbela mochelet vechotevet shennitkabbela:
Rabbi meir omer kulei. vahalacha kerabbi meir bigzerotav:

Baal chamesh raglayim o shalosh. ha dechashvinan leh baal mum velo terefa, hane mille kesheyyater o chaser beyadav dehaynu otam shel tzad harosh, aval chaser regel o yater regel meraglav haacharonim, haveya terefa vaasura vaachila:
Kelutot. agullot. vaafillu hen sedukot have mum, defarsot behema tehora enan agullot:
Shachul. shennishmeta yerecho. targum meshitihu, shechalteh:
Vehakkasul. derech habbehema shehayyarech mechubberet laalya samuch lakkesalim, velo lemala min hakkesalim, vezo hayyarech al gabbe hakkesel:

Kol zayit. kezet hannetofa bishato. al shem shehu notef shemen karu lo netofa, af al pi sheeno notef bechol shana, hoil veheelu lo shem ze al shehu notef bishato, im shechacho eno shichcha, dichtiv (Devarim 24) veshachachta omer bassade, omer sheatta shochcho leolam, yatza ze sheatta zochro leachar zeman:
Shofchani. shezzetav shofchim shemen harebe:
Beshani. shehu mevayyesh kol shear ilanot merov hashshemen sheyyotze mimmennu yoter mechaverav:
Shehu ose harebe. zetim merubbim:
Shenayim shichcha. setam matnitin kevet hillel deamre leel shenayim laaniyyim:

Rabbi yose omer en shichcha lezetim. lo amar rabbi yose ella bizman shebba adriyyanus kesar vehecheriv et kol haaretz velo hayu zetim metzuyin, aval bizman shezzetim metzuyin mode rabbi yose deyesh shichcha lezetim. vechen mi shehayu kol zetav netofa o shofchani o veshani yesh lahem shichcha:
Af al pi sheeno nikkar. keshehu omed sheen hashshever nire, aval nikkar keshehu mehallech shehu tzolea. dei eno nikkar kelal lo have mum:
Mumin ellu. nishbar etzem yado veetzem raglo shehuzkeru lemala:
Ila. shem chacham:
Agol keshel adam. delav hayenu orcha sheyyehe galgal en habbehema agol keshel adam:
Rov hamedabber. hayenu oto ketzat hallashon sheeno mudbak lemalkochav:
Uvet din shel acharehen amru hare ellu mumin. vechen halacha:

Shalosh shurot shel shene malbenim. shalosh shurot shel ilane zetim uven shura rishona lishniyya aruga merubbaat kidmut malbenot hattevua shebben hazzetim ditnan leel beresh perek 3, vechen ben shura sheniyya lishlishit, veshachach ilan emtzai shebbashshura haemtzait, enah shichcha, shehailanot shessevivav histiruhu, vedami lechippuhu vekash o amdu aniyyim kenegdo ditnan leel deeno shichcha:

Bamme devarim amurim. ammatnitin dilel kamhadder ditnan bezet hannetofa bishato ushechacho eno shichcha. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shello hitchil bo, aval hitchil bo ushechacho hare zo shichcha ad sheyyihye bo satayim:

Kol zeman sheyyesh lo tachtav yesh lo verosho. im nizkar baal hazzetim min hazzetim sheshshachach bailan beod sheyyesh lo zetim tachtav yachol lachazor ulelakketan, velo chashiva shichcha ma sheshshachach berosh hailan ella leachar shello nisharu lo zetim tachat hailan:

Rabbi meir omer mishshettelech hammachave. kelomar mishshebbadak hammelakket bechol machavoe hazzetim, az have hannishar laaniyyim kesheen levaal hailan zetim tachtav, aval kol zeman shello badak hammelakket bechol machavoe hazzetim af al pi sheen zetim tachtav yachol lachazor ulelakket. veen halacha cherabbi meir:

Hakkama matztzelet et haomer. kama shello shechachah shehayta betzad omer sheshshechacho, matztzelet al haomer, delo have shichcha dichtiv (sham) ki tiktzor veshachachta omer, omer shessevivotav katzir have shichcha, velo omer shessevivotav kama:

Veet hakkama. im shachach kama vehayu rashe shibbolim shellah mechubbarim lekama acheret shello shechachah, zot hakkama shello shechachah matztzelet al hakkama hashshechucha hamechubberet eleha, velo haveya shichcha:
Haomer eno matztzil. im haya omer shachuach o kama shechucha betzad omer sheeno shachuach, en haomer sheeno shachuach matztzil lo al haomer velo al hakkama hashshechuchim:
Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta. kegon sheamar yeaser hanaat tashmishech alay. aval hanaat tashmishi asur alayich, lo mittasra, deha meshubad lah, dichtiv (Shemot 21) veonatah lo yigra:
Bet shammay omrim shete shabbatot. im hiddirah shete shabbatot tamtin, shekken matzinu beyoledet nekeva shettemea shevuayim:

Uvet hillel omrim shabbat echat. shekken matzinu bannidda shettemea shiva. vegamrinan mide dishchiach, hakkaas shekkoes adam al ishto umaddirah dehu mide dishchiach, minnidda shehu mide dishchiach, laafoke leda delo shechiach kulle hay. uvet shammay savre gamrinan mide dehu garam lah, neder haish shehu gorem lah lishhot, milleda sheal yado vaa lah. laafoke nidda demimmela kaate lah. veyoter al shabbat achat levet hillel o shete shabbatot levet shammay yotzi veyitten ketubba, vaafillu haya gammal sheonato lishloshim yom o sappan sheonato leshishsha chodashim:
Hattalmidim vechulei‏ sheloshim yom. umatnitin rabbi eliezer hi. ufelige rabbanan aleh veomrim afillu shetayim veshalosh shanim, vahalacha kachachamim:
Hattayyalim. sheen lahem melacha velo sechora:
Hachammarim. sheyyotzim lakkefarim lehavi tevua:
Haggammalim. meviin chavilot al haggemallim mimmakom rachok:

Hassappanim. hamefarshim layyam haggadol. umi shehaya vitchillato baal ummanut sheonato kerova uvikkesh leasot baal ummanut sheonato rechoka, ishto meakkevet alav, chutz mittalmud tora, sheen haishsha yechola leakkev al balah shehaya tayyal o poel shello yease talmid chacham:
Gufo gadol meevarav. shiur gufo gadol min harauy lefi shiur shear evarav kegon yadav veraglav veshokav:
Chatmo gadol. shiur hachotem keshiur etzba ketanna shel yado. veim haya aroch mikken o katzar mikken, hare ze mum:
Domot lisfog. shekkevvutzot usetumot:
Miggad almenutich. meshech almenutich:

Anshe yehuda chotvin kulei. veen halacha keanshe yehuda, ella kol zeman shello nisset veshello tava ketubbatah bevet din nizzonit mishshel balah vedara babbayit shehayta dara bechayye balah umishtammeshet bechol hakkelim shehayta mishtammeshet bahen bechayye balah:

Hammakkish bekarsullav. shearkubbotav akummot lachutz vekarsullav lifnim venokshim ze baze keshehu mehallech. umakkish bearkubbotav have ippecha, sheraglav akummim kelappe chutz umeruchakim zo mizzo ad shearkubbotav lemala [haakummot] kelappe penim nokshot zo bezo:
Baal happikin vehaikkel. veka farish ikkel beresha:
Kol shehu makkif parsotav. kesheyyoshev umekarev parsot raglav zo lazo:
Veen arkubbotav. nogot zo lazo. sheakummot kelappe chutz. uvaal happikin hu sheppika yotze miggudalo, chatichat basar agulla kefika yotza miggudal shel yado o miggudal shel raglo:
Akevo yotze meachorav. kegon sheshshoko omed beemtza raglo, shechatzi haregel lefanim vachatzi regel leachor:
Rechavot keshel avvaz. shekkelushot hen keshel avvaz veen arkan yoter al rachban:
Kelutot. medubbakot zo bazo:
Ad happerek. haemtzai shel etzbaot:
Lematta min happerek. dehaynu letzad hatztzipporen shemmechubbarim kullan:
Vachatachah. sheyyihyu mechullakim, kasher:
Hayta vo yetera. etzba yateret:
Im yesh bah etzem pasul. dehoil vachatachah hare hu mechussar evar shennimtza vo:

Shesh vashesh esrim vearba. kelomar afillu hayu etzbeot yadav veetzbeot raglav shavin, shebbechol yad uvechol regel yesh shesh vashesh, afillu hachi chachamim poslim. vechol shekken im haya veyado achat chamesh uveyado achat shesh, dahave mum tefe. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hashsholet bishte yadav rabbi posel. desavar kechishuta ityelida veh beyamin:
Vachachamim machshirin. savre beriuta hi deityelida leh bismol. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hakkushi. shachor:
Haggichor. adom keargaman:
Hallavkan. lavan beyoter:
Vehakkippeach. aroch vadak, sheeno av lefi arko. vehu mechoar umegunne:

Vehashshikkor. velo miyyayin, hu dachashiv kevaal mum min hammumim hayeterim baadam, sheim avad loke veen avodato mechullelet. aval hashshikkor miyyayin veshechar, im avad chillel. divfarashat shetuye yayin ketiv (Vayikra 10) ulehavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol. veshikkor dematnitin eno ella sheshshata chalav harebe, o rov devash, o achal devela kailit, venitbalbela dato. sheellu chashuvim kevaale mumim veen mechallelim avoda:
Uvaale negaim tehorim. kegon bohak vechullo hafach lavan. dei minnegaim temeim lo tzarich lememar, daafillu akkenisat azara chayyav karet:
Dildulin. kemin chatichot basar yotzot teluyot bahen. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:
Al ellu mumin. nifgema. en pegima belo chesron. aval sedek mashma nammi belo chesron. veshiur pegima, kede shettachgor bah tzipporen:
Hassechus. tenuch haozen shekkorin 305 belaaz:
Aval lo min haor. deor hadar bari velo have muma. vehay or hayenu alya rakka shel ozen:
Nikkeva melo charshina. sheyyesh bachalal hannekev shiur gargir shel karshina, ben shehannekev aroch ben agol, im yesh bechullan kede lehitztaref bachalalo keshiur gargir shel karshina, hare ze mum:

Shettehe nifrachet. naaset peruchim ufetitim keshemmemashmeshim bah. veen halacha kerabbi yose. vechol hane mumin dachashiv bematnitin sheshshochatin alehen et habbechor yalfinan mikkerae, dichtiv (Devarim 15) vechi yihye bo mum, kelal. pisseach o ivver, perat. kol mum ra, chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella cheen happerat. ma happerat meforash mumin shebbegaluy veeno chozer, af kol mumin shebbegaluy veeno chozer:
En pochatin laaniyyim baggoren. keshemmechallekin masar ani baggoren en notnin lechol ani veani pachot mishshiur ze, dichtiv (Devarim 26) veachlu visharecha vesaveu, ten lo kede savo:

Devela. teenim yeveshim leachar shennidrasim baiggul keruyin devela, veshuv en nimkarim bemidda ella vemishkal, lehachi tane mane devela, umane hu mishkal mea dinarim vehaddinar mishkal shishsha maim umishkal hammaa shishsha asar gargere seora:

Peras. chatzi mane, uvechol hammiddot haamurot bematnitin halacha ketanna kamma vahalacha keabba shaul. velo neemru devarim hallalu ella lamchallek masar ani baggoren, aval hamechallek masar ani betoch beto mechallek kefi retzono, velo natnu vo chachamim shiur:

Haddemay en lo chomesh. happode maaser sheni shel demay eno noten et hachomesh, mishshum derov amme haaretz measserin hem. hilkach keren dimakkev bidorayta ita bidrabbanan, chomesh delo meakkev bidorayta yeachel:
Veen lo biur. besof shalosh shanim, shechayyav levaer kol maasrotav kedichtiv (Devarim 26) biarti hakkodesh min habbayit, velo tikkenuhu rabbanan bidmay:
Veneechol leonen. demaaser sheni shel vadday asur laonen kedichtiv (sham) lo achalti veoni mimmennu, umaaser sheni shel demay lo gazru vo:
Venichnas lirushalayim veyotze. nifde veneechol chutz lirushalayim, ma sheen ken bevadday shehammechitztzot koltot veen yecholin lifdoto ulehotzio chutz lachoma leachar shenichnas, uvidmay lo gazru:

Umeabbedim miuto badderachim. im haya maaser sheni shel demay badderachim bimkom gedude chayya velistim, afillu haya davar muat veyachol lahavio belo torach uvelo hefsed, eno choshesh lo umanniach oto leaved badderech bammakom shehu sham. verambam peresh sheim beshaa shemmolich maaser sheni shel demay birushalayim neevad mimmennu meat badderech eno choshesh lo, ma sheen ken bevadday shetztzarich sheyyaalehu kullo o damav velo yippased mimmennu kelum badderachim:
Venotnim oto leam haaretz. leachlo birushalayim veaf al pi shehu chashud leachlo betuma, ma sheen ken bevadday sheen mosrim oto leam haaretz lefi sheeno nizhar leachlo betohora:
Veyochal kenegdo. keneged ma shennatan leam haaretz lokeach minnechasav veochel betohorat maaser birushalayim:

Umechallelim oto kesef al kesef. im yesh lo kesef maaser sheni shel demay vehu tzarich lo yachol lechallelo al kesef chullin, ma sheen ken bevadday, sheen mechallelin kesef al kesef ella bislaim shel shene melachim sheyyachol lechallel ze al ze im hashsheni charif, aval shel melech echad lo delav derech chillul hu, uvidmay share:
Kesef al nechoshet. afillu shello middochak. aval shel vadday middochak in, shello middochak lo:

Veyachazor veyifde et happerot. garsinan, velo garsinan uvilvad sheyyachazor veyifde. vehachi kaamar veyachol lachazor velifdot et happerot im yirtze, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim omrim eno yachol lachazor velifdotam ella maale happerot lirushalayim. vahalacha kachachamim:

Mikkikkar befunedyon. kikkar hannimkar befunedyon keshehachittim nimkarim arba seim lesela. vearba sein hen esrim vearbaa kabbin, shekkol sea hi shishsha kabbin, vehassela hu arbaa dinarim vechol dinar shishsha main, nimtza hassela esrim vearbaa main, nimtzeu esrim vearbaa kabbin leesrim vearbaa main, kav lechol maa, vehammaa shene funedyonim, hare hakkikkar hannimkar befunedyon hu chatzi kav. aval mippene shehachenvani rotze lehistakker litziat haafiyya vehattechina i efshar sheyyimmacher hakkikkar shehu chatzi kav befunedyon kefi haerech shemmochrim hattevua bashshuk arba seim besela, lefichach lo yihye hakkikkar hannimkar befunedyon ella rova hakkav bilvad. ucheshemmechallekim tevua leani baggoren vealav litchon veleefot en pochatin mechatzi kav, aval keshennotnim lo kikkar afuy lo yihye ella rova hakkav shehem shishsha betzim. vehachi meforash beferek ketzad mishtattefin beeruvin (daf 82):
Parnasat lina. mitta vecharim uchesatot:
Mezon shalosh seuddot. shechayyav adam leechol bashshabbat shalosh seuddot:

Lo yittol min hattamchuy. lefi shehattamchuy mitchallek bechol yom, shehaggabbaim machazirim al pitche baale vattim bechol yom velokchim mehem tavshil letzorech haaniyyim, vehakkeli shemmesimim bo et hattavshil nikra tamchuy:
Lo yittol min hakkuppa. lefi shehakkuppa mitchalleket meerev shabbat leerev shabbat:
Nigbet bishnayim. lefi shemmemashkenim al hatztzedaka, veen osim serara al hatztzibbur pachot mishshenayim:
Umitchalleket bishlosha. lefi shehi kedine mamonot vedine mamonot bishlosha:
Umet chatano. venafla lifne yavam:

Yachol hu sheyyomar. o chalotz o yabbem. veillu leachiv, o yitten ma sheppasak o teshev ad shettalbin roshah. veaf al gav deachiv am haaretz vehu talmid chacham, yachol hu lomar leachicha hayiti rotze litten ulecha eni rotze litten:
Matayim zuz. kim lehu lerabbanan sheellu maspikim leshana achat lichsut velimzonot:
O lichtubbat ishto. vaafillu hi yoshevet tachtav:

Veet kele tashmisho. kelim yafim shemmishtammesh bahem bashshabbatot uvargalim. vehanne mile keshebba littol leket shichcha ufea veeno notel mikkuppa shel tzedaka, shemmitparnes betzina veeno notel mimma shebbeyad gabbay, aval im notel mikkuppa shel tzedaka az en mannichin oto littol afillu leket shichcha ufea ad sheyyimkor kele tashmisho:
Hakkotzer ballayla vehammeammer. ballayla:
Vehassuma. ben bayyom ben ballayla:
Im haya mitkavven littol haggas haggas. kevan demitkavven littol haggassin afillu dakkin en lahem shichcha:
Al menat ma sheani shochech ani notel yesh lo shichcha. dematne al ma shekkatuv battora utenao batel:
Ad detinnassevan. ad sheyyitarsu. veim bagru af al pi shello nitarsu en lahem mezonot, dekayma lan bogeret en lah mezonot:

Maase shehallechi hattachton. mishshum ditnan leel divfiv dome lachazir pelige rabbanan aleh deila, kamashma lan hasheta delo felige rabbanan aleh ella visfato haelyona odefet al hattachtona, aval sefato hattachtona odefet al haelyona modim rabbanan dahave mum. umaase nammi shehallechi hattachton odef al haelyon veamru chachamim hare ze mum. vehane mille kesheetzem hallechi hattachton odef al haelyon, az have mum afillu bivhema. aval en bah etzem ella shessefato hattachtona arukka umekabbelah et haelyona, have mum baadam aval lo vabbehema:
Ozen haggedi shehayta chefula. sheyyesh lo shete aznayim mitztzad echad ozen betoch ozen:
Bizman shehi etzem echad. sheen lah ella tenuch echad, shennichpal tenuch haelyon letocho venitchabber lematta, have mum:
Veim enah etzem echad. shehattenuchim muvdalim lemala:
Eno mum. vetaama lo itparash. umikkol makom lo dame levaal chamesh raglayim, deozen betoch ozen eno nire kol kach:
Shehi doma leshel chazir. agulla chiznav hachazir, veaf al pi sheenah dakka chemotah:
Shalosh chulyot. davka bezanav shel tale hu devainan shalosh chulyot. aval zanav shel gedi, chulya achat bilvad mum, shetayim eno mum. vechen halacha:

Hereti vechor ze. lechacham, veamar li shemmum kavua hu, veshochato, uvilvad sheyyihyu lo edim shello hittilo vo. shehakkohanim chashudim lehattil mum babbechor kede lemachro ulehaachilo kechullin, aval en chashudin leechol kadashim temimim bachutz velomar al mum over shehu kavua. vechohen shehu mumche neeman ladun al mum habbechor shehu kavua ulehattiro. vechen neeman hakkohen lomar bechor ze natan li yisrael bemumo, shehu asuy lehiggalot im netano lo yisrael bemumo im lav, umilleta daavida leiggalloye lo meshakkere vah eynashe:

Hakkol neemanim al mume hammaaser. hakkohanim chayyavim lehaferish maasar behema keyisrael. vehakkol neemanim lomar al mum shennaasa bevehemat maaser deshello bechavvana haya, vaafillu habbealim. miggo dei vae shade veh muma vechulleh edreh kodem sheyyeasser, venimtza hammaaser baal mum:
Shennismet eno shenniktea yado. dehaynu mum muvhak:

Bene hakkeneset. kelomar sheenan chachamim. vehane mille bemakom sheen yachid mumche, aval bemakom sheyyesh yachid mumche eno nishchat ella al pi mumche, vaafillu bemum muvhak. dumeya dahafarat nedarim shebbemakom sheyyesh yachid mumche en shelosha hedyotot moilim:

Afillu hayu sham esrim ushelosha. afillu hayta sanhedrin bammakom veen sham echad shennatal reshut lehattir mume habbechor, eno nishchat al pihem vaafillu bemum muvhak, ad sheyyihye sham mumche. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Lo yimmane yisrael im hakkohen. leechol immo bachavura mibbesar bechor baal mum. sheen nimnin al habbechor ella chavura shekkullah kohanim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) uvesaram yihye lacha kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin, ma chaze veshok kohanim in yisrael lo, af bechor ben tamim ben baal mum kohanim in yisrael lo:

Uvet hillel mattirin vaafillu nachri. dichtiv (Devarim 12) katztzevi vechaayyal, ma tzevi veayyal afillu nachri, af bechor nammi. ukera dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) uvesaram yihye lacha kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin, bivchor tamim davka mishtae:
Sheachazo dam. choli shehu mistakken bo meribbuy haddam:
En makkizin lo dam. vaafillu bemakom sheeno ose bo mum. demittoch sheadam bahul al mamono, i sharet leh bemakom sheen ose vo mum ate lemeevad bemakom sheose bo mum:

Uvilvad shello yaase vo mum. shello yisdok rosh azno o niv sefatav bemakom shello yuchal lachazor uleherafe. desavre rabbanan kol shekken dei lo sharet leh bemakom sheen bo mum ate lemeevad afillu bemakom sheyyesh bo mum:
Lo yishshachet alav. hoil vehu hittilo. ad sheyyippol bo mum acher:
Yakkiz. af bemakom sheose bo mum, im hu tzarich lehakkiz meoto evar. velo yannichennu sheyyamut. veaf al pi shehu hittil hammum beyadav yishshachet alav. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:

Haomer sheyyesh bo satayim eno shichcha. dichtiv (sham) lo tashuv lekachto, omer sheatta yachol lehagebiho kullo keachat velaset oto al ketefo, yatza ze shel satayim shei atta yachol lehagebiah kullo keachat:
Amru lo yafe kocho. kidamrinan shetayim shichcha shalosh enan shichcha:
Lo im amarta beomer echad shehu chegadish. din hu sheomer echad sheyyesh bo satayim lo yihye shichcha, mippene shehu chegadish veen shayyach shichcha begadish:
Tomar bishne omarim. shehem kemo shear omarim ketannim:
Kichrichot. kaagudot ketannot:
Daddav shochvim. gedolim ad shennirim shochvim kedadde ishsha:
Nichpe. nofel mechamat choli:
Afillu achat leyamim. sheeno nofel tadir ella paam achat lizman merubbe:
Ruach katzrit. sherucho ketzara mechamat [mara] hashshechora haggoveret alav lifrakim venishar belo hergesh:
Hameushkan. shekkis shel betzim shello aroch ad shemmaggia laarkuva. ben shehu nafuach mechamat ruach o mechamat lecha:
Uvaal gever. baal evar. shennitarech haggid shello venaasa gadol ad shemmaggia learkubbotav:
Shennimrechu ashachav. shennimmochu betzav:
Sheruach baashachav. veal yede ken betzav nefuchim:

Shemmarav chashuchin. shehu shachor. veaf al pi sheeno shachor kechushi. uleshon meroach ashech, mare choshech. velav bevetzim mishtae kera. uveikkar haddin lo felige, shekkol echad mehem mode bemum shemmone chavero dahave mum. velo nechleku ella beferusho shel mikra, umashmaut dorshin ikka benayhu:
Hashshochet et habbechor. umachar mibbesaro venoda lanu shello herahu lechacham:
Ma sheachlu. hallokchim achlu:
Veyachazir lahem et haddamim. mishshum kenas. sheheechilam besar issur:

Mecharuhu. hallokchim lenachri, hoil velo garam lahem issura, yeshallemu lo deme terefa kemo shehi nimkeret bezol, vehu yachazir lahem et hammotar. vegabbe vechor lo tane mecharuhu lenachri, divchor tamim asur bahanaa:
